data.name: Asmodeus: Embrace of Life and Death
Asmodeus: Embrace of Life and Death
Forbidden Chakra Fury
data.description: The user's chakra lashes out aggressively at all nearby enemies. The chakra attacks autonomously, seeking out targets within a certain range. The attacks are fast and powerful, capable of causing significant damage to multiple opponents.
data.battleDescription: With a fierce battle cry, %user channels their chakra into a raging storm of energy, surrounding %target. Each strike fueled by this chakra fury lands with intense force, overwhelming %target's defenses and pushing them to their limits. The sheer ferocity of the assault leaves %target reeling, struggling to withstand the relentless barrage of chakra-infused attacks.

data.name: Ethereal Rebirth
data.description:
A forbidden art that breaks the seal upon the user's soul and burns them anew in green flame, turning every wound into new life at the cost of their strength.

DON'T TRAIN. ALREADY CAPPED. IT HAS NO POWER PER LEVEL
data.battleDescription: %user cracks open the seal upon their own soul, and the elements burn through them in a roar of green flame that erupts outward to strike %target. In the fire's wake %user's body begins to unmake and remake itself, turning every wound they suffer into new life. The rebirth is not gentle; it pulls the strength from %user's arms to feed the blaze, and for a time their blows fall soft as ash. What rises from those flames is harder to kill than what entered them.

data.name: Ethereal Nexus
data.description: A forbidden art that binds fire, water, earth and wind into a knot of chakra that drinks the life of its prey. The hunger it awakens leaves its user's own body exposed.
data.battleDescription: Fire, water, earth and wind spiral together between %user's hands, tightening into a single blinding knot of chakra that burns too bright to look upon. Released, the nexus tears into %target and drinks from the wound, pouring stolen life back into %user with every blow they land. But a power that devours does not rest easily in its host, and as the nexus feeds, %user's own body lies open, stripped raw by the hunger within.

data.name: Subaku Palace
data.description: A forbidden art stolen from Subaku Castle that calls the demon palace into the waking world, sapping every enemy beneath its gates while pouring dark power into its master.
data.battleDescription: %user presses a palm to the earth, and a sigil of burning gold spirals outward across the battlefield. With a sound like grinding stone, gates of red sandstone carved with snarling faces tear free of the ground, and the shadow of the demon palace falls across the field. Beneath those gates strength drains away and every strike grows timid, while the palace pours its dark power into the one who summoned it. For a time the battlefield belongs to the demon palace, and to its master.

data.name: Hollow Veil
data.description:
Casts a shroud of ash-gray mist over the enemy that drains the fire from their strikes and turns their fury into the user's strength.

DON'T TRAIN. ALREADY CAPPED. IT HAS NO POWER PER LEVEL
data.battleDescription: With a whisper from %user, a veil of ash-gray mist drifts across the battlefield and settles over %target like a funeral shroud. It hollows %target out from within, draining the fire from their strikes until even their fiercest blows fall weak and distant. What the veil takes, it gives to its maker: every wound %target lands on %user returns to them as quiet, restoring breath.

data.name: Celestial Dew
data.description: Calls down a drop of starlight from a crescent moon that heals the user and wraps them in a silver ward.
data.battleDescription: %user closes their eyes and the night seems to answer, a pale crescent moon blooming into being above them. From its tip falls a single drop of starlight that splashes across %user and spreads into a dome of soft, silver light. Wounds knit closed beneath its glow as the dome settles into a quiet ward that swallows the blows meant for its keeper. Within it, for a few heartbeats, the battle seems very far away.

data.name: Blazing Fang Strike
data.description: Unleashes a great fire dragon whose burning fangs pierce straight through any guard. The fire takes root in its prey and burns on long after.
data.battleDescription: Flame gathers in %user's hands until it can no longer be contained, coiling into a great fire dragon with jaws agape. With a roar that shakes the air, the dragon lunges across the battlefield and sinks its burning fangs straight through %target's guard as if it were paper. The bite does not end with the strike; the fire takes root deep within %target, flaring anew with every breath that follows.

data.name: Drops of Renewal
data.description: Summons a glowing rain that turns the enemy's blows into healing and swells the user's chakra.
data.battleDescription: %user lifts their face to the sky as a single drop of water falls, then another, then a shimmering rain that gathers around them in slow, glowing spirals. Every wound that reaches %user is drawn into the rain and returned as living water, mending flesh even as it is torn. Fed by the current, %user's chakra swells, and each strike they throw lands with the force of a river in flood. For a short while, %user becomes the eye of a healing storm.

data.name: Earthen Bastion
data.description: Calls the earth up to clad the user in a living fortress of molten-veined stone. Blows break against it, while every strike the user throws carries the weight of the mountain.
data.battleDescription: %user drives a heel into the ground, and the earth answers with a roar. Jagged plates of stone tear free of the battlefield and slam shut around %user, veined with molten light, a living fortress that moves as they move. Blows that land against it crack and scatter like rain on a cliff face, while every strike %user throws carries the weight of the mountain behind it. For as long as the stone holds, %user stands as immovable as the land itself.

data.name: Tempest Cleave
data.description:
A spinning storm of razor wind that carves through everything around the user, friend and foe alike. Its cuts keep singing long after it fades.

DON'T TRAIN. ALREADY CAPPED. IT HAS NO POWER PER LEVEL
data.battleDescription: %user plants their feet and turns once, and the air itself becomes a blade. A storm of razor wind erupts outward in a howling ring, carving through everything within its reach, for the tempest knows no allegiance. Those caught in it are left with wounds that will not close, each cut still singing with the wind long after the gale has passed. In its wake, even the hardiest guard lies in ribbons.

data.name: Abyss of Shadows
data.description: Calls down a black sun of shadow whose crimson corona drinks the light from the battlefield. Beneath it the enemy grows slow and hollow, their strength and guard drawn into its void for a few precious moments.
data.battleDescription: %user raises a hand to the sky, and the light bleeds away as a black sun blooms above %target, its corona burning a deep and terrible crimson. Wisps of shadow spiral down from its rim and wind around %target, dragging them into a silence older than chakra itself. Beneath that dead star %target's strikes come slow and weightless, and their guard dissolves like mist drawn into the void. For a few precious moments, the black sun makes even the mightiest shinobi small.

data.name: Dragon's Fang (竜の牙)
data.description: Dusk becomes a streak of fire and shadow, delivering a devastating, lightning-fast strike that pierces and stuns the target.
data.battleDescription: %user transforms into a blazing streak of fire and shadow, blitzing through %target with lightning speed. %target barely has time to flinch before crumpling like a poorly trained Genin. Somewhere in the distance, even their clan elders are shaking their heads in disappointment.

data.name: Soulflame Rend (魂焔の裂き)
data.description: Shadowy draconic claws materialize from fiery twilight energy and coil around the user. Embers and shadows sharpen their Water and Wind techniques while forming a draconic mantle that guards them against elemental attacks.
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes shadowy claws that coil around their body like a dragon guarding unclaimed ryo. Fiery twilight energy sharpens their Water and Wind techniques while the draconic mantle hardens against elemental attacks. Nice try, though.

data.name: Thunder’s Judgement
data.description: The user wraps themselves in reactive lightning that answers every blow with judgment. For a short while their attacks strike harder and part of every hit they take is thrown back at the attacker.
data.battleDescription: %user surrounds themselves with surging lightning chakra, strengthening their attacks. While the current remains active, incoming damage is partially reflected back at the attacker through reactive lightning.

data.name: Hiru-Sakura: Sakura-ame
data.description: Infusing chakra into a cloud above their opponent, the user is able to make it rain blossom petals that distort enemy senses.
data.battleDescription: %user infuses their chakra into a cloud above %target, gradually changing the cloud's color to a mix of pink and violet. %user clenches their hand as an immense number of blossom petals begin to fall from the cloud like rain, overwhelming %target's senses.

data.name: Magma Slayer
data.description: This jutsu enables the user to conjure an incredible, dangerous ally from the molten depths to maul the target and leave lasting wounds.
data.battleDescription: %user utilizes the power of their lineage to conjure a humanoid magma form from the molten depths. As the husk arises, an incredible heatwave forms around the area. The husk emanates incredible temperatures and looks at %target with murderous intent as it prepares for the slaughter.

data.name: Demonic Vitae
data.description: By tapping into the ancestral demonic energy within their blood, the user can momentarily enhance their physical attributes, increasing their strength and speed for a short duration.
data.battleDescription: %user channels their demonic heritage, their eyes glowing with an eerie light as they draw on the ancient power within their blood. A surge of dark energy pulses through their veins, amplifying their strength and speed. With newfound power, %user launches themselves at the opponent, their movements a blur as they deliver a series of powerful, precise strikes. The opponent is caught off guard by the sudden increase in %user's abilities, struggling to defend against the onslaught. The demonic energy crackles around %user, a testament to their formidable lineage, as they push their limits to gain the upper hand.

data.name: Ancient Demon Roar
data.description: The Ancient Demon Roar Jutsu is a powerful and fearsome technique that harnesses the immense chakra of an ancient demon.
data.battleDescription: With a primal roar, %user begins channeling the ancient and powerful chakra within. A massive shockwave, tinged with the aura of ancient spirits, surges towards %target, shaking the very ground and overwhelming everything in its path with raw, unbridled force.

data.name: Cauterize
data.description: The user presses searing red chakra against their wounds and burns them closed, restoring health. The heat also scours away the harmful effects clinging to their body.

effects.description: DETOUR NOTE: Should be set to self
DETOUR NOTE: Should be set to self

data.battleDescription: %user presses glowing red chakra to their wounds, searing them shut and burning away every lingering affliction.

data.name: Ryūsa Kōka
data.description: The user wraps their body in a flowing layer of hardened earth chakra. For a short while their attacks hit harder, and the armor blunts any Earth attack that strikes them.
data.battleDescription: %user envelops their body in a dense, moving layer of fortified earth chakra. The hardened flow surges with pressure, sharpening attacks and blunting earthen impacts, allowing the user to strike harder while enduring Earth techniques with ease.

data.name: Chōha
data.description: A technique that channels the power of the ocean into the user’s weapon, boosting their speed and flexibility with each strike.
data.battleDescription: %user's weapon shimmers as it becomes enveloped in swirling water, the fluid force enhancing their agility. With every swing, the weapon moves with the grace and power of a tidal wave, each strike increasing in speed and precision. The water flows seamlessly around %user, allowing them to dodge and counter with fluidity, making them nearly untouchable in battle.

data.name: Fire Release: Inferno
data.description: The user wraps the target in a clinging haze of fire chakra that does no harm by itself. For a short time every blow they take burns deeper, and fire techniques strike them harder still.
data.battleDescription: %user breathes a shimmering wave of heat over %target, leaving them smoldering and primed for the flames to come.

data.name: Enjin
data.description: A technique that envelops the user’s weapon in flames, boosting their speed and power with every strike.
data.battleDescription: %user’s weapon bursts into flames, the intense heat warping the air around them. With every swing, the flames grow fiercer, their strikes gaining momentum and power. The weapon becomes an extension of %user’s fiery will, cutting through defenses like a hot knife through butter, and leaving behind trails of searing heat that scorch the battlefield.

data.name: Gust Armor
data.description: The user wraps themselves in dense, howling wind that sharpens their wind techniques. Cutting gusts lash out at the target, leaving them more exposed to damage for a short time.
data.battleDescription: A roaring vortex coils around %user, sharpening their wind as cutting gusts tear open %target's guard.

data.name: Guard
data.description: The user raises a swirling guard of dense chakra that soaks up incoming blows as a temporary shield. For a short time, part of every hit they take is hurled back at the attacker.
data.battleDescription: %user weaves swift hand seals and a spinning wall of chakra rises around them, ready to catch blows and fling them back.

data.name: Chakra Resonance
data.description: The user releases a harmonic pulse of chakra that crashes into the target. The resonance rattles through their body and can stun them, slowing their next moves.
data.battleDescription: %user sends a resonating wave of chakra crashing into %target, the vibration leaving them reeling.

data.name: Hellfire Apparition
data.description: The user burns their own life force to raise a phantom castle of hellfire that spirals across the field. Its heat stokes the user's attacks while every enemy caught in the blaze finds their healing badly weakened.
data.battleDescription: %user bleeds chakra into the air until a phantom castle of hellfire rises in a burning spiral around them. Its scorched air chokes the healing of every enemy within its walls, while the flames pour back into %user's strikes.

data.name: Spectral Chain
data.description: Spectral chains lash out of the void and wrap around the target's mind, wracking them with phantom pain. While the illusion holds, the user stands steady and cannot be stunned.
data.battleDescription: %user performs a swift, entrancing sequence of hand seals. Spectral chains erupt from the void around %target, latching onto their mind and spirit. The illusion tightens with each pulse, sending jolts of phantom pain and confusion through their senses. As the chains bind %target in this nightmarish loop, the user is enveloped in a stabilizing aura, making them immune to stunning interruptions while the illusion holds.

data.name: Unholy Enhancement
data.description: The user awakens a corrupted vitality, amplifying their strength while their body shrugs off harm with unnatural resilience.
data.battleDescription: A dark pulse spreads through %user’s veins, quickening with hungry force. %user’s strikes land harder, fueled by something that does not tire, while blows from %target sink shallow, unable to fully pierce what refuses to weaken.

data.name: Cosmic Explosion
data.description: Condense celestial energy into a volatile sphere that explodes around the target, dealing damage and leaving lasting wounds.
data.battleDescription: %user releases a small purple ball into the center of the battlefield, the small ball begins to vibrate as a strong gravitational field begins to draw in %targets and the surrounding area. Once %targets reaches the center and makes contact with the sphere, it ignites causing a chain reaction of the entire area around %target igniting

data.name: Ice bound fortitude
data.description: Expand your domain, summoning heavy ice chains
data.battleDescription: %user expands the elemental chakra in wide area, summoning dark ice shackles, binding %target to the ground

data.name: Starlight Veil
data.description: Channels celestial energy to enhance both strength and protection.
data.battleDescription: %user gazes upward, drawing in the shimmering essence of the stars. As the celestial energy courses through their veins, a radiant veil of starlight surrounds them. This ethereal barrier fortifies their defenses, while simultaneously enhancing their offensive prowess. With each attack, %user strikes with the force of a shooting star, and every incoming blow is softened by the veil's protective light.

data.name: Celestial Empowerment
data.description: Channeling celestial knowledge from within, the Celestial Mage becomes fortified with the strength of the constellations of old.
data.battleDescription: %user pours through invisible channels in her veins, threading her bones with quiet radiance and igniting ancient constellation patterns beneath her skin. Her eyes become mirrors of the night sky, deep and burning with distant suns and millions of stars.

data.name: Godflare Construct
data.description: Compiles the first forbidden light into a volatile war-core and detonates it into the rendering layer.
data.battleDescription: %user launches a Godflare Construct at %target, unleashing the first light that ever dared exist—an orb of divine overheat that fractures air, color, and memory with its violent return.

data.name: Chakra Cannon
data.description: A blast of raw chakra to pierce and obliterate your foes
data.battleDescription: %user shapes chakra into a ball in the palm of their hands before throwing it at %target. The chakra explodes dealing damage.

data.name: Eclipse Drain
data.description:
A cursed enhancement that boosts the user's damage and restores health with every strike.

DON'T TRAIN. ALREADY CAPPED. IT HAS NO POWER PER LEVEL
data.battleDescription: %user draws in a slow breath as a shadow-like chakra coils around their arms and chest, pulsing with violent rhythm. Their strikes begin to land harder, the weight of each hit intensified by dark energy. As they attack, part of the damage inflicted siphons back into their body, restoring vitality through every blow.

data.name: Water Release: Heavy Rain
data.description: The user calls a heavy downpour over the battlefield and moves within its curtain. For a short time the rain sharpens their water techniques and blunts the blows aimed at them.
data.battleDescription: %user raises a hand to the sky and heavy rain sweeps across the field, feeding their water chakra and dulling incoming blows.

data.name: Thunder Chain Slash
data.description: The user snaps a lightning-charged chain weapon at the target in a sudden lashing slash. The jolt locks up their muscles, stunning them and costing them action points.
data.battleDescription: %user channels lightning chakra into a chained weapon and unleashes a sudden, snapping slash toward %target. The moment the weapon strikes, a burst of electricity erupts from the point of contact, locking up the enemy’s muscles with a violent jolt. The electric backlash leaves %target momentarily paralyzed, caught in the crackling wake of the chained assault.

data.name: Ghosts of the Looking Glass
data.description: Summons ghostly entities from the Vorpal Sword.

effects.description: Ghostly entities emerge from the Vorpal Sword.

data.battleDescription: KyoRuedrig holds out a hilt without a blade, channeling the madness in his heart. Chakra flows down his arm, manifesting the Vorpal Sword into existence. With a single slash of the shimmering blade, KyoRuedrig rends the veil between dreams and reality, allowing the ghost trapped in the Vorpal Sword to break free. The ghostly entities swarm the battlefield, their eerie presence causing %target to feel the chilling grip of madness and despair.

data.name: Crimson Spires
data.description:
A cursed spike technique that makes the enemy take more damage from non-elemental attacks and suffer recoil when they strike.

DON'T TRAIN. ALREADY CAPPED. IT HAS NO POWER PER LEVEL
data.battleDescription: %user conjures blood-red chakra spikes beneath %target’s feet. The moment they pierce upward, they embed a lingering curse that tears at %target's body whenever they attack. Non-elemental damage becomes harder to withstand, and each strike %target makes sends backlash through their own frame.

data.name: Command
data.description: The Primordial Flame is the original essence from which all elemental chakra was born. Unlike ordinary fire, it embodies the perfect balance of the five primordial elements, allowing its wielder to seamlessly channel Fire, Water, Wind, Earth, and Lightning through a single, ever-burning flame
data.battleDescription: Madcrep channels the first flame to blast %target with raw elemental fire, igniting their body and chakra

data.name: Ethereal Bloom
data.description:
A graceful support technique that boosts healing effects and reduces incoming damage.

DON'T TRAIN. ALREADY CAPPED. IT HAS NO POWER PER LEVEL
data.battleDescription: %user blossoms with chakra-infused energy that calms the body and hardens the spirit. As ethereal chakra petals drift around them, healing becomes more effective and damage is softened, shielding them in a veil of resilience.

data.name: Small Chakra Barrier
data.description: The user stretches out an arm and raises a small wall of chakra close by. For a short time it stands in the path of incoming attacks, soaking up much of their force.
data.battleDescription: %user performs hand signs and stretches out their arm, creating a barrier of chakra in front of them.

data.name: Hittakuri
data.description: The user tears open a pitch-black rift that lashes out at the target and rifles through their pockets for ryo. The shock of the theft rattles them, weakening their attacks for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user opens a swirling black rift that strikes %target and snatches a fistful of their ryo before snapping shut.

data.name: Gale Release
data.description: Calls forth a silent and swirling vortex to envelop and confuse.
data.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra into the air, creating a silent cyclone that spirals onto the battlefield

data.name: Whispering Winds
data.description: A ghostly breeze whistles from the user's hand, slicing at the target and filling their ears with eerie whispers. The voices fray their nerve, leaving them more exposed to every kind of attack for a short time.
data.battleDescription: With a gentle sway of the hand, %user summons a spectral wind that whistles with haunted whispers. The gust slashes through %target’s senses, disrupting their mental clarity and unraveling their resistance to harm. The eerie presence lingers, amplifying every attack to come.

data.name: Ice chains
data.description: Hinder your enermy with ice chains
data.battleDescription: Hinder your enermy with ice chains

data.name: Tides of Sovereignty
data.description: Summoning the might of the endless sea, the user commands the tides to swell their power, amplifying the force of every water-based assault with sovereign wrath.
data.battleDescription: %user draws deep from their water chakra reserves, their movements becoming smooth, forceful, and unrelenting like a rising tide. Each strike is infused with hydraulic pressure, reinforcing every blow with the crushing strength of flowing currents. The user’s water-based techniques become more destructive, mirroring the power of sovereign tides.

data.name: Shimmer
data.description: Synchronizes the user’s chakra with their weapon, enhancing its power.
data.battleDescription: %user channels the power of their lineage into forming a blade dome. As the blade form, their eyes awaken.  In this state, %user 's awareness and abilities are enhanced

data.name: Illusionary Celestial Mirage
data.description: The user floods the target's mind with a vision of falling stars that sears them with radiant light. The dazzling afterimages linger, dulling their attacks for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user weaves an elegant seal, and the sky above %target fills with illusory stars that rain down and sear their mind.

data.name: Flash Pulse
data.description: Release a massive pulse of chakra through your body.
data.battleDescription: %user claps their hands together, releasing a massive pulse of chakra around their body.

data.name: Gaze into Yomi
data.description: A forbidden jutsu that brings the target's departed loved ones to the battlefield, crushing them in a cold mist and sealing their bloodline. The user's attacks hit harder for a short time, though every hit they take then burns deeper.
data.battleDescription: %user forms hand seals while smoke rises from their body. The smoke rapidly expands into a cold, damp cloud, engulfing %user and hiding them from sight. %target feels a cold chill run down their back as the area around them turns gray and all color drains from their vision. The mist materializes into spirit-like apparitions resembling deceased family members. They float around %target, softly wailing in agony as they close in, their cold grip crushing the breath from %target and smothering their bloodline while the borrowed grief sharpens %user's strikes and leaves them raw to every blow.

data.name: Martial Movement
data.description: A refined movement technique that evades attacks and reduces the enemy’s offensive power.
data.battleDescription: %user shifts position with disciplined footwork and controlled breathing, weaving through combat with fluid precision. Their movements disrupt %target’s rhythm, dulling the force behind their attacks and reducing the damage they can deliver.

data.name: Phantom Whirlpool
data.description: The user conjures the illusion of a vast whirlpool that drags every enemy in the area into its spiraling depths. Their command over the vision deepens as it turns, making the user's attacks hit harder for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user conjures the illusion of a massive whirlpool swirling beneath %target’s feet, dragging their senses into a spiraling abyss. As the illusion tightens, the crushing pressure distorts their perception, causing real damage and mentally fracturing their composure. The user’s mastery over the genjutsu deepens with the cast, heightening the force behind every attack that follows.

data.name: Thunder Fist
data.description: The user charges a fist with violent static and slams it into the target. The discharge seizes their nerves, stunning them and stealing their momentum.
data.battleDescription: %user channels concentrated lightning chakra into their fist until it pulses with violent static. With a flash-step and explosive lunge, they slam their electrified strike into %target. The chakra discharges on impact, sending a jolt through the target’s nervous system, locking muscles, distorting balance, and interrupting movement. Thunder Fist is not just a blow; it’s a system shock, leaving %target frozen and open for the next attack.

data.name: Forgotten Ember Blade
data.description: Forgotten Ember Blade harnesses the fierce and explosive power of the fire element, once thought lost to the Yaketsuku Netsu bloodline. The user channels their chakra into their weapon, transforming it into a conduit for devastating flames. With a powerful swing, they unleash a wave of fiery energy that incinerates everything in its path, leaving nothing but scorched earth in its wake.
data.battleDescription: %user's eyes burn with an intense focus as they channel their chakra into their weapon, flames crackling to life along the blade. With a powerful shout, they swing their weapon in a wide arc, unleashing a torrent of fiery energy towards %target. The ground beneath the slash ignites, and %target is engulfed in a blazing inferno, their form outlined by the searing flames. The heat is overwhelming, and the sheer force of the attack leaves %target reeling, their defenses crumbling under the relentless assault. The air is thick with the scent of smoke and ash, a testament to the destructive might of the Yaketsuku Netsu bloodline.

data.name: Divine Elements
data.description: Generate 5 cyclones of elemental chakra that collides against each other.
data.battleDescription: %user generates 5 cyclones of elemental chakra around %target. With precise control each cyclones converges on %target

data.name: Sickle Twist
data.description: Conjures a spectral sickle from dust that disorients and ensnares the target.
data.battleDescription: %user channels their mastery over dust, conjuring a spectral kusarigama from dust in the air, its blade constantly flickering in and out of %target’s vision. The air hums as the weapon twirls back and forth, leaving %target bewildered, their attempts to track it futile. In a blink, the blade solidifies, hurtling towards %target, who braces for impact. Yet, the sickle vanishes once more, only to rematerialize an instant before slicing into %target’s flesh, the chain ensnaring their limbs. With a decisive yank, %user dissipates the weapon, the dust settling ominously into %target’s wounds.

data.name: Dragon Eye Awakening
data.description: Channels celestial energy to enhance both strength and protection.
data.battleDescription: %user steadies their stance as wind currents spiral inward. A vast draconic presence stretches across the skyline while radiant currents descend in measured waves.  Luminous scales of celestial chakra layer across %user’s form, reinforcing muscle and guard alike as their strikes grow heavier and their defense unyielding beneath the crowned horizon.

data.name: Ice Shackles
data.description: The Gaze regards a rival and the cold agrees. Frost climbs them like a verdict, and for a breath the world simply declines to let them move.
data.battleDescription: %user levels the trident and its three eyes narrow. Frost races up %target from the ground, locking joint after joint, until %target stands shackled in blue ice.

data.name: Incandescent Nova
data.description: Incandescent Nova showcases extreme control over the scorch release, summoning a radiant nova that converges on a target and evaporates a massive area in an instant.
data.battleDescription: %user performs a series of hand signs, unleashing a surge of chakra that forms a radiant nova around %target. The area rapidly evaporates as the nova converges inward, erupting in a devastating blast that inflicts lasting burns through simultaneous heat and dehydration.

data.name: Waterborn Shield
data.description: The user cloaks themselves in a dense shell of rolling water. For a short time it soaks up incoming attacks like a second layer of health and dulls the force of every blow.
data.battleDescription: %user conjures a Waterborn Shield, wrapping themselves in rolling tides that swallow and dull incoming blows.

data.name: Nature's Curse
data.description: Sap away the life of your target the longer they stand in front of you.
data.battleDescription: %user enters a mad frenzy throwing themselves at %target after a series of furious blows they manage to attach a string of chakra that is naked to the visible eye slowly sapping away the lifeforce of %target

data.name: Liquid Palm
data.description: The user flows to a new position and unleashes rapid water-charged palm strikes on the enemies around them. The current keeps moving through their body afterwards, turning part of every blow they take into health for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user glides forward on a rush of water chakra and crashes into nearby enemies with rapid palm strikes, the current around them ready to drink in the next blow.

data.name: Glacial Volley
data.description: The wielder raises the Gaze and the air answers with an arsenal. A dozen lances of ice hang waiting, and every one of them has already chosen where it lands.
data.battleDescription: %user raises the trident and the cold assembles into ranks: lance after lance of pale ice hanging in the air, every point aimed at %target. %user lowers the tines, and winter volleys.

data.name: Thunderclap Strike
data.description: The user charges their fists with lightning and lands a strike that bursts with a thunderous boom. The crackling energy surges through their body, sharpening their offense and defense for a short time.
data.battleDescription: Thunder booms as %user drives a lightning-charged fist into %target, the energy crackling back through %user's body.

data.name: Lightning Flash Strike
data.description: The user charges their blade with raw lightning and cuts through the target in a blinding flash. Sparks keep crawling over their body, so every hit they take bites deeper for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user channels raw lightning into their blade and launches at %target in a blinding flash. The strike cleaves through the air with violent speed, erupting in an electric burst upon contact. The sheer velocity and power tear through defenses, leaving behind scorched ground and ringing silence as arcs of electricity dance across the impact zone.

data.name: Sunshine
data.description: A powerful beacon that brings friendship and hope
data.battleDescription: %user slices his hand and slams his hand on the ground summoning a giant spectral tree that pulses with light giving Kieto a massive boost in chakra.

data.name: Sea King's Armor
data.description: Summon the ocean’s divine protection to shield yourself from harm while striking enemies with the relentless force of the sea.
data.battleDescription: %user calls upon the Sea King’s blessing, reducing damage taken and unleashing a powerful aquatic strike on %target.

data.name: Danse Macabre
data.description: The user conjures a bloom of spectral blades that dance around the target before piercing their chakra points. The wounds can seal away their bloodline for a short time.
data.battleDescription: Spectral blades erupt from %user in a ghostly bloom, scattering around %target before arcing inward to pierce the chakra points that feed their bloodline.

data.name: Primal Incineration
data.description: A fierce surge of flame that burns the enemy and makes them more vulnerable to Fire damage.
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes Primal Incineration, scorching %target with persistent flames and leaving them vulnerable to further Fire damage.

data.name: Chakra Overflow
data.description: A potent chakra buff that surges through every offensive path, making all of the user's attacks hit far harder for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user channels a surge of chakra beyond their natural limit, their aura expanding in a volatile ripple of power. This overflowing chakra wraps around them in thick, radiant waves, barely restrained. Chakra Overflow heightens every offensive path: physical strikes land harder, ninjutsu hits with greater force, and even genjutsu becomes more potent. The surge floods through %user's body and mind, doubling down on that force for the intensity of high-stakes combat. It is the edge between control and chaos, a moment where %user becomes a living conduit of power.

data.name: Senbon Sakura
data.description: The user shatters their blade into a storm of tiny petal-shaped needles that slice into the target. Each cut keeps bleeding, draining their health over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user presses a palm to their sword and it shatters into a cloud of razor petals that whirl into %target, leaving them flecked with blood.

data.name: Arashi Ikari
data.description: A stormborn genjutsu that damages the enemy and increases the damage they take.
data.battleDescription: %user conjures a storm of phantom lightning in %target’s mind. The mental assault deals damage and leaves %target more vulnerable to subsequent attacks.

data.name: Cool-Blooded Empowerment
data.description: Tapping into your primal chakra, you channel it into your summons, granting them a boost in power.
data.battleDescription: Using the connection they share, %user channels their primal chakra into their summoned allies, granting them a significant boost in strength.

data.name: Shockwave Fist
data.description: The user charges their fist with lightning and releases a crackling shockwave on impact. The surge rattles through the target and stuns them.
data.battleDescription: This technique charges %user’s fists with electrical chakra to deliver a crushing blow. Upon impact, the strike releases a violent surge of electricity that deals damage and stuns %target, leaving them momentarily unable to act.

data.name: Gust Punch
data.description: The user packs wind chakra into their fist and punches the target with a burst of compressed air. The blast cuts straight through their guard, ignoring damage reduction and breaking shields.
data.battleDescription: %user drives a wind-charged fist into %target, and a blast of compressed air bursts straight through their guard.

data.name: Drowning Strike
data.description: A fist of boiling water to the face.
data.battleDescription: %user covers their fist in scorching hot water before striking %target in the face, forcing most of that water down their nostrils.

data.name: Force Wave
data.description: The user releases a shockwave of raw chakra that slams into the target like a wall of pressure. The surge leaves the user's chakra running hot, so their attacks hit harder for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes a wave of raw chakra that crashes into %target, the backlash surging through %user and sharpening their next strikes.

data.name: Seal of Nullification
data.description: The user binds the target in chains of sealing script that lock their chakra against any new enhancement. The same seals ward the user, shielding them from debuffs for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user weaves intricate seals in the air, summoning glowing ethereal chains that surge toward %target, coiling tightly to disrupt their chakra flow, suppressing any attempts to invoke new enhancements while the last links settle over %user as a ward against debuffs.

data.name: Temporal Erosion
data.description: Rapidly accelerates the target's timeline, causing them to decay and erode into dust.
data.battleDescription: %user extends their hand, pulling particles from the surrounding air that shimmer with an otherworldly glow. The particles coalesce into jagged shards that gleam with distorted time energy. With a swift motion, %user launches the fragments at %target. The shards tear through the air, bending light and warping space as they collide with %target

data.name: Seimyaku
data.description: The user sends a quiet pulse of chakra through the target's veins, choking their ability to heal. The same pulse settles around the user, blunting non-elemental attacks against them over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user emits a deep, controlled pulse of refined chakra that interferes with %target’s ability to recover while reinforcing their own defenses. The technique dampens restorative energies around the enemy and surrounds the user in a chakra field that cushions incoming non-elemental attacks.

data.name: Fan Dance
data.description: The user sweeps a fan through a graceful dance, weaving wind chakra into every turn. Their wind-element attacks strike far harder for a short time afterwards.
data.battleDescription: %user infuses their fan with wind chakra, performing a Fan Dance that amplifies their wind-based abilities.

data.name: Sapphire Command
data.description: A complex series of slashes drops your opponent to their knees before you.
data.battleDescription: %user releases a pulse of Blue Blade chakra across the battlefield. As the wave passes through %target, their chakra flow freezes, increasing their vulnerability.

data.name: Heaven's Blessing
data.description: The user calls chakra down from the sky to settle over the target like a heavy mantle. For a short time they take more damage, and every hit they suffer burns them further.
data.battleDescription: %user draws chakra down from the heavens and lets it fall over %target, leaving them exposed and burning under every blow.

data.name: Chakra Resistance
data.description: The user layers dense chakra through their body, hardening it against harm. For a short time they take less damage and their attacks strike with greater force.
data.battleDescription: %user draws chakra inward until it settles over their body like armor, steeling them to endure and to strike back harder.

data.name: Blaze Release
data.description: A Flaming lotus that wraps it selfs around the target
data.battleDescription: %user conjures a flicker flaming lotus of With a whispered chant, the lotus blossoms mid-air — and from it burst dozens of petal-like fragments that streak toward %target

data.name: Inferno Kunai Barrage
data.description: The user looses a storm of flaming kunai that rains down across the area, striking every enemy within it. The burning wounds linger, so each blow taken by anyone caught burns hotter over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes a relentless stream of flaming kunai at %target, each one carving through the air with searing heat. The scorching impacts ignite lingering flames that make every later blow against %target burn hotter.

data.name: Ethereal Particle Storm
data.description: The user unleashes a storm of charged particles imbued with temporal energy, blanketing the battlefield. These particles create unstable time zones where objects and enemies fluctuate between accelerated and decelerated states, creating chaos and opportunity.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a shimmering cloud of dust particles that engulf %target, eroding their ability to strike effectively.

data.name: Warpath
data.description: A runeword-charged series of icy slashes that wounds your opponent and strengthens your attacks.
data.battleDescription: %user invokes runewords of iron and strength, empowering themselves before striking %target with cutting ice that leaves a lingering wound.

data.name: Storm Fist
data.description: The user wraps their fist in a spiraling vortex of lightning and drives it into the target. The charge clings to them, so every hit that follows burns deeper for a short time.
data.battleDescription: Lightning spirals up %user's arm as they drive a crackling punch into %target, leaving them sparking with residual charge.

data.name: Divine Thunder Slap
data.description: The user claps their hands until they crackle with lightning, then delivers a thunderous open-palm slap. The charge lingers in their hands, making their next attacks hit harder.
data.battleDescription: Lightning gathers between %user's palms and breaks across %target in one ringing slap, leaving %user crackling with power.

data.name: Life reaver
data.description: Assault the opponents chakra and steal it for yourself
data.battleDescription: %user cloaks their hands in chakra, Then in one quick motion, they grasp %target and siphon their chakra

data.name: Fire Release
data.description: A Flaming lotus that wraps it selfs around the target
data.battleDescription: %user conjures a flicker flaming lotus of With a whispered chant, the lotus blossoms mid-air — and from it burst dozens of petal-like fragments that streak toward %target

data.name: Fist of 10 ,000 Volts
data.description: The user charges their fists with lightning chakra and hammers the target with crackling blows. The current lingers in their body, sapping their health, chakra and stamina over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user drives lightning-charged fists into %target, each blow sending a jolt through them that keeps draining their strength.

data.name: Infernal Combo
data.description: The user sets their fists ablaze and unleashes a furious combo of punches and kicks on the target. The flames cling to them afterwards, burning them over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: Flames roar along %user's limbs as they batter %target with a blazing chain of punches and kicks, leaving them burning.

data.name: Severed Pulse
data.description: The user slices a wave of chakra through the target's pulse, cutting off the flow that mends their body. For a short while their healing falters and non-elemental attacks strike them harder.
data.battleDescription: %user releases a cutting wave of chakra that severs the natural flow of recovery within %target. The disruption corrodes regenerative functions and breaks down their guard, amplifying the effect of incoming non-elemental attacks.

data.name: Debilitating Sword Strike
data.description:
The user charges their blade with lightning and drives it into the target. The surge flows back through the user, making all of their attacks hit harder for a short while.

DON'T TRAIN. ALREADY CAPPED. IT HAS NO POWER PER LEVEL
data.battleDescription: %user drives a lightning-charged blade into %target with explosive force, the surge crackling back through %user's own body.

data.name: Purgatory
data.description: The user ignites their limbs with fire chakra and unleashes a spiralling flurry of burning strikes that scorches every enemy in its path. The blaze keeps roaring through their body, making their attacks hit harder for a short time.
data.battleDescription: Flames burst from %user's fists and feet as they whirl through a spiral of strikes, the heat building with every blow.

data.name: Petal Nightmare
data.description: A mental tempest of razor-sharp petal blades that fills the target's thoughts with cutting and stabbing pain.
data.battleDescription: %user creates a myriad of razor-sharp petals floating around them, causing %target to hallucinate strange visions and nightmares.

data.name: Fractured Desire
data.description: Creates a burst of alluring shattered crystals, piercing the target causing bleeding and leaving them vulnerable to mind control.
data.battleDescription: %user moves with an enchanting fluidity, their steps accompanied by soft whispers of thunder and flickers of lightning that dance around them like sirens’ tendrils. Each graceful motion weaves an electrifying melody, luring the opponent into a trance-like state. Suddenly, with a burst of speed, %user unleashes sharp arcs of lightning that pierce the opponent, stunning them with searing precision. The surging currents disorient and immobilize the opponent, leaving them vulnerable, as if ensnared in the haunting embrace of a siren's deadly performance.

data.name: Crushing Abyss
data.description: A spiraling vortex traps and suffocates enemies in water.
data.battleDescription: %user performs a sequence of hand seals, summoning a surge of chakra-infused water that spirals into a menacing vortex. The vortex rushes forward, engulfing %target in a swirling aquatic prison.

data.name: Stardust
data.description: Calls down star-like dust that empowers the user while leaving the target more vulnerable and burning under later blows.
data.battleDescription: %user performs strange handseals, and with each seal a strange pattern appears on their body. As %user glows, small dust-like particles fall from the heavens, covering the battlefield.

data.name: Thunderbolt Spear
data.description: The user forges a dense spear of lightning and hurls it straight through the target's defenses. Leftover charge crackles over the user, throwing part of every hit they take back at the attacker until the charge fades.
data.battleDescription: %user forms a high-density spear of lightning chakra and hurls it toward %target, piercing their defenses with explosive speed. The charged impact lingers around %user in a crackling stream, causing a reactive backlash that reflects a portion of incoming attacks back at the attacker.

data.name: Void Pulse Barrage
data.description: A barrage of void pulses erupts from the ground, piercing the enemy and making them take more damage.
data.battleDescription: %user drives void chakra beneath the battlefield and a barrage of pulses erupts upward, tearing through every enemy's guard and leaving them exposed.

data.name: Thunderstrike Punch
data.description: The user channels a live current into their arm and lands a punch that detonates like a bolt from the sky. The charge keeps buzzing through the target, so later blows hurt them more until the current fades.
data.battleDescription: %user channels lightning chakra deep into their arm, the energy pulsing through their veins like a live current. With a sharp forward step and clenched knuckles, they unleash a thunderous punch that detonates against %target like a bolt from the sky. The force fractures defenses and shakes the body to its core, delivering overwhelming damage in a single strike.

data.name: Thunderclap Barrage
data.description: The user charges their weapon with storm chakra and unleashes a rapid series of crackling strikes on the target. A residual current lingers around the user, softening incoming attacks for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user floods their weapon with storm chakra and rains a rapid series of strikes on %target, the leftover current gathering around them like armor.

data.name: Prism
data.description: Channel the light from the sun to enlighten the battlefield
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes a blinding prism of light, striking %target dealing a devastating blow leaving them wounded.

data.name: Herald of the Black Night
data.description: A technique that covers the battlefield in a shadowy portal to the world of yokai.
data.battleDescription: %user clasps their hands in a praying motion as a shadowy mist flows from beneath them covering the entire battlefield.

bloodline.name: Night Parade of A Thousand Demons

data.name: Angra Mainyu: Blood Sovereignty
data.description: The crimson eyes awaken, radiating an oppressive aura of vampiric authority. Blood magic courses through her body, elevating her offensive power while placing a sinister curse upon her opponent, weakening their ability to inflict damage.
data.battleDescription: %user crimson eyes flare as a sinister aura engulfs her body. Blood-red energy surges through her veins, dark markings spreading across her skin.She thrusts her hand forward, unleashing a cursed wave that tears into %target, leaving crimson splashes across the battlefield as their strength withers beneath She oppressive presence.

data.name: Divine Pulse
data.description: A radiant energy pulse that boosts power and weakens the enemy.
data.battleDescription: %user releases a surge of divine energy, enhancing their strength while diminishing %target’s attack power.

data.name: Exploding Wood Serpent
data.description: Summon an exploding wooden serpent
data.battleDescription: %user creates a wooden statue, the eyes of the statue starts to glow as a wooden serpent starts wrapping itself around %target then explodes

data.name: Phoenix's Wrath Strike
data.description: The user channels fire chakra through their limbs like molten wings and drives a blazing strike into the target. The flames dig into the wound, scorching them again over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user channels fire chakra through their limbs, the aura shimmering like molten wings poised to strike. With a fierce step forward, they deliver a crushing blow that erupts on contact with %target, igniting not only flesh but the sinew beneath. Flames snake through %target’s muscles, digging deeper with every heartbeat and refusing to die out. As the embers cling to the wound, they keep searing %target in the rounds that follow.

data.name: Rei no Kata: Nukitsuke
data.description: The zeroth movement of Tenshin Shoden Yami-Ryu, the mind blade technique is used to conjure up purple blades of bright chakra.
data.battleDescription: Imperial chakra gathers around %user taking the shape of blades. The user takes a neutral stance preparing to attack or defend.

data.name: Volt Reaper
data.description: The user whips a lightning-charged limb across the target in a reaping arc. The discharge coils around the user like a second skin, making all their attacks strike harder for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user charges forward, lightning chakra crackling across their limbs in jagged, twitching arcs. With a sudden pivot, they slash their leg or arm across %target with blinding speed, the strike crackling on impact. As the chakra discharges, it doesn’t fade; instead, it coils around %user like a second skin.

data.name: Cosmic CataTism
data.description: The awakened Catboi ascends into full cosmic form, channeling galaxies and meows to bend the battlefield’s fate.
data.battleDescription: %user’s tail stretches into a beam of starlight as their pupils become pure nebulae. They float weightlessly, paws glowing, and the air trembles with soft meows and collapsed timelines. Empowered by their full Catboi form, they radiate cosmic dominance, strengthening themselves and overwhelming their foes with paradoxical force.

data.name: Electric Prison
data.description: The user traps the target in an illusory prison of blinding lightning that lashes the space around them. The phantom jolts stun whoever is caught inside, robbing them of action.
data.battleDescription: With a surge of chakra and a flicker of illusion, %user traps %target in a prison of blinding lightning. The phantom bolts lash at their senses, sending jolts of searing pain through their body. Overwhelmed by the crackling current, the target is left stunned as it locks down both body and mind.

data.name: Icebound Might
data.description: The wielder lets winter close over them like a second body. What it grips, it guards, and the cold it sheds sinks into their rival's every limb, dulling their blows before they land.
data.battleDescription: %user plants the trident and the cold closes over %user like armor, plate after plate of pale ice. The chill hangs heavy on every swing at %user, and the blows that land arrive dulled, only settling the frost.

data.name: Whirlwind Kick
data.description: The user spins into a gale-driven kick that tears through the target and the air close around them. Wind lingers in their joints and loosens their guard, so all attacks against them hit harder for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user channels wind chakra through their legs and launches into a fierce spin, kicking with the force of a gale. Wind spirals outward in a sharp arc, amplifying the velocity and reach of the strike. When the blow lands, the shock tears through %target’s balance and muscular control. Wind chakra lingers in the joints, loosening their ability to brace or defend.

data.name: Aqua Serpent Strike
data.description: A fluid, water-based taijutsu strike that lashes the target and leaves them more susceptible to damage.
data.battleDescription: %user channels water chakra through their limbs, shaping it into a sinuous, whip-like flow around their arm. With swift, coiling motion, they dart toward %target and unleash a fierce, fluid strike that lashes across flesh like a serpent breaking the surface. The impact disorients the enemy's defenses, soaking them in reactive chakra that lingers like venom, heightening the damage they suffer from subsequent attacks. The strike is silent, swift, and merciless, like the serpent it's named for.

data.name: Stormguard Retaliation
data.description: The user gathers volatile lightning and lashes it out at the target in a punishing surge. The charge flows back into the user, letting their attacks recover health for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user lets volatile lightning burst from their body into %target, the surge flowing back to feed %user's next blows.

data.name: Flash Kick
data.description: The user flashes across the field and lands in a storm of lightning-charged kicks. Every enemy around the landing spot is caught in the crackling flurry.
data.battleDescription: %user explodes forward in a storm of lightning-charged kicks, each strike cracking with blinding speed and power. The final roundhouse erupts in a flash of electricity, scattering a haze of sparks across the ground where %user lands.

data.name: Arcbound Vortex
data.description: The user slams a hand to the earth and a vortex of lightning surges up beneath the chosen spot. Enemies caught in it take lightning damage over the next few rounds and deal less damage while it lasts.
data.battleDescription: %user slams a hand to the ground and a spiraling vortex of lightning tears up through the earth, crackling around every enemy inside.

data.name: Midare
data.description: The user whirls into a relentless barrage of water-charged kunai that cut the target from every angle. Currents keep swirling around the user afterwards, turning part of each blow they take into health for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user hurls forward into a whirlwind of motion, striking %target with a rapid barrage of kunai infused with water chakra. Each slash and throw disrupts the opponent's rhythm while thin currents of chakra swirl around %user’s body. With every movement, the surrounding moisture condenses into a protective flow, allowing them to turn some of the damage from incoming attacks into health.

data.name: Demons Strike
data.description: Call down a powerful storm strike on an area while raising a temporary shield around yourself.
data.battleDescription: as the storm rages on,  %user calls upon the power of the storm, forming a fearsome lightning strike from within the clouds. The demonic lightning descends with tremendous speed and force, crashing into %target with overwhelming power.

data.name: Storm's Lullaby
data.description: Surrounds an ally with cleansing thunder that removes harmful effects and forms a protective lightning shield.
data.battleDescription: As %user channels their chakra, cleansing thunder rolls around %target, stripping away harmful effects before settling into a crackling protective shield.

data.name: Primate Assimilate
data.description: The user takes on the hardy instincts of a primate, letting their body soak up punishment. For a short time, part of the damage they take is turned into health.

effects.description: Absorb damage taken & convert to health, chakra or stamina

data.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra, performing the Primate Assimilate jutsu. Through this technique, %user takes on the hardy instincts of a primate, gaining the power to absorb the force of their opponents' attacks and turn it into health. The primal strength rising within %user grows with every blow they endure.

data.name: Lightning Release: Thunder Edge
data.description: Lightning Release: Thunder Edge is a versatile jutsu that allows the user to infuse their weapon with lightning chakra and drive it into the ground. The charge erupts around the target in a surge of electrical energy that stuns anything caught in it over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user releases a surge of electrical chakra through their blade and strikes the ground. The current races out from the blade, crackling across the surrounding ground and wrapping itself around %target.

data.name: Founder’s Wrath
data.description: Unleashes a massive attack by harnessing the origins of chakra.
data.battleDescription: Drawing on the very origins of chakra, %user begins to chant an ancient incantation, their voice resonating with the primordial energy of creation. The ground trembles as elemental forces converge around %user—fire, water, earth, and lightning swirl into a tempest of raw power. With a final, commanding gesture, %user unleashes this elemental fury upon %target. The combined elements strike with devastating force, engulfing %target in a catastrophic storm that obliterates everything in its path. The sheer magnitude of the attack showcases the true power of the Heavenly Founder's legacy.

data.name: Infernal Mirage
data.description: The user casts the target into an illusion of a burning hellscape that scorches their mind. The torment leaves them shaken and exposed, so they take more damage from every attack for a short time.
data.battleDescription: The user executes a sequence of fluid hand seals, projecting %target into an intense illusion of a hellish landscape. The burning terrain pulses with psychological torment, disorienting the target’s perception and leaving them increasingly exposed to every attack that follows. The more they struggle, the deeper the illusion claws into their mind.

data.name: Lightning Release: Stormcaller Whip
data.description: The user forms a whip of pure lightning and lashes the target from a distance. A retaliatory charge clings to them, so their own attacks shock them back for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user lashes %target with a whip of crackling lightning, leaving a charge that bites back whenever they strike.

data.name: Mind Flay
data.description: The user locks eyes with the target and tears through their mind with visions of shattering bone. The terror they sow feeds the user's focus, making their attacks hit harder for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user locks eyes with %target and floods their mind with phantom agony, drawing fresh strength from the fear that follows.

data.name: Breeze Guardian Shield
data.description: Summon a protective wall of wind and dust
data.battleDescription: Using a series of hand seals %user crafts a formidable wall of swirling wind and dust. As %user stands behind the wall, they are protected from harm, deflecting incoming attacks and reflecting damage back at the attacker.

data.name: Eroding Current
data.description: The user sends a torrent surging up from the ground across an area, battering enemies over the next few rounds. The current wears down their guard, so other attacks hit them harder as well.
data.battleDescription: %user channels water chakra into the ground, summoning a sudden upward torrent across the area. The relentless pressure of the surge breaks the footing of anyone caught in it and erodes their guard, amplifying the impact of future attacks.

data.name: Lightning Release: Raijin's Bow
data.description: Raijin's Bow is a powerful lightning-based jutsu that manifests as a bow made of crackling electricity. It allows the user to create and shoot arrows infused with lightning, dealing devastating damage to their target, and the charge lingers in their hands to strengthen their attacks for a short time.
data.battleDescription: With a swift, intricate hand seal, %user channels their lightning chakra, shaping it into a dazzling bow crackling with raw energy. Nocking an arrow of pure electricity, they draw and release, sending the charged projectile streaking toward %target. The arrow explodes on impact in a blinding flash and deafening thunderclap, unleashing a torrent of lightning that engulfs %target in a devastating storm of electricity.

data.name: Kaze Kama
data.description: The user shapes compressed wind into a curved blade and sends it slicing into the target. The wind keeps circling the user afterwards, letting them heal from part of the damage they deal for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user conjures a crescent blade of wind and flings it at %target, the gusts curling back to mend %user with each blow that follows.

data.name: Soul Shackles
data.description: A cursed chakra technique that deals direct damage by tearing through the enemy’s spirit.
data.battleDescription: %user conjures cursed chakra chains and hurls them at %target. Upon contact, the chains pierce through physical defenses and latch onto the target’s spirit, delivering a crushing blow to their core. The pain is sharp and sudden, striking deeper than the flesh and rattling their chakra from within.

data.name: Stone of the Withering
data.description: The user hurls a withered shard of compacted earth that cracks against the target. The shard's hunger passes into the user, letting their attacks draw back health for a time.
data.battleDescription: %user hurls a cursed shard of compacted earth chakra at %target. The impact disrupts their vitality and awakens a latent siphoning effect within the caster, allowing them to absorb health from their next damaging attacks.

data.name: Aqua Barrier
data.description: A protective water shield that boosts attack and defense.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a swirling barrier of water, dampening incoming attacks while empowering their own strikes.

data.name: Riptide Kick
data.description: The user spins a vortex of water around their leg and drives it into the target like a riptide. The current then lingers around them, converting some of the damage they take back into health for a short while.
data.battleDescription: Water swirls around %user's leg as they leap and crash a riptide kick into %target, the current curling back to cloak them.

data.name: Skyfang Burst
data.description: Unleashes a massive attack by harnessing the origins of chakra.
data.battleDescription: %user bursts forward in a controlled surge of movement, slipping along an unexpected angle before driving a reinforced strike through %target’s guard.  Draconic pressure concentrates at the point of contact, piercing their defenses as %user flows past them in the same motion. Luminous scales of condensed chakra form along %user’s frame, fortifying their defense as they reposition to superior ground.

data.name: Aqua Fang
data.description: A precise water-based strike that deals damage and boosts the user’s offensive power.
data.battleDescription: %user darts forward and slashes with a weapon wreathed in jagged water chakra, striking %target with a snapping surge. As the attack lands, streams of chakra coil around their body, heightening the force behind their next assaults.

data.name: Gale Blade
data.description: A slicing wind attack that deals damage and boosts the user’s damage output.
data.battleDescription: %user channels slicing wind chakra into their blade and launches a swift slash at %target. The strike tears forward with precision, empowering the user’s next attacks as wind gathers around their form in a flowing spiral of energy.

data.name: Aqua Fist
data.description: Forms hardened water around the fists for devastating punches. Afterwards the water flows back over the user, strengthening their healing for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user's fists, surrounded by swirling, hardened water, unleash a barrage of punches at %target, each strike hitting with the force of crashing waves, before the water flows back over %user and strengthens their healing.

data.name: San no Kata: Yasakani
data.description: The hidden third movement of Tenshin Shoden Yami-Ryu, it is the awakening of the most basic principle taught in school: Mediation.
data.battleDescription: With senses honed and heightened to their peak, %user is able to enter a deep meditative state, their purple chakra flowing from their body freely, bolstering their defense. Then, before anyone can react, an unblockable slash rends across %target

data.name: Heavenly Barrier

data.description: A  devastating strike that cuts through both body and spirit.
data.battleDescription: %user steps in with disciplined precision and drives a chakra-infused strike into %target.  At the moment of impact, a radiant draconic sigil flashes between them, tracing the structure of %target’s active enhancements. Celestial currents rise and mirror that power before descending into %user, manifesting the same amplified force within their aura.

data.name: Soul Laceration Mirage
data.description: The user conjures a dark illusion that shreds the target's mind. The spiritual backlash coils around the user as a brief ward against harmful effects.
data.battleDescription: %user conjures a dark illusion that claws through %target’s mind. As the mirage tears into its victim, the released spiritual force coils around %user as a brief ward against debilitating effects.

data.name: Star Realignment
data.description: Using long since forgotten constellations, the Celestial Mage binds their enemy in the radiant force and rewrites the fate of the enemy.
data.battleDescription: %user traces a shattered constellation in the air, forcing %target’s fate into the path the heavens intended. Starlight snaps into place around them like invisible chains. Their strength falters, their magic stutters, and their destiny is rewritten mid-breath followed by a cold surge of astral force that tears through body and spirit alike.

data.name: Lightning Flash Step
data.description: The user flashes to a new position in a burst of lightning, unleashing strikes that pierce any guard across the area around their landing point. The shocks linger, hurting anyone struck again over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user surrounds themselves with lightning chakra, flashing to a new position at blinding speed and delivering rapid, precise strikes from all angles that tear through any guard.

data.name: Strike: Raijin
data.description: The culmination of your Bloodline limit, you create thunderclouds above the battlefield that rain down lightning indiscriminately, destroying everything.
data.battleDescription: %user summons up thunderclouds in the sky, charging their body with chakra, they disappear from the field of battle and strike down from the heavens on %target

data.name: Thunder Shockwave
data.description: A concussive burst of lightning that strikes hard and leaves the enemy paralyzed.
data.battleDescription: %user slams their palm to the ground, unleashing a booming pulse of lightning chakra that radiates in all directions. The blast cracks the earth and engulfs %target in a sudden shockwave, paralyzing their muscles mid-motion as the electric surge locks their body in place.

data.name: Stormguard Aura
data.description: A defensive technique that envelops the user in a protective aura of electricity, deflecting attacks and boosting their resistance to damage.
data.battleDescription: %user creates a shimmering Stormguard Aura of crackling electricity, dispersing incoming attacks while enhancing their resilience, allowing them to endure prolonged combat with unwavering strength.

data.name: Water Release: Whirlpool Water Blade
data.description: The user spins inside a whirlpool of water chakra, hiding kunai in the current before flinging the whole vortex at the target. The momentum of the spin carries into the user's next attacks, making them hit harder for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user twirls a whirlpool of water chakra laced with hidden kunai and hurls the spinning blades at %target.

data.name: Phantom Requiem
data.description: The user calls up a ghostly mist that strikes the target and seeps into their body. Over the next few rounds it bleeds away their health, chakra and stamina.
data.battleDescription: %user forms a seal, summoning a ghostly mist that seeps into %target’s body. Wisps of blue and red energy, chakra and stamina along with their very life, are ripped from them, spiraling away into the mist. %target’s limbs grow heavy, their strength fading as exhaustion takes hold. If they don’t break free, they’ll collapse under the relentless drain.

data.name: Star Guardians
data.description: Called down from the stars above, Star Guardians protect their Celestial Mage while reflecting attacks back to the enemy.
data.battleDescription: %user lifts her gaze to the fractured heavens, and the dying star in her chest answers with a silent pulse. From the night spill living constellations, tall figures forged of cold starlight, bound by forgotten orbits. They strike at %target with radiant force, and when blades or spells fall upon them, the light bends, turns, and returns the violence to its source.

data.name: Bedrock Stance
data.description: The user roots themselves to the earth and draws its strength up through their body. For a short time they shrug off blows like bedrock and their taijutsu lands harder.
data.battleDescription: %user sinks into a low stance as the ground hardens beneath them, their body turning stone-steady and their fists heavy.

data.name: Shrapnel Clone Barrage
data.description:
The user sends a wave of clones rushing into the fray, each one bursting into chakra shrapnel on impact. The embedded fragments keep tearing at everyone caught in the blast over the next few rounds.

DON'T TRAIN. ALREADY CAPPED. IT HAS NO POWER PER LEVEL
data.battleDescription: %user sends a wave of clones charging at %target, and they detonate in a storm of chakra shrapnel that buries itself in everyone nearby.

data.name: Lux
data.description: An orb of light that explodes upon impact.
data.battleDescription: %user creates an orb in the palm of one hand. Within the orb, small lights of multiple colors begin to form. As the orb grows, the lights brighten until four translucent rings appear around it. In an instant, %user appears in front of %target and strikes them in the chest with the orb. Upon impact, the orb explodes, and the translucent rings begin to tear %target apart.

data.name: Veil of Shadows
data.description: The user draws a veil of living shadow across the field, and its formless shapes lash at the target. The veil then settles over the user, turning part of the damage they take into health for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user forms a slow, deliberate seal as an ominous haze spreads through the air, cloaking the battlefield in spectral mist. %target’s vision darkens as they’re pulled into an illusion where formless shadows lash out with invisible strikes. As the veil settles, a portion of every blow aimed at the user loops back to reinforce their health.

data.name: Marshmallow Blitz Bomb
data.description: Teni pulls out a bag of marshmallows from her pocket and tears it open with her teeth. Tossing them into the air, they rain down on the opponent, with each explosion feeling larger than the last. The opponent is covered in sweet, melted marshmallow goo which burns and damages them.
data.battleDescription: With a wild grin, %user tears open a bag of marshmallows and tosses them skyward. As they rain down, each marshmallow detonates in a fiery explosion, covering the %target in molten, sticky goo. The goo burns fiercely, causing intense damage and leaving the opponent immobilized and scorched.

data.name: Void Gaze Rift
data.description: A devastating strike that cuts through both body and spirit.
data.battleDescription: %user focuses their energy, and a dark aura begins to surround them. With a swift and decisive movement, they launch a blade of pure ethereal energy toward %target. This blade cuts through physical defenses like paper, but its true power lies in its ability to sever the connection between body and spirit. %target feels a cold, numbing pain as their very soul is sliced, leaving them disoriented, weakened, and vulnerable to further attacks. The wound left by this strike lingers, disrupting %target's chakra flow and making it difficult to recover.

data.name: summontester
data.description: Fireball like jutsu
data.battleDescription: %user activates sage mode and now has access to all Senjutsu

data.name: Gaia's Wrath
data.description: The user shapes a massive hammer of earthen chakra and brings it down on the target with the weight of the land. Stone dust settles over the user like a thin crust of armor, slightly softening incoming blows for a brief spell.
data.battleDescription: %user jumps high into the air and draws a long pole. As %user reaches the peak of their jump they start to channel incredible amounts of earthen chakra into the end of the pole to form a huge hammer of natural elements. Mere moments later, %user comes down with the weight of the earth and devastates %target with massive force.

data.name: Inferno Cataclysm
data.description: Unleashes a devastating explosion
data.battleDescription: Battle Description: %user channels the destructive power of their Bakuhatsu bloodline, their body surging with intense heat as the air around them distorts from the sheer energy. With a focused shout, %user slams their hands into the ground, causing the earth to tremble and crack. From the fissures erupts a cataclysmic explosion

data.name: Quicksand Trap
data.description: The user casts an illusion of the ground collapsing into churning quicksand that drags down every enemy in the area. Standing calm above the mirage, the user shrugs off part of the damage they take for a short time.
data.battleDescription: The user calmly weaves a deceptive genjutsu, casting the illusion of the ground collapsing beneath the enemy into a churning pit of quicksand. Within the mirage, the sands twist and coil, dragging the target downward as invisible pressure grinds at their body and mind. Their perception of movement slows, their senses dulled by the crushing despair. Meanwhile, the user gains a protective clarity, their awareness sharpened against oncoming attacks. The result is a mirage that defends the caster while eroding the will and health of the target.

data.name: Stone Hammer Kick
data.description: The user brings a stone-hard heel down like a falling slab, sending a shockwave through every enemy in the area. Shards of hardened chakra cling to the user afterwards, dulling the blows they take for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user reinforces their leg with dense earth chakra, then launches into a spinning downward kick that slams into %target like a falling slab of stone. Upon impact, shockwaves ripple through the ground, and fragments of hardened chakra recoil around %user’s body. These chakra shards linger like a shell, bracing against impact and dulling incoming attacks.

data.name: Kinetic Nova
data.description: A blast of explosive chakra that disrupts all other chakra in the area
data.battleDescription: %user condenses their chakra into a ball, flinging it at %target which explodes showering the area in the tiny explosions. %target soon realizes that its very hard to gather mold their elemental chakra.

data.name: Stone Skipping
data.description: The user skims chakra-weighted stones low across the ground so they bounce into the target in quick succession. The battering leaves them off balance, so the blows that follow land harder for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user channels chakra into a handful of flat stones, enhancing their mass and speed. With a precise flick of the wrist, the stones launch forward, skipping across the ground and striking %target with successive, chakra-infused impacts. Each bounce amplifies the force, turning a simple motion into a relentless barrage.

data.name: Tectonic Stomp
data.description: The user stamps the ground to raise a wall of stone behind the target, then smashes them through it. The impact rattles them, softening their attacks over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user stamps the earth to throw up a stone wall behind %target, then sends them crashing through it with a crushing blow.

data.name: Boulder Crush
