data.description: A brutal earth strike that smashes the enemy and dulls their offensive strength.
data.battleDescription: %user channels earth chakra into a massive boulder that launches toward %target, crushing them under its sheer weight. The impact disrupts their balance and chakra output, sharply reducing the damage they can inflict afterward.

data.name: Boulder Barrage
data.description: The user tears massive boulders from the earth and hurls them at the target in a crushing barrage. The leftover stone gathers around the user as a shield that soaks up blows for a brief spell.
data.battleDescription: %user rips a series of boulders from the ground and hurls them at %target, keeping the last of the stone close as a shield.

data.name: Stonebreaker Strike
data.description: The user roots their stance and drives an earth-laden fist through the target hard enough to crack the ground. The shock lingers in their body, so every blow that follows lands harder while the tremor lasts.
data.battleDescription: %user roots themselves to the ground, channeling dense earth chakra through their body and into their strike. With a sudden forward step, they deliver a crushing blow aimed at breaking not just %target, but the terrain itself. The sheer force of the attack sends a deep shockwave through the ground, cracking stone and rupturing the earth beneath their feet.

data.name: Quicksand Mirages
data.description: The user bends the target's mind until the ground seems to swallow them, the illusion striking at their senses. Panic grips them as they sink, weakening their attacks for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user bends the mind of %target and creates an illusion of them sinking into quicksand. The feeling is real as their body sinks into the sand, and they can feel it getting stuck under the pressure as they fall into a state of panic.

data.name: Earth Style: Shattering Kick
data.description: The user plants their weight and drives an earth-charged kick upward into the target. The ground cracks beneath their heel as the blow lands with crushing force.
data.battleDescription: %user drops low and plants their weight before delivering a crushing upward kick infused with earth chakra. The ground beneath their foot cracks as force surges through the strike, slamming into %target with seismic impact. The blow drives deep into their body, the earth chakra hammering home with the weight of the land itself.

data.name: Earth Release: Boulder Crush
data.description:
he user lifts a massive boulder infused with earth chakra and slams it down onto the target, causing heavy damage.

DON'T TRAIN. ALREADY CAPPED. IT HAS NO POWER PER LEVEL
data.battleDescription: %user channels Earth Release chakra, summoning a colossal boulder above %target. With a commanding motion, they hurl it downward, shattering it on impact and bombarding %target with debris. The force of the crash creates a shockwave, leaving %target staggered and exposed.

data.name: Stone Warden
data.description: The user conjures an illusion of an ancient stone guardian that crashes down upon the target. Its looming presence weighs on their mind, so their attacks deal less damage for a short time.
data.battleDescription: A towering illusion of an ancient stone guardian erupts from the battlefield, crashing down upon %target with terrifying force. The overwhelming presence of the Stone Warden fractures their focus, dulling the force behind every attack they make. The enemy is left mentally burdened and less capable of mounting an effective counterattack.

data.name: Decapitating Slash
data.description: The user steps in and carves a wide, ruthless arc at the target's neck. The slash leaves them reeling, so every attack against them lands harder until they recover.
data.battleDescription: %user steps in and unleashes a wide, arcing slash at %target, breaking open their guard.

data.name: Tidal Slice
data.description: The user pivots and sweeps a blade of pressurized water through the target. The surge wraps around the user as it recedes, softening the hits they take for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user pivots swiftly and releases a sweeping arc of reinforced water chakra that tears into %target. As the surge crashes forward, a protective layer of water pressure envelops the user’s body, softening incoming attacks.

data.name: Wind Cutter
data.description: A high-speed wind slash that carves through the area around the target, dealing heavy damage and draining health, chakra and stamina over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user blurs forward in a burst of wind, slashing through %target with razor-sharp wind chakra. The cutting force is so intense it leaves a trail of cleaved air behind, carving across the surrounding ground and draining the strength of all it cuts.

data.name: Suijin Gir
data.description: The user dashes in with a slash of high-pressure water that bursts against the target. The crashing current leaves them off balance, so they take more damage from every source over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user dashes in with a swift slash imbued with high-pressure water, striking %target with explosive force. The slicing current crashes through defenses, leaving the enemy off balance and more susceptible to every follow-up attack.

data.name: Blazing Slash
data.description: The user ignites their weapon with a touch and releases a fiery arc that scorches the target. The searing cut resists healing for a short while.
data.battleDescription: With a quick touch, %user sets their weapon ablaze and descends on %target, releasing a fiery arc that scorches them on contact.

data.name: Iaido
data.description: A single, decisive katana strike that channels the user’s spirit into a devastating blow.
data.battleDescription: With a calm breath, %user draws their katana with a swift, fluid motion. The blade hums with spiritual force as the strike cuts through %target’s body and essence, leaving a lingering aura of power before the blade is sheathed again.

data.name: Shadow Dance
data.description: A mesmerizing spectacle unfolds as the wielder's weapon becomes an integral part of their very essence. This intricate choreography of combat seamlessly melds martial finesse with the power of the Shadow Weaver bloodline.
data.battleDescription: %user's weapon becomes an extension of their body as they engage in a mesmerizing dance of combat. With swift, rhythmic movements, %user strikes and slashes, each motion releasing bursts of shadow energy that cascade toward %target, inflicting a series of rapid and devastating blows. The seamless fusion of %user's mastery over shadows and their weapon creates a captivating and lethal performance on the battlefield.

data.name: Wave Cleaver
data.description: The user swings their weapon in a wide arc and releases a cleaving wave of water that crashes over the target and the ground around them. Everything it batters stays soaked and reeling, taking extra damage from every hit for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user swings their weapon in a wide arc, releasing a massive surge of compressed water chakra that rips toward %target. The cutting wave crashes forward like a tidal blade, delivering overwhelming force in a single sweeping motion.

data.name: Flame Crescent Slash
data.description: The user sweeps their blade through a wide arc, releasing a crescent of flame at the target. The fire leaves them scorched, so every hit they take burns hotter for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user channels intense fire chakra into their blade and unleashes a wide, flaming arc aimed directly at %target. The searing crescent tears across the battlefield in a blazing trail, striking with devastating force and leaving a charred path in its wake.

data.name: Harmonious Slash
data.description: A perfectly timed strike to punish the opponent
data.battleDescription: %user stands motionless, patiently reading %target’s attack. At the perfect instant, they strike, blade flashing, cutting through and reflecting the force back, punishing %target with their own power.

data.name: Rending Slash
data.description: The user carves a deep, ragged slash across the target with a vicious draw of the blade. The wound keeps tearing open, dealing further damage over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user rips a vicious slash across %target, leaving a ragged wound that keeps bleeding.

data.name: Crescent  Reaper Fang
data.description: A high-speed weapon slash that deals massive damage to the target and briefly blocks every attempt to cleanse their ailments.
data.battleDescription: %user grips their weapon with both hands and crouches low before vanishing in a flash of speed. A single arc slices through the air past %target, and for a heartbeat, nothing happens. Then a diagonal wound bursts open across their body, blood spraying as if the strike had been delayed in time. But the real sting comes after: the wound lingers in %target's chakra and refuses every attempt to cleanse it, as if their body is punishing them for moving too soon.

data.name: Brandish Flames
data.description: The user wreathes their sword in fire chakra and cuts a blazing path across the target. The burns keep eating away at their health over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: Fire chakra engulfs %user's blade as they carve a searing arc across %target, leaving burns that keep eating at them.

data.name: Shadow Dance NEW
data.description: A mesmerizing spectacle unfolds as the wielder's weapon becomes an integral part of their very essence
data.battleDescription: A mesmerizing spectacle unfolds as the wielder's weapon becomes an integral part of their very essence

data.name: Inferno Slash
data.description: A fiery slash that deals damage and makes the enemy more vulnerable to future attacks.
data.battleDescription: %user channels blazing fire chakra into their weapon and slashes at %target in a wide arc. The strike erupts on contact, searing through defenses and leaving behind scorching embers that increase the damage the target will take from future attacks.

data.name: Summoning: Jade
data.description: Summon a beautiful but fierce warrior to the battlefield
data.battleDescription: %user creates a cocoon made of crystal, out of it a beautiful warrior appears

data.name: Kōsai Shippū
data.description: Enhances speed and generates crystal-laced shockwaves.
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes crystal shockwaves at %target, striking with speed and recoiling damage.

data.name: Crystal Sphere
data.description: Create a Sphere in which you protect yourself from all damage
data.battleDescription: %user encases themselves in a sphere made of pure crystal

data.name: Crystal Cave
data.description: Surround your opponent with a crystal cave that damages them, leaves them vulnerable, and reflects incoming attacks.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a cave of jagged crystals around %target, impaling them and leaving them vulnerable as the crystal walls reflect incoming attacks.

data.name: Shippūgeki
data.description: The user whips up a spiraling gale of cutting winds that tears through every enemy in its path. The surge of speed carries on through the user, making their attacks hit harder for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes a spiraling storm of razor winds across the field, the gale feeding back into their own strength.

data.name: Cyclone Shredder
data.description: The user releases a spiraling vortex of bladed wind that shreds the target and everything around them. Every enemy caught in the storm is left raw, so the blows that follow hurt more for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user looses a roaring vortex of slicing wind at %target, shredding the ground and every enemy caught in its spin.

data.name: Acidic Permeation
data.description: The user hurls seal-made pellets that burst into a cloud of acid around the target. The particles eat into their armor, leaving them more vulnerable to damage for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user flicks a handful of acid-filled pellets at %target, and as they burst the fine mist seeps through their defenses.

data.name: Wind Dance
data.description: The user dances within circling currents of wind that cushion incoming blows. The flowing air sharpens their movements, raising their offense and defense for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user whirls into a graceful dance, swift currents circling their body to cushion blows and sharpen every movement.

data.name: Thorn Grasp
data.description: The user calls up thorny vines that coil around the target and puncture deep. The wounds leave them exposed, so follow-up attacks hit harder for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user summons spiked vines that wrap around %target, puncturing them and leaving their defenses exposed.

data.name: Pressure Damage
data.description: The user compresses a tornado of wind into a dense mass and releases it on the target, punching through any guard. The pressure leaves them reeling, so each later hit carries extra damage for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user crushes a roaring tornado into a dense sphere of air and unleashes it on %target, the blast ripping straight through their defenses.

data.name: Ignition Kick
data.description: This technique focuses on utilizing fire elemental chakra on the leg to erupt in fire as it makes contact with the opponent. The flames keep burning afterward, draining their health over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user channels fire chakra into their leg, delivering a swift roundhouse kick to %target. The impact erupts in a burst of flames, scorching %target and leaving them burning.

data.name: Earth Release: Stone Fist Strike
data.description: A hardened earth-infused punch that deals damage and weakens the enemy’s offensive output.
data.battleDescription: %user reinforces their arm with dense earth chakra before launching a crushing punch into %target's core. The impact echoes like stone slamming into steel, rocking the opponent and disrupting their ability to channel power. The force of the strike not only causes direct physical damage but saps their offensive momentum, reducing the strength of their follow-up attacks.

data.name: Zephyr’s Judgment
data.description: This technique has been passed down by several ninja of old times. By achieving control of the wind nature, the user subjugates the winds around their fists and legs, and every blow leaves a miniature cyclone at the point of impact that keeps cutting at the target over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user enters a wind-infused trance and unleashes a blur of strikes on %target. Each rapid punch and kick leaves a miniature cyclone spinning at the point of impact, shredding at %target long after the blow lands.

data.name: Summoning: Lord Pengu
data.description: The people of Hyorin have cohabitated with the Ancient Penguins and have earned the favor of Lord Pengu, who answers the user's call and fights at their side for several rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user pricks their finger and slams their hand to the ground. A cold mist swirls before condensing into a crowned penguin.

data.name: Mizushibari
data.description: A water-based strike that crushes the enemy, then coils around the user to turn part of the damage they take into health.
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes a burst of high-pressure water that lashes out toward %target, striking with force before swirling around their own body. The lingering vortex hardens like fluid armor, drinking in a portion of the damage from the attacks that follow and turning it into health.

data.name: Majestic Flame
data.description: A spiraling blaze of fire chakra that scorches the area around the target. Everything it engulfs is left smoldering, so the hits that follow burn deeper.
data.battleDescription: %user channels refined fire chakra into a spiraling blaze that engulfs %target. The scorching flames sweep the surrounding ground and leave everything they touch smoldering, so each hit that follows burns deeper.

data.name: Blazing Reprisal
data.description: The user wreathes the target in clinging flames that make every later hit burn deeper. The fire also feeds the user, letting their own attacks draw back life over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user sets %target smoldering in a ring of fire, the embers curling back to mend %user with each blow that follows.

data.name: Tempestual Fury
data.description: Tempestual Fury is a wind-element Ninjutsu that summons a devastating storm of immense size and power. Its winds leave everything they batter raw, so the hits that follow strike harder for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a raging tempest, its ferocious winds slamming into %target and scouring the ground around them with relentless force.

data.name: Quaking Earth Strike
data.description: The user smashes the earth so the ground quakes and shatters across the area around the target. The tremors break the footing of anything caught in them, leaving it open to more damage for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user smashes the earth, sending shockwaves rippling through the ground around %target and weakening their defenses against further attacks.

data.name: Medusa's Gaze
data.description: A mythical genjutsu in which the user channels the power of Medusa, their eyes turning a cold serpent yellow. For a short time every attack they make strikes harder, and the blows against them land softer.
data.battleDescription: %user closes their eyes and gathers chakra as the air grows still around them. When the lids lift, a cold serpent's stare looks out, and Medusa's power floods through %user, strengthening every strike and blunting the blows that come for them.

data.name: Lightning Ward
data.description: Envelops the user's weapon in lightning, strengthening their Lightning attacks and leaving the target vulnerable to all further attacks for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user surrounds their weapon with crackling lightning, empowering their Lightning techniques before marking %target with a jolt of electricity that leaves them vulnerable to further attacks.

data.name: Lightning Blitz Strike
data.description: The user channels lightning chakra into their limbs to deliver a swift series of electrifying taijutsu strikes.
data.battleDescription: %user charges their limbs with crackling lightning and delivers a rapid series of electrifying blows to %target.

data.name: Inner Flame
data.description: A fiery aura that shields the user against incoming blows. Through methods few understand, it also turns part of the damage they take into renewed energy.
data.battleDescription: %user ignites their inner fire, reducing the force of incoming blows and using the energy to replenish and reinforce themselves.

data.name: Inferno Cyclone
data.description: The user raises a spinning column of fire around the target. The blaze leaves them smoldering, so each blow they take over the next few rounds burns deeper.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a blazing cyclone, engulfing %target in flames that leave them smoldering against the blows to come.

data.name: Ice Vortex
data.description: The user conjures a freezing polar vortex that engulfs the target and the ground around them. The bitter cold numbs whoever it catches, so their attacks deal less damage for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user conjures a raging vortex of ice, engulfing %target in relentless, churning frost.

data.name: Hurricane Strike
data.description: The user spins into a wind-charged kick that bursts into a gale around the target, battering everything caught in the blast. The momentum carries through the user's body, raising their strength, speed, taijutsu and bukijutsu for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user channels wind chakra into their leg, executing a spinning kick that generates a powerful gust, striking %target with force as the gale tears across the surrounding ground.

data.name: Harden Fist
data.description: A taijutsu technique that hardens the user's body to blunt incoming blows and boost their striking power for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user tightens their stance, chakra flowing into their limbs until the muscle fibers tense like steel cables. A faint aura pulses around their fists, dense, controlled, and brimming with suppressed force. Harden Fist enhances the body at its core, toughening it against incoming blows while reinforcing every strike with hardened impact. The result is a sharper, more brutal form of taijutsu, each blow landing with enhanced precision and punishing force. It is not just about hitting harder; it is about becoming a weapon in motion.

data.name: Flame Infusion
data.description: A burning taijutsu attack that damages the enemy and weakens their stats for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user drives a flame-laced strike into %target, searing flesh and spirit alike, leaving their strength smoldering in ruin.

data.name: First Chakra Gate
data.description: Unlocks the user's chakra flow, making all of their attacks hit harder while the surging energy dulls the damage they take for a short time.
data.battleDescription: A deep roar echoes from within as %user tears open the first chakra gate. Their aura erupts in a violent surge of energy, rippling through the air like a heatwave. Veins glow beneath their skin as raw chakra floods their network, amplifying every movement and sharpening their control. The ground beneath them fractures under the pressure, and the battlefield trembles as their techniques flare with newfound ferocity, faster, heavier, and more destructive than before, while the surging aura dulls every blow that reaches them.

data.name: Fire Fist
data.description: Ignites the user's fist for a strike that releases a burst of fire, scorching the target and the ground around them.
data.battleDescription: With a focused burst of chakra, %user ignites their fist in roaring flames. The strike releases a fiery shockwave that scorches %target and the ground around them.

data.name: Eight Fist Style: Earthen Grasp
data.description: Eight Fist Style: Earthen Grasp is a taijutsu technique that focuses on immobilizing the opponent. Its earth-charged blows call stone hands from the ground that can root the target in place for a moment.
data.battleDescription: %user channels Earth Release chakra into their fists, delivering a barrage of strikes that causes the ground to erupt. Earthen hands emerge and seize %target's legs. %user finishes with a crushing kick, sending %target to the ground, where the earthen hands may keep them from moving.

data.name: Earthquake Slam
data.description: The user channels earth chakra to deliver a powerful Earthquake Slam, causing the ground to shake upon impact with the target. The force of the quake surges into the user's own strikes, making them hit harder for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user's decisive slam sends shockwaves through the ground beneath %target, and the earth's power answers %user, loading their next strikes with greater force.

data.name: Burning Coil
data.description: Blazing coils of fire wrap around the target and scorch them. The seared skin leaves them vulnerable, so they take more damage for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user summons blazing coils of fire that wrap around %target, searing their skin and leaving them vulnerable to further damage.

data.name: Blazing Flash
data.description: Envelops the user in flames to dash across the field with explosive speed and erupt in fire where they land, scorching every enemy caught in the blast. The blaze lingers around the user, making their attacks hit harder for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user focuses their chakra, igniting flames that swirl around their body. With a sudden burst of energy, they propel themselves forward at blinding speed, leaving a trail of fire in their wake. The intense heat generated by their movement scorches the ground and air, making their path difficult to follow. As %user moves, the flames around them roar and grow, turning their rapid dashes into fiery streaks that sear anything they touch. The final strike comes when %user reaches their destination, the flames concentrating into a devastating kick or punch that sends a wave of fire bursting across the surrounding ground. The battlefield is left smoldering, with %user standing amidst the remnants of their fiery dash, the flames still roaring around their fists.

data.name: Sealing Technique: Lotus Barrier
data.description: Creates a barrier of chakra that takes the shape of a lotus around the target, blocking all of their summoning. The glowing petals weigh on them as well, so their attacks deal less damage for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user slams their palm to the ground, releasing a bloom of glowing lotus-shaped seals that spread outward in a perfect circle. The lotus petals rise upward, forming a radiant, semi-transparent barrier of light around %target, sealing away their summons and weighing down every strike they throw.

data.name: Leviathan's Embrace
data.description: A devastating water-taijutsu strike that siphons vitality from the enemy, feeding the user with every impact.
data.battleDescription: %user channels the wrath of the deep as water chakra surges down their spine and coils around their limbs like serpents from the abyss. With a chilling calm, they square up to %target and drive their fist forward, unleashing a crushing blow that echoes with the pressure of the ocean floor. The strike erupts in a spiral of black-blue water, tearing through defenses and drawing life essence back into %user like a drowning tide claiming its own. Each hit binds them deeper to the flow of %target's chakra, feeding life back into their body as they press on like the relentless sea.

data.name: Eight Fist Style: Lotus Dance
data.description: The user drops into a low, still stance before detonating into eight rapid strikes in perfect rhythm, each landing with surgical precision. The relentless barrage shatters the target's guard and seals them off from any buffs for a moment.
data.battleDescription: %user's stance drops low, tense and almost still, then detonates. With masterful precision and tempestuous speed, they unleash eight rapid, deliberate strikes in perfect rhythm. Each blow strikes with surgical accuracy, shattering %target's guard and sending their balance crumbling under the relentless cadence, their body sealed off from any empowering chakra.

data.name: Adamantine Fortress
data.description: A defensive earth-style jutsu that raises barriers to protect the user and reduce damage taken.
data.battleDescription: %user slams their hand to the ground, channeling earth chakra outward in all directions. Thick stone walls erupt across the field in rapid formation: dense, layered, and reinforced with chakra. These barriers deflect incoming strikes and dull the force of enemy attacks. While active, %user's body is further reinforced by lingering stone chakra, allowing them to absorb more punishment than usual.

data.name: Fury of The White Tiger
data.description: The user opens seven of the eight inner gates and releases a devastating tiger-shaped gale at the target, staggering them. The surge makes the user's attacks hit harder for a short time but leaves their body burning under every hit.
data.battleDescription: Waves of green and blue energy flow from %user's body as %user opens the first seven Inner Gates. Each Gate adds terrible force to their strikes, engulfing %user with an all-repelling aura of pure power. %user goes into the Tiger stance before striking the air in front of them with an explosion of power. The violent punch sends a massive tiger-shaped shockwave of wind crashing into %target, staggering them where they stand. The strain of the open Gates sears through %user's body, leaving them vulnerable to every blow even as their strikes grow heavier.

data.name: Dragon King's Impact
data.description: A forbidden jutsu that burns the user's own lifeforce to power a high-flying dragon of fire that crashes down on the target, leaving wounds that keep burning. For a short time the user's attacks hit harder, though their scorched body takes extra damage from every hit.
data.battleDescription: %user uses a single hand to perform a series of simple hand seals before pressing the same hand on their blade. The blade shimmers briefly as %user jumps into the air, and the chakra flowing around the weapon bursts into flame and forms a dragon shape around %user, its maw centered on the tip. With breathtaking speed, %user plummets toward %target, smashing the blade into them with devastating power and destroying everything in the impact zone. The dragon's fire lingers in %target's wounds, while the lifeforce it burned leaves %user striking harder but scorched beneath every hit.

data.name: Verdant Renewal
data.description: The user presses their palms to the ground and draws vines and blossoms up to wrap around them. For several rounds the living growth turns part of every blow they take into health.
data.battleDescription: %user kneels and places their palms on the ground, channeling energy into the earth. Vines and blossoms emerge, wrapping gently around %user. The vibrant greenery pulses with life, ready to drink in incoming blows and knit them into health. The sweet scent of blooming flowers steadies %user’s resolve as the living growth stands guard.

data.name: Forbidden Art: Heaven's Rupture Oath
data.description: A lost oath that splits the sky with dust and yin-yang chakra and crashes down on the target, threatening to seal their elements. Its chains then bind the user, armoring them while every technique costs more for a short time.

effects.description: A sky-splitting slash ruptures the target.
The rupture seals forbidden elemental flow.
The oath hardens the user's stance for a moment.
The oath chains make future actions costly.

data.battleDescription: %user draws their weapon across the air without touching %target. For a heartbeat, nothing happens. Then the sky splits along the blade's path, and a silent dust-white wound opens above %target. The rupture crashes down, carving through defenses and sealing forbidden elements in its wake. As the oath closes, chains of chakra lash back around %user's arms, hardening them against harm while making every movement cost far more than it should.

data.name: Crippling Blade
data.description: Crippling Blade is a Forbidden S-Rank Bukijutsu that enhances the user's weapon with a dark, ominous aura, sapping the strength of their foe and dulling their strongest abilities for several rounds.
data.battleDescription: With a swift, calculated strike, %user's weapon is engulfed in a menacing, dark aura, crackling with malevolent energy. As the blade connects, the aura surges into %target's body, creeping through their veins like icy tendrils, sapping their strength and agility. %target's movements slow, each step becoming a laborious effort as the oppressive force of the curse weighs them down. The once nimble and powerful fighter now struggles against the debilitating effects of the jutsu, their greatest strengths drained and diminished.

data.name: Storm Style: Divine Railgun 2
data.description: The user wraps a pebble in water chakra and fires it on a surge of lightning at blinding speed. The charge left behind makes the target far more vulnerable to storm attacks for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user coats a small pebble in water chakra, then using lightning, they supercharge it sending it flying toward %target before they can even react, inflicting massive injury with what seems like just a flick of a finger.

data.name: Storm Style: Daibutsu Thunder 2
data.description: The user calls down a storm that crashes over an area as a wave of lightning-charged water. The charge clings to every enemy it strikes, so their own attacks jolt back into them for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user raises their hands, summoning a massive storm as dark clouds gather and electricity crackles through the air, unleashing a torrential wave of electrified water that crashes toward %target with violent force, striking with bolts of lightning and dealing devastating damage while leaving the battlefield drenched and charged with residual energy that clings to whoever it struck, turning their own attacks back upon them.

data.name: Primordial Blight
data.description: The user lays a festering blight on the target at close quarters, rotting at their body. The corruption can stop them from healing at all for several rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a malevolent elemental blight of fire, water, wind, earth, and lightning that engulfs %target, scorching their vitality and corrupting their recovery, leaving them unable to mend against %user’s assault.

data.name: Zephyr Strike
data.description: The user lets a light breeze carry their weapon into a swift, cutting strike. The wind lingers around the target and turns against them, so their own attacks rebound on them for a short time.
data.battleDescription: As %user channels wind chakra into their weapon, a light breeze envelops the blade. %user strikes with swift grace, the edge flashing toward %target faster than the eye can follow. As it connects, the breeze clings to %target and twists against them. Each blow they throw is caught by the contrary wind and hurled back upon them.

data.name: Wind Vacuum
data.description: The user draws the surrounding air into a tight vacuum around their body, compressing their chakra. For a short time their attacks strike harder and the pressure blunts incoming blows.
data.battleDescription: %user draws in surrounding air with a deep inhalation, forming an intense vacuum around their body. As the pressure equalizes, their chakra surges violently, amplifying the force and sharpness of every technique they unleash. The surrounding atmosphere distorts slightly, blunting incoming blows and signaling the enhanced potential of their next strike.

data.name: Wind Release: Tempest Edge
data.description: The user wraps their weapon in a swirling vortex of wind chakra, honing its edge to a howling sharpness. They bring it down on the target with the force of a raging storm.
data.battleDescription: With a powerful swing, %user imbues their weapon with swirling wind chakra, forming a tempestuous blade. As they bring it down upon %target, the blade cuts through the air with a ferocious howl, striking with the force of a raging storm. The tempestuous energy enhances the blade's cutting power, aiming to inflict devastating damage upon impact.

data.name: Water Style: Water Beast
data.description: The user conjures a beast of churning water that surges forward and slams into the target. A vortex lingers around the user, turning part of the damage they take into health for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user conjures a massive beast made entirely of churning water, which surges forward to slam into %target. As it crashes home, a swirling vortex lingers around %user, turning a portion of incoming damage into health. This technique balances offense with a defensive advantage.

data.name: Water Shuriken
data.description: The user compresses water into razor-edged shuriken and sends them spinning at the target. Each one strikes with the force of a breaking wave.
data.battleDescription: %user channels chakra into their hand and swiftly generates a set of spinning water-formed shuriken. With a flick of the wrist, the projectiles are launched with deadly precision toward %target, slicing through the air and striking with sharp aquatic force. Each impact lands like a compressed wave, delivering solid damage.

data.name: Tidefall Punch
data.description: The user coils water around their arm and drives it into the target like a falling tide. The spray settles over their own body, softening the blows they take for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user surges forward, water spiraling tightly around their arm like a coiled serpent. As they drive their fist into %target, the crashing blow sends a shockwave rippling outward like a tidal surge erupting from their knuckles. The impact drenches the battlefield in pressurized chakra-infused water, fortifying %user’s body with a durable aquatic guard.

data.name: Tectonic Ascendancy
data.description: Harnessing the primal energy of the earth’s tectonic plates, the user channels a massive surge of chakra into their own body, turning every earth-based attack into a destructive force of nature.
data.battleDescription: %user slams their foot into the ground, awakening deep veins of earth chakra that ripple through their body. A surge of raw, grounded power builds beneath their feet, reinforcing their strikes with the weight of the land itself. This technique heightens the user’s affinity with earth, amplifying the force behind all subsequent earth-based attacks.

data.name: Stone Shuriken Technique
data.description: The user packs compacted earth into hard stone shuriken and hurls them at the target. Each one lands with the dull weight of rock, battering them with earth.
data.battleDescription: As %user creates shurikens from compacted earth, %target braces for the incoming assault. With a swift motion, %user hurls the stone shurikens at %target, each impact sending a shockwave of earth through %target's body. The barrage of shurikens leaves %target battered and bruised, struggling to withstand the relentless assault of earthy projectiles.

data.name: Stone Circle
data.description: The user slams their hands to the earth and a ring of jagged stone pillars bursts up around the target. The pillars strike hard and may close in tight, leaving them unable to move for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user slams their hands into the earth, channeling chakra that triggers a circular formation of jagged stone pillars to erupt around %target. The rising stones strike with force before closing in tightly, restricting movement and leaving the opponent vulnerable to follow-up attacks.

data.name: Shocking Discharge
data.description: The user looses a jagged bolt of lightning from their palm into the target. The shock seizes their muscles and stuns them, costing them precious time.
data.battleDescription: %user releases a sudden burst of concentrated lightning from their palm, sending a jagged bolt surging into %target. The impact is sharp and blinding, causing the target’s muscles to seize and their body to convulse. The shock leaves them momentarily immobilized, giving the user an opening to follow up or reposition.

data.name: Rotting Bite
data.description: The user sinks phantom fangs into the target, and the illusion of rotting flesh spreads across their skin. The rot feeds the user, letting them heal from a share of the damage they deal for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %target feels a sharp sting as the illusion of rotting flesh spreads across their body. The horrific vision saps their will, activating lifesteal for %user as their strength feeds into the caster.

data.name: Lightning Release: Holy Strike
data.description: The user clasps their hands in prayer and calls down a divine bolt of lightning on the target. The holy glare leaves them shaken, dulling the force of their attacks for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user weaves a multitude of hand signs, then clasps their hands in a praying motion. Their body is cloaked in lightning that almost seems divine. In a swift motion, lightning arcs toward %target, delivering a devastating blow.

data.name: Lightning Cloak
data.description: Enshrouded in crackling energy, the user dons a mantle of lightning, amplifying the ferocity of their electric attacks until every strike sings with thunder’s fury.
data.battleDescription: %user surrounds their body in a radiant sheath of crackling lightning, each muscle fiber twitching with raw power. As they move, arcs of electricity trail behind them, lending raw force to every motion. Their strikes become charged with electric energy, enhancing the impact of all lightning-based techniques with devastating precision.

data.name: Infernal Ascension
data.description: The user calls up an infernal blaze from within, their aura roaring into flame. Every fire technique they unleash burns far fiercer for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user ignites their chakra into roaring flame, every motion blazing with destructive intensity. Their body radiates searing heat as they ascend into a state of relentless aggression, striking with explosive bursts of fire chakra. With each move, the user channels infernal energy that fuels their flame-based attacks, overwhelming the battlefield in blazing dominance.

data.name: Electric Surge
data.description: The user floods the target's mind with the illusion of a violent surge of lightning. The shock feels real enough that it stuns them, stealing time from their next moves.
data.battleDescription: As %user invokes the Electric Surge genjutsu, %target is enveloped in an illusionary surge of electricity. %target reacts instinctively, jerking as if shocked. The sensation is vivid, causing %target to momentarily lose focus, creating an opening for %user's next move.

data.name: Electric Maul
data.description: The user drives lightning chakra into the earth, and a tiger of crackling electricity bursts out to maul the target. Its claws leave their body jolted and exposed, so attacks against them hit harder for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user slams their palm into the earth, channeling lightning chakra through the terrain. From the surge, a roaring tiger made entirely of crackling electricity erupts into view, its body outlined in streaks of blinding light. The beast charges %target with terrifying speed, pouncing and delivering a mauling strike of raw elemental force. This genin-level jutsu strikes fear into opponents through its fierce visual and devastating impact.

data.name: Earth Release: Palm Push
data.description: The user thrusts a palm forward and a wall of solid force rises between them and the target. Blows land softer on the user, and the target's own attacks lose some of their bite for a short time.
data.battleDescription: With a grounded stance, %user channels earth chakra into their palm before thrusting forward. A sudden wave of solid force erupts, intercepting %target’s attack and dispersing its power. This technique reduces the damage %user receives while subtly shifting the incoming force, blunting the strength of %target’s attacks with controlled redirection.

data.name: Desert Illusions
data.description: The user traps the target in a mirage of shifting sand that crushes in around them. The phantom dunes may also mire their feet, leaving them unable to move for a short while.
data.battleDescription: With a subtle hand seal and a steady gaze, %user casts an illusion that traps %target in a mirage of shifting sands and scorching sun. In the false desert, every step becomes a struggle, and escape seems impossible. %target is struck by searing mirages while their movement is locked in the grip of the genjutsu’s disorienting landscape.

data.name: Bursting Compressed Air
data.description: The user packs air into a dense orb between their palms and bursts it at the target, punching straight through their defenses. The shock leaves them reeling, so attacks against them hit a little harder for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user compresses air with precise chakra control into a tightly packed orb between their palms. With a sharp thrust, the orb explodes forward, releasing a concentrated shockwave that tears through the air. The blast distorts the surroundings as it barrels toward %target, hitting with the crushing force of pure atmospheric pressure.

data.name: Wind Scythe Barrage
data.description: The user flings a spiraling barrage of crescent wind scythes that cut through every enemy in their path. The rhythm of the assault sharpens the user's own edge, making their attacks hit harder for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user whirls in a blur of motion, launching a barrage of crescent-shaped wind scythes across the battlefield. As the scythes fly, chakra surges through their body, sharpening their offensive edge and enhancing the power of future attacks.

data.name: Weary Fists
data.description: The user drives a slow, crushing punch weighed down with dense chakra into the target. The chakra hardens around the user afterwards, turning part of every blow they take into health for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user approaches with grounded steps, chakra coiling around their arm like lead. They drive a deliberate, crushing punch into %target, the force transferring with bone-deep weight. On impact, residual chakra lingers around %user, hardening into a dense field that turns a portion of incoming damage into health.

data.name: Volt Jab Barrage
data.description: The user unleashes a flurry of lightning-charged jabs, each punch jolting the target's nerves. The shocks leave their body raw and exposed, so attacks against them hit harder for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user’s fists spark to life as lightning surges through their limbs. In a flash, they close the distance and unleash a relentless barrage of precise jabs, each punch crackling with high-voltage chakra. Every hit sends jolts through %target’s nervous system, overloading muscles, rattling their nerves, and breaking their physical rhythm. As %target’s guard deteriorates, the electricity lingering in their body leaves them open, so every blow that follows lands harder.

data.name: Volt Fang
data.description: The user sweeps a lightning-cloaked blade in a crackling arc that bites into the ground around the target. The surge flows back up the steel, making the user's attacks hit harder for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user lunges forward and slashes %target with a blade cloaked in surging lightning chakra. The strike jolts through the enemy in a burst of current that races back up the blade, empowering every attack the user makes.

data.name: Toxic Pool
data.description: The user floods the ground with a bubbling pool of toxic chakra that scalds every enemy in the area. The poison seeps into their system, burning them each time they spend chakra or stamina over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user releases toxic chakra into the ground, forming a bubbling, acidic pool that spreads across the area. The vapor and liquid gnaw at whatever stands in it, inflicting immediate pain and poisoning the body. Every burst of chakra or stamina spent afterward worsens the poison.

data.name: Tornado Fist
data.description: The user wraps a fist in a condensed cyclone and drives it into the target's core. The torn flesh keeps ripping, dealing further damage over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user spins into action, wind chakra whipping around their arm in a vicious spiral. As they launch their fist forward, a condensed cyclone wraps tightly around the strike. The blow lands with explosive force against %target, tearing at their stance and disrupting their physical core. The turbulence doesn’t fade; it lingers. Wind chakra burrows beneath the skin and into the muscle, tearing at them from within. With the wound left open, %target keeps bleeding long after the blow has landed.

data.name: Tidal Crush
data.description: The user summons a crushing tidal wave that slams down over an area and batters every enemy within it. A film of chakra-laden water clings to the user afterwards, softening the blows they take in the rounds that follow.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a powerful wall of high-pressure water that slams into %target with crushing force. As the impact crashes forward, a residual film of chakra-infused water clings to %user’s body, forming a protective barrier that dampens future damage.

data.name: Tempest’s Whisper
data.description: The user murmurs a genjutsu that floods the target's senses with crashing phantom tides. The calm water settles around the user afterwards, turning part of every blow they take into health for a short while.
data.battleDescription: With a mere glance and a faint motion, %user casts a silent genjutsu that invades %target’s senses like a creeping tide. In the illusion, a storm stirs around them, whispers of rain lashing through reality. The target is struck by phantom torrents, while their attacks feel muffled and distant, as if the storm is stealing their force. The user remains within the illusion’s calm eye, the storm turning the blows that reach them into fresh health.

data.name: Swallow’s Flight
data.description: The user darts across the field with the grace of a swallow and lands in a spinning kick. Every enemy near the landing spot is struck by the sweep of their legs.
data.battleDescription: %user channels chakra into their legs and darts forward with birdlike elegance. Their body moves in a blur, dashing to a new position and landing in a precise aerial kick. The combination of striking force and tactical movement mirrors the fleeting flight of a swallow, dealing damage and adjusting battlefield placement.

data.name: Stormblade Arc
data.description: The user carves a spiraling arc of storm-charged steel that slices through the defenses of every enemy in its path. Lightning coils around the user afterwards, throwing part of the damage they take back at the attacker.
data.battleDescription: %user strikes in a flash, slashing through %target with a blade crackling with storm energy. The momentum whirls the blade onward in a spiral as arcs of electricity coil around their form. The blade’s storm-charged edge reflects part of the incoming damage back toward its source.

data.name: Storm Kick
data.description: The user unleashes a spiraling lightning kick that cuts straight through the guard of every enemy in its path. The current wraps around the user afterwards, hurling part of every hit they take back at the attacker.
data.battleDescription: %user channels lightning chakra into their leg, their form crackling with unstable voltage. With a flash of movement, they lash out like a bolt breaking loose from a thundercloud. The kick lands cleanly against %target, piercing through their guard with razor precision. But the technique doesn’t stop there. Storm Kick leaves a current behind, wrapping the user in reactive lightning. For a short time, part of any damage aimed at %user arcs back toward the attacker, punishing them for every blow.

data.name: Stone Pillar Strike
data.description: The user drives chakra into the ground and a jagged pillar of stone erupts beneath the target. Shattered rock clings to the user as armor, cutting the damage they take in the rounds that follow.
data.battleDescription: %user slams their chakra into the ground, summoning a jagged pillar of stone that erupts beneath %target. As the impact lands, fragments of chakra-reinforced rock encase the user, forming a hardened layer that reduces incoming damage.

data.name: Stone Breaker
data.description: The user drives a stone-weighted weapon down with a crash that breaks over a wide patch of ground. Any enemy caught in the impact is left shaken, their attacks weaker for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user twists mid-air and drives a stone-weighted weapon into %target’s torso with brutal force. The sudden blow reverberates through their body, disrupting their chakra flow and reducing the power behind their next attacks.

data.name: Shōen Gen'ei
data.description: The user conjures a spiraling mirage of heat that sweeps the field and burns every enemy it touches. The haze stokes the user's own fighting spirit, making their attacks hit harder for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user vanishes into a mirage of heat and haze, reappearing in flickering bursts as spectral flames race across the battlefield. The illusion strikes everything in its spiral with scorching clarity, searing the mind as much as the body. Each movement sharpens the user's own aggression, amplifying the potency of their next attacks.

data.name: Rib Breaker
data.description: The user drives a coiled fist into the target's ribs, cracking the channels that carry their chakra. For a short while, every technique the target performs drains far more chakra and stamina.
data.battleDescription: %user drives forward with a tightly coiled strike, targeting the ribs with pinpoint precision. The moment their fist crashes into %target’s side, chakra surges through the blow, fracturing internal flow and rupturing control points. The hit leaves more than bruises; it disrupts how %target channels energy. From that moment on, their chakra and stamina slip through the cracks, making every technique cost more to maintain.

data.name: Resounding Crescendo
data.description: The user builds a rhythm of blows that swells into a crashing final strike against the target. The echo of the impact settles over their body as a hardened guard, so the hits they take land softer over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user strikes with precise rhythm, each movement building in intensity until the final blow crashes into %target like a drumbeat shaking the air. The force of the hit reverberates through the user’s body, channeling momentum inward. As the impact fades, hardened chakra settles over %user’s frame, reducing damage taken from future blows.

data.name: Rengoku Rō
data.description: The user locks eyes with the target and drags them into an illusory prison of endless flame. The phantom fire keeps smoldering in their mind, so the blows that follow burn deeper for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user locks eyes with %target and channels overwhelming genjutsu energy, summoning a fiery illusion that consumes reality around the victim. Walls of flame twist into phantasmal figures, dragging %target into an endless mental prison of agony and despair. Every sensory input is distorted, disorienting the enemy and leaving their will fractured under the crushing weight of illusionary suffering.

data.name: Quaking Fist
data.description: The user stomps forward and hammers a stone-cracking punch into the earth, sending a quake through the area. The tremor shakes everyone it reaches, blunting their attacks over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user anchors their stance, fists brimming with stone-cracking force. With a forward stomp and a devastating punch, they channel tectonic weight into %target’s body, the blow landing like the fall of a mountain. But the damage isn’t just physical. The shock seeps inward, fracturing focus, disrupting chakra flow, and shaking the very core of %target’s will. Their techniques falter, their strikes lose their bite under the pressure, and their power erodes like stone in a quake.

data.name: Phoenix Heart
data.description: The user engulfs the area in an illusory inferno as the cry of a phoenix sears everyone within. The visionary flames refuse to fade, burning them again over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: The user’s chakra flares with ethereal fire as they weave hand signs that blur the line between reality and illusion. %target finds themselves engulfed in a rising inferno of rebirth, their thoughts seared by the haunting cries of a celestial phoenix. As their mental defenses crumble, the phantom flames cling to their mind, searing them again with every breath in the rounds that follow.

data.name: Mountain Crusher
data.description: The user wraps their fist in earth chakra as heavy as a mountain and drives it into the ground, sending a seismic shock across the area. Any enemy caught in it is rattled, their attacks weakened for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user drives forward with immovable force, earth chakra wrapping around their limb like the weight of a mountain. The strike lands against %target with crushing density, sending a seismic jolt through their frame.

data.name: Mizukumi
data.description: The user moves like flowing water, lashing the target with a heavy strike of water chakra. The water then wraps around the user as a veil, converting a share of incoming damage into restored health in the rounds that follow.
data.battleDescription: %user moves like liquid vengeance: fluid, controlled, and deadly. As they strike %target, water chakra lashes out with every movement. After the impact, the water wraps around %user like a protective veil, absorbing incoming force and restoring their health.

data.name: Mental Fortress
data.description: The user clasps a firm seal and projects a fortress of focused will across the battlefield. It sharpens their own attacks for a short while and frays the intent behind the target's strikes.
data.battleDescription: %user clasps their hands in a firm seal, eyes locked with unshakable focus. A web of radiant chakra sigils ignites from their body, expanding outward in layered rings that pulse with calculated force. The mental barrier they project doesn’t block attacks physically; it disrupts the intent behind them, unraveling the precision of enemy strikes. As the battlefield warps subtly under this pressure, %user’s resolve sharpens, amplifying their own power while clouding %target’s offensive edge.

data.name: Limit Breaker
data.description: The user settles into a taijutsu stance and lets raw fighting spirit flood their limbs. For a short time their attacks hit harder, while the pressure they give off weakens the target's strikes.
data.battleDescription: %user tightens their stance, breathing slow and deep as raw fighting spirit surges through their limbs. Muscles tense. Focus sharpens. Power spikes violently: strikes hit harder, movements become instinctive. At the same time, the user’s aura emits crushing pressure that destabilizes %target’s combat rhythm, weakening their offensive output.

data.name: Lightning Release: Charged Senbon
data.description: The user hurls a cluster of senbon crackling with lightning chakra at the target. The shock bursting from each needle stuns them, stealing time from their next move.
data.battleDescription: %user channels lightning chakra into a cluster of senbon needles, each one crackling with electric intensity. With a swift motion, they hurl the needles toward %target. As the senbon strike, a burst of lightning erupts on contact, disrupting motor control and delivering a jolt that leaves %target paralyzed. The precision and speed of the assault make recovery nearly impossible in the moment.

data.name: Inferno Kick
data.description: The user sets their leg ablaze and spins into a flaming kick that erupts in searing heat on impact. The flames cling to the wound, burning the target again over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user channels fire chakra into their leg, the limb igniting in a blaze that roars with each step. With a swift leap and a violent spin, they deliver a flaming kick to %target, the impact erupting in a burst of searing heat. The flames cling to the point of contact, continuing to burn and inflict damage over time.

data.name: Inferno Burst
data.description: The user hurls a dense knot of fire chakra that erupts over the area, scorching every enemy in the blast. The heat lingers on anyone caught inside, leaving them more vulnerable to fire for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user expels a high-speed blast of condensed fire chakra that detonates on impact with %target, scorching their body and chakra network. The heat lingers, disrupting their chakra defenses and increasing the damage they take from future fire techniques.

data.name: Graveyard of Stone
data.description: The user traps the target in a vision of a vast graveyard where stone hands drag them under and jagged rock rains down. The phantom weight lingers on their mind, so every hit they take strikes deeper for a short while.
data.battleDescription: The user performs a silent sequence of hand seals before slamming a palm to the ground. In an instant, the terrain warps in %target’s vision as they are plunged into a nightmarish realm of collapsing cliffs and shifting tombs. The enemy sees themselves standing in a vast graveyard where every headstone bears their name. Stone hands erupt from the earth, grabbing at their limbs and dragging them downward as the sky rains jagged obsidian boulders. With each phantom impact, real pain blossoms, blurring the line between illusion and reality. The oppressive weight of stone breaks their focus and crushes their will, delivering devastating damage through sheer psychological terror.

data.name: Gale Reaver
data.description: The user gathers wind chakra into a keen edge and releases it in a sweeping arc that carves into the target. The shredding winds leave them raw, so the hits that follow cut deeper for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user gathers immense wind chakra into a concentrated edge and releases it in a sweeping arc. The resulting surge carves through the air with violent speed, shredding everything in its path and crashing into %target with brutal precision.

data.name: Gale Mirage
data.description: The user conjures an illusion of spectral wind blades that slice into the target's senses with very real pain. The mirage lingers in their mind, so for a short time part of every blow they deal turns back on them.
data.battleDescription: %user forms a single-handed seal, and the air begins to shimmer with illusory distortions. A cascade of spectral wind blades surrounds %target, slicing into their senses and nerves with phantom pain. As they strike back, a portion of their own force is turned against them, bent back through the genjutsu’s twisting illusions and causing recoil damage that echoes the pain they inflict.

data.name: Flame Vortex
data.description: The user drives fire chakra into the ground until a spinning column of flame erupts beneath the target. The heat lingers on their body, making every blow that follows burn deeper for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user channels fire chakra into the earth, erupting a spinning column of flames beneath %target. The spiraling inferno engulfs them in a brutal surge of heat and force, the flames clinging to them long after the column fades.

data.name: Endless Drowning
data.description:
A powerful genjutsu that overwhelms the target’s senses with the illusion of being pulled into an infinite, drowning ocean. For a short time after, every blow they take drags them deeper and hurts more.

DON'T TRAIN. ALREADY CAPPED. IT HAS NO POWER PER LEVEL
data.battleDescription: %user locks eyes with %target and casts a crushing illusion of a boundless, inescapable sea. In an instant, the battlefield melts away as torrents of water rise from nothing, surrounding %target in a vast, cold abyss. The sense of drowning becomes unbearable as sight warps, sounds distort, and movements feel paralyzed under the weight of imagined pressure. Panic and helplessness set in as the illusion traps the target’s mind in an endless descent.

data.name: Earth Release: Seven Heavenly Pillars
data.description: The user drives chakra into the ground and a ring of stone pillars erupts across an area, pounding enemies over the next few rounds. Those caught among the pillars are staggered, and their attacks lose force.
data.battleDescription: %user slams their hands into the earth, summoning seven towering stone pillars that burst upward across the area. Anyone caught among them is crushed again and again and left staggered, their ability to strike effectively reduced.

data.name: Cyclone
data.description: The user whips the air into a tight cyclone that tears into the target. The cuts it leaves keep reopening, dealing further damage over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user spins their fingers subtly, releasing a genjutsu that swirls into %target’s mind like a twisting cyclone. Within moments, the enemy is trapped in a howling illusion, disoriented by phantom winds that lash and rip at their senses. The mental strain tears at their resistance, leaving their mind raw with wounds that keep reopening. What began as a single storm becomes a gateway for future torment.

data.name: Chouryū Ken
data.description: The user coils water around their arm and launches a rising uppercut that crashes into the target like a dragon. The force leaves them shaken, so the blows that follow hurt more for a little while.
data.battleDescription: %user crouches low, water coiling around their arm like a living serpent. With a surge of momentum, they launch into a leaping uppercut at %target, water bursting upward in a spiraling torrent. As the punch ascends, it forms the shape of a roaring dragon made entirely of water, propelling %user into the air. The soaked terrain beneath them churns from the pressure, marking the devastating path left behind by the Soaring Dragon Fist.

data.name: Chakra Invigoration
data.description: The user surges across the field in a burst of chakra-charged speed. The rush floods their body with energy, so for a short time they hit harder and take less damage.
data.battleDescription: %user surges forward in a burst of chakra-enhanced motion, leaving afterimages as they reposition across the battlefield. As their body moves, internal chakra flow heightens, enhancing physical and mental performance all at once.

data.name: Bonecrusher Kick
data.description: The user whips a crushing kick into the target with bone-cracking force. The blow leaves their body battered, so every attack against them hits harder for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user charges forward, planting one foot with brutal precision as their leg whips into a wide, crushing arc. The kick slams into %target with raw, unfiltered force, striking deep into the nervous system and chakra flow. The impact causes more than just physical pain; it scrambles coordination and breaks down their defenses. Their guard crumbles under the weight of the blow, so every attack that follows lands harder.

data.name: Blazing Knuckle
data.description: The user sets their fists alight and drives a blazing combination into the target. The fire chakra burrows into their frame, leaving them open to heavier damage from every source in the rounds that follow.
data.battleDescription: %user’s fists ignite with concentrated fire chakra, the heat pulsing with each movement. They launch into a flurry of blazing punches, hammering %target with rapid, explosive force. Each strike forces fire chakra into the target’s frame, loosening muscle control and distorting their ability to brace. The result is lasting vulnerability, and %target becomes far more susceptible to every attack that follows.

data.name: Abyssal Surge
data.description: The user draws dense, high-pressure chakra up from the depths and wraps it around their body. For a short time their strikes hit harder, and part of every blow they take is drawn in as health.
data.battleDescription: %user steadies their breath, water beginning to churn and rise from the ground like a tide answering a silent call. Abyssal Surge engulfs their body in dense, high-pressure chakra drawn from oceanic depths. As the aura wraps tightly around their limbs and core, it sharpens their strikes and fortifies their body. Each enemy blow is drawn into the fluid barrier, its force flowing back into %user as health. In this state, the user becomes both sharper and harder to wear down, a relentless force riding the surge of the abyss.

data.name: Wind Style: Sky Dragon
data.description: The user molds chakra into a colossal dragon of cutting wind that dives through the target. The gashes it leaves keep bleeding for a short while afterward.
data.battleDescription: A furious gust howls as %user thrusts their palms toward the heavens, molding chakra into a colossal dragon of cutting wind. The creature coils above, its translucent form shimmering like glass before diving with a deafening roar. Its spiraling body tears through the air, slicing everything in its path as it drives straight through %target. The impact leaves deep, invisible wounds that continue to rip and bleed under the lingering force of the gale.

data.name: Tidal Shift
data.description: The user transforms into surging water, darting across the battlefield to a new position while boosting their offensive power before striking with crushing force.
data.battleDescription: %user harnesses the power of water, their body becoming fluid and untouchable. In a surge of motion, they dissolve into a torrent that sweeps across the battlefield, slipping through the chaos as waves crash in their wake. Reforming in an instant, %user channels the gathered momentum into a devastating, water-imbued strike that greatly enhances their offensive power.

data.name: Terra Shift
data.description: The user sinks into the earth and bursts out at a new position, hurling soil and stone across the ground around them. A layer of rock clings to their body, softening incoming blows for a short time.
data.battleDescription: In the midst of combat, %user focuses their chakra into the earth beneath their feet. The ground responds, softening momentarily as %user merges with the terrain, disappearing from sight. They move beneath the surface, undetectable and protected by layers of earth and stone. With a sudden burst of energy, %user re-emerges at a new location, the ground parting to allow their passage. As they exit the earth, the displaced soil surges outward, creating a small shockwave that strikes everything caught in the burst. The battlefield trembles under their command as %user uses the very ground beneath them as a conduit for swift and tactical repositioning.

data.name: Tempest of the Blade
data.description: The user creates a large, blade-shaped construct of pure wind chakra, which can be wielded as a weapon or launched at the target with tremendous force. The cut leaves the target exposed, so every attack against them hits harder for a short time.
data.battleDescription: As %user focuses their chakra, the air around them becomes charged with energy, swirling into a tempest. With a mighty swing, %user unleashes this tempest upon %target, the blade cutting through the air with a deafening roar. The tempest strikes %target with the force of a raging storm, dealing devastating damage.

data.name: Tempest Dash
data.description: The user rides a tempest to a new position, the wind of their passage slicing every enemy around where they land. The gale lingers in their limbs, making their attacks hit harder for a short time.
data.battleDescription: In the heat of battle, %user focuses their chakra, allowing it to flow into their legs. With a sudden surge of energy, the air around them whirls and intensifies. In an instant, %user propels themselves forward with the force of a tempest, moving at a speed that seems almost impossible. The wind roars in their wake, creating a vortex that tears at the surroundings. As %user completes their dash, they reappear in a new position, ready to strike or evade further assaults, while chaotic winds burst outward to slash at everything around their landing spot.

data.name: Siren's Lament
data.description: The user sings a haunting siren's melody that drags the target beneath a crushing phantom tide. As the song fades, its calm settles over the user, strengthening their healing for a short while.
data.battleDescription: The battlefield is engulfed in a haunting melody as %user's hands dance in graceful, intricate patterns, casting Siren's Lament. %target's eyes widen, captivated by an illusion of a beautiful, yet treacherous, underwater world. Enchanted, they begin to sink into the illusionary depths, their movements sluggish and their breath hitching. Images of ethereal creatures glide by, their eerie calls echoing in %target's mind, luring them further into the depths. As %user completes the jutsu, %target is left gasping for air, shaken by the vividness of the illusion.

data.name: Rock Barrage
data.description: The user tears jagged stones from the ground and hurls them in a hail at the target. The rocks shatter on impact, battering every enemy caught around them.
data.battleDescription: %user slams their weapon into the ground, channeling chakra to tear the earth apart beneath them. With a precise swing, they command jagged chunks of stone to rise and fly forward like deadly missiles. The barrage of sharpened rocks strikes the battlefield in a brutal, calculated rhythm, dealing heavy earth-based damage.

data.name: Phantom Step
data.description: The user flits across the field like a phantom, landing in near silence. Allies around the landing spot take less damage for a short time, while the user's own attacks hit harder.
data.battleDescription: In the midst of combat, %user channels their chakra into their legs and feet, synchronizing their movements with the surrounding shadows. With a light step, they become nearly invisible to the naked eye, their presence fading like a phantom. The user moves silently and swiftly, weaving through obstacles without making a sound. As %user advances, their form flickers in and out of visibility, making their movements difficult to track. By the time anyone pinpoints %user's position, it's already too late; %user is poised for a counterstrike, and the lingering shadows guard them from harm.

data.name: Pill Pack: Large Health Pill
data.description: The user swallows a large red pill packed with healing herbs. Its medicine mends their wounds over the next few rounds and leaves their attacks hitting harder.
data.battleDescription: %user swallows a large red pill, and warmth spreads through their body as their wounds begin to knit.

data.name: Pill Pack: Chakra Pill III
data.description: The user bites into a pill pressed from ancient ginseng and floods their body with its stored chakra. For a short time, every technique they use strikes with far greater force.
data.battleDescription: %user bites down on the pill, and a rush of stored chakra surges through their body, lending every strike a sudden, fearsome power.

data.name: Life Release: Spirit Wall
data.description: A forbidden technique that converts the user's life force into a massive chakra barrier able to withstand devastating attacks. Though immensely powerful, it exacts a heavy toll on the user's health.
data.battleDescription: %user sacrifices their life force as crimson chakra erupts around them, forming a massive chakra barrier covered in glowing sigils. The blood-forged wall withstands incoming attacks while waves of violent chakra surge from %user’s body.

data.name: Feint Step
data.description: Granted by a worn charm, this perfect feint carries the user across the field between heartbeats, leaving only an afterimage. For a moment afterwards, their actions cost them less effort.
data.battleDescription: %user vanishes in a smear of afterimages and reappears across the field before anyone can react.

data.name: Anchor the Storm
data.description: The user drives the Stormanchor's grounding current into the earth, and no one standing in the circle can be struck down for a moment. Allies within it also turn part of the damage they take into health for a short while.

effects.description: Anchored ground shelters all within from the storm's killing blow
A dome of grounded pale light

data.battleDescription: %user drives the Stormanchor's current into the ground, and for one breath nothing can kill those anchored beside them.

data.name: Wind Release: Mighty Gust
data.description: The user hurls a mighty gust that tears at the target's guard and leaves them reeling. For a short time, wind attacks cut into them more deeply.
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes a howling gust at %target, stripping away their footing and leaving them open to the wind.

data.name: Summoning: Titanoboa
data.description: The user cuts their palm and presses the blood to the earth, calling the great Titanoboa onto the field. The giant serpent fights at their side for several rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user slices their palm on a kunai and slams it to the ground, and the vast coils of the Titanoboa rise from the earth.

data.name: Spectral Counter
data.description: The user wraps the target in an illusion of spectral foes poised to counter every move. Unnerved, they leave openings everywhere, taking more damage from all attacks for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user conjures spectral duellists around %target, unsettling their guard and leaving them open to every strike.

data.name: Solar Flare Kick
data.description: Harnesses fire chakra to execute a dazzling kick that emits blinding light upon impact.
data.battleDescription: %user delivers a blazing kick that bursts into blinding light as it slams into %target.

data.name: Liver Shot
data.description: Taijutsu that deals damage and increases damage taken by the enemy.
data.battleDescription: %user drops low and drives a sudden hook into %target's side, folding them around the blow.

data.name: Liquid Thrashing
data.description: The user unleashes a thrashing torrent of water that batters the target again and again. The water then wraps around the user, turning part of every blow they take into health for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user summons jagged, thrashing tendrils of water to strike %target repeatedly, then draws the torrent around themselves as a protective veil that absorbs incoming damage.

data.name: Glyph Blade
data.description: A precise bukijutsu slash that deals damage and reduces the enemy's damage output.
data.battleDescription: %user slashes %target with a glyph-etched blade, leaving a glowing seal that saps the strength from their attacks.

data.name: Fire Release: Burning Soil
data.description: The user sets the ground ablaze beneath the target and blasts them with searing heat. The flames then rise around the user as a ward, softening the blows they take for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user scorches the earth under %target in a burst of heat, then draws the rising flames around themselves as a guard.

data.name: Cyclone Palm Strike
data.description: The user presses a whirling cyclone of chakra into the target with an open palm. The spinning force clings to them, so every attack hits them harder and burns a little deeper for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user plants a spinning cyclone of chakra on %target with an open palm, tearing their guard wide open.

data.name: Clone Technique
data.description: The user shapes chakra into a perfect copy of themselves on a nearby tile. The clone shares their full strength and fights on its own for a short while before it fades.
data.battleDescription: %user splits apart in a burst of chakra, and an identical clone steps out onto the field ready to fight.

data.name: Chakra Barrier
data.description: Hardens the body with chakra to reduce damage taken.
data.battleDescription: %user spreads a faint, shimmering layer of chakra across their body to soften the coming blows.

data.name: Tornado Vortex
data.description: The user whips up a raging tornado that tears across an area and batters every enemy inside. The cutting winds leave ragged wounds that keep bleeding over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a howling tornado that engulfs %target and the ground around them, flinging everyone caught inside back to earth.

data.name: Swift Combination
data.description: The user unleashes a flurry of rapid strikes that batters the target from every angle. The barrage can scatter their focus, leaving them unable to receive buffs for a brief moment.
