data.battleDescription: %user rains a flurry of quick, precise strikes on %target, leaving their chakra too scattered to build any strength.

data.name: Shattering Strike
data.description: The user brings down a shattering blow that cracks against the target with full force. The impact braces the user's stance, softening the hits they take until the tremor fades.
data.battleDescription: %user brings down a shattering blow on %target, planting their feet firm as the shock rolls through the ground.

data.name: Rock Fortress Strike
data.description: The user slams a weapon down on the target, and the ground erupts into ramparts of rock. The stone closes around the user like fortress walls, softening the blows they take for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user crashes a weapon into %target as walls of rock burst from the ground and close around %user.

data.name: Rock Cleaver
data.description: The user brings down a jagged, earth-laden cleave with crushing weight. The shock rattles the target's footing, so their attacks deal less damage for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user brings a jagged, earth-heavy cleave down on %target, the impact shaking the strength from their arms.

data.name: Rejuvenating Chakra
data.description: The user turns their chakra inward and guides it through the body's pressure points. Their wounds begin to knit, restoring a good measure of health as the next round begins.
data.battleDescription: %user closes their eyes and draws chakra inward, a soft glow gathering over their wounds as they start to close.

data.name: Gale Dance
data.description: The user whirls through a graceful dance of wind-wrapped strikes that cut into the target. The rending gusts leave them off balance, so they take more damage from every source for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user spins through a flowing dance of wind, each graceful strike slicing into %target and leaving them exposed.

data.name: Faint Shadow
data.description: The user casts an illusion of whispers from every direction, unsettling the target and battering their mind. Their growing paranoia emboldens the user, whose attacks hit harder for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user weaves a web of whispering illusions around %target, the faint voices tearing at their nerves while %user's confidence swells.

data.name: Eternal Darkness
data.description: The user shrouds the target in a veil of darkness, blinding them so their attacks lose force. Hidden in the gloom, the user also takes less damage for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user weaves a string of hand seals, and a veil of darkness swallows %target, hiding %user from their sight.

data.name: En Ken
data.description: The user sets their fists ablaze and pounds the target with a relentless flurry of blows. The flames cling to them afterwards, so the hits that follow burn deeper until the embers die.
data.battleDescription: %user's fists burst into flame as they charge into %target's guard, each blow landing faster and hotter than the last.

data.name: Eclipsing Gales
data.description: The user whips a wind-charged blade through the target in a single high-speed slash. The cut keeps tearing open, dealing further damage over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user lashes out with a wind-charged slash that rips across %target, leaving a wound that refuses to close.

data.name: Echoing Void
data.description: The user releases a pulse of void chakra that slams into the target. The echo settles over the user, guarding their own buffs from being cleared for a moment.
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes a wave of void-touched chakra at %target, its echo wrapping around %user to anchor their enhancements in place.

data.name: Earthquake Fist
data.description: The user smashes an earth-charged fist into the target, rupturing the ground around them. The seismic shock can root every enemy caught in it, leaving them unable to move for a moment.
data.battleDescription: %user slams a fist into %target hard enough to split the ground, the shockwave threatening to root nearby enemies in place.

data.name: Earth Release: Earthquake
data.description: The user stamps hard and sends a shockwave of splitting earth racing towards the target. The tremor surges back up through their legs, strengthening their taijutsu and bukijutsu in the moments after.
data.battleDescription: %user stamps the ground and sends fissures racing towards %target, the tremor rising back up to steel %user's limbs.

data.name: Cyclone Prison
data.description: The user conjures a raging cyclone over an area, trapping enemies in winds that batter them over the next few rounds. Its momentum feeds back into the user, making their attacks hit harder.
data.battleDescription: %user calls down a roaring cyclone across the ground ahead, its gathering momentum surging back into their own strikes.

data.name: Crimson Vein
data.description: The user lashes crimson threads of chakra into the target, opening their body so later hits land harder. The threads also link back to the user, letting their attacks draw life for a short while.
data.battleDescription: Crimson threads lash out from %user and burrow into %target, laying them open and tying every strike %user makes to a thread of stolen life.

data.name: Crescent Strike
data.description: The user darts to a chosen spot and sweeps their blade in a wide arc shaped like the crescent moon. The cut strikes every enemy around them as they land.
data.battleDescription: %user flashes across the field and lands in a sweeping crescent slash that cuts through the enemies around them.

data.name: Chakra Palm
data.description: The user packs raw chakra into an open palm and drives it into the target. The released energy rebounds around the user as a protective shield for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user drives a chakra-packed palm into %target, and the backlash spins around %user into a shimmering shield.

data.name: Body Flicker
data.description: The user vanishes in a flicker of speed and reappears at a chosen spot on the field. Their arrival lands as a sharp burst of chakra that strikes every enemy close by.
data.battleDescription: %user blurs out of sight and reappears across the field, striking at the enemies around them in the same instant.

data.name: Zephyr Smash
data.description: The user wraps their arms in volatile winds and smashes through the target's guard with a single punch. The swirling air clings to them, so the next hits they take bite deeper for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user dashes at %target with winds swirling around their arms, landing a punch that bursts straight through their guard.

data.name: Wind's Embrace
data.description: The user wraps the target in a cutting embrace of wind that leaves their guard open. The same breeze lifts the user's wind techniques, making them hit harder for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user wraps %target in a cold embrace of wind that strips their guard, the breeze curling back to sharpen %user's wind techniques.

data.name: Typhon Burst
data.description: The user condenses wind chakra in their palms and releases it as a bursting typhoon at the target. The blast tears through the enemies around them, and its backdraught makes the user's attacks hit harder for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user thrusts out both palms and a typhoon bursts across %target, the wind roaring back to fill %user with storm-born power.

data.name: Torturing Flame Coil
data.description: The user summons a serpent of blazing flame that coils around the target and sears them. The coils keep tightening, burning them again on each of the rounds that follow.
data.battleDescription: %user summons coiling flames that wrap around %target, searing them relentlessly.

data.name: Tidal Surge
data.description: The user conjures a crushing tide that slams into the target and the enemies around them. The waters then draw back to wrap the user, blunting the blows they take for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user conjures a crushing tide that slams into %target, its waters rolling back to wall %user in a flowing guard.

data.name: Thunderbolt Fury
data.description: The user calls down a furious barrage of thunderbolts on the target. The storm's energy surges back into the user, making their attacks hit harder for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes a storm of thunderbolts upon %target, surging with electric power as their strength grows.

data.name: Surging Kick
data.description: The user rides a surge of water into a sweeping roundhouse kick against the target. The force of the wave leaves them reeling, their attacks dulled for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user dances light on their feet, then sweeps a water-charged roundhouse across %target's guard.

data.name: Suiryūken
data.description: The user moves with the flowing form of the water dragon fist, letting water techniques slide off them. The current fuels their strikes, so all their attacks hit harder for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user sinks into a fluid stance, water coiling around their arms as they turn aside water techniques and gather force.

data.name: Sudden Geyser
data.description: The user bursts a geyser up from the ground beneath the target, blasting them with crushing force. Its mist then lingers around the user, turning a share of incoming damage into health for a short time.
data.battleDescription: The ground splits beneath %target as a geyser erupts on %user's command, its spray settling around %user like a healing mist.

data.name: Stunning Jab
data.description: The user darts in and drives a sharp jab into a weak point on the target. The jolt can stun them, slowing their actions over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user surges forward and snaps a precise jab into %target, the impact ringing through their whole body.

data.name: Stone Stomp
data.description: The user drives an earth-charged stomp into the ground, sending a shockwave racing towards the target. The tremor strikes with the full weight of the earth behind it.
data.battleDescription: %user stamps down with earth-laden force, splitting the ground in a shockwave that slams into %target.

data.name: Shadow Tendril Technique
data.description: The user's shadow splits into inky tendrils that lash at the target. For a short time afterwards, the darkness feeds the user, healing them for part of the damage they deal.
data.battleDescription: %user's shadow stretches into inky tendrils that lash %target, then coil back to feed on every blow that follows.

data.name: Scorching Sun Strike
data.description: The user gathers the heat of the midday sun into one blazing strike against the target. The burns it leaves keep searing them over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user's hands blaze like a rising sun as they strike %target, leaving burns that keep flaring after the light fades.

data.name: Scorching Kick
data.description: The user sets their leg ablaze with fiery chakra and delivers a searing high kick to the target. The scorched wound resists healing for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user's leg erupts in flame as they snap a high kick into %target, leaving a searing mark that will not easily mend.

data.name: Savage Blade Cyclone
data.description: The user wraps their blade in a cyclone of wind chakra and slashes the target in a savage spinning cut. The gale keeps howling around the user, making their attacks hit harder for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user whips their blade through a roaring cyclone of wind, carving into %target as the gale wraps around them.

data.name: Raijin Puncture
data.description: The user charges their fist with white lightning and drives it into the target in a piercing discharge. The blast tears through guards and shields alike, striking everyone close to the impact, friend or foe.
data.battleDescription: White lightning gathers around %user's fist as they drive a charged punch into %target, unleashing a blinding discharge.

data.name: Phoenix Flame Strike
data.description: The user conjures a blazing phoenix that dives into the target in a burst of fire. Its lingering flames wreath the user, making their attacks hit harder for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user looses a phoenix of blazing fire at %target, its embers swirling back to feed the flames around %user.

data.name: Multi-Layered Gale
data.description: The user stacks layer upon layer of cutting vacuum and drives them into the target. The deep cuts leave them exposed, so every blow that follows deals more damage for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user gathers layered currents of wind that converge on %target, carving deep cuts through their guard.

data.name: Ice Blade Dance
data.description: The user whirls through a dance of ice blades that carve into the target. The frozen cuts keep biting, dealing more damage over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user spins through a flurry of ice blades, carving %target with frozen cuts that keep bleeding long after the dance ends.

data.name: Ganpaken
data.description: The user hardens their fists like solid rock and drives a ground-shattering punch into the target. The impact cracks their guard, leaving them slightly more exposed to the blows that follow.
data.battleDescription: %user's fists turn hard as stone, and a crushing punch sends a shockwave through %target that splits the ground at their feet.

data.name: Fleeting Strike
data.description: The user slams a wind-charged heel into the ground beside the target, sending a shockwave of compressed air through nearby enemies. The wind keeps buffeting them, so every hit they take over the next few rounds lands harder.
data.battleDescription: %user stamps down a wind-charged heel, and a ring of compressed air bursts out to tear through %target and those around them.

data.name: Fire Release: Majestic Fist
data.description: The user wreathes their fist in roaring flame and slams it into the target with a fiery shockwave. The blaze stokes their own body, raising their strength, speed, taijutsu and weapon power for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user charges at %target with a fist of blazing fire, the shockwave of the impact kindling a fierce heat in %user's muscles.

data.name: Fire Release: Dragon Punch
data.description: The user throws a blazing punch that takes the shape of a roaring dragon's head as it strikes the target. The searing bite leaves them exposed, so the blows that follow hurt more for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user drives a burning fist forward, and a roaring dragon of fire bursts from it to sink its fangs into %target.

data.name: Earth Release: Dragon's Tomb
data.description: A dragon of earth and stone bursts from the ground and crashes down on the target. Its rubble briefly pins them in place, and the wounds it leaves keep hurting over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user calls a great earthen dragon up from the ground, and it coils over %target in a crushing tomb of rock.

data.name: Earth Armor
data.description: The user encases their body in thick, hardened earth that blunts incoming blows. Its crushing weight bears down on the target, dulling their attacks for a short time.
data.battleDescription: Hardened earth crawls over %user's body in heavy plates, and its looming weight leaves %target's strikes faltering.

data.name: Dust Dismanting
data.description: The user charges the dust around the target with chakra and drives it into their body. The particles keep tearing at them from within, dealing more damage over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user stirs a cloud of chakra-laden dust around %target, the fine grains slipping into their lungs and tearing at them from inside.

data.name: Drowning Smash
data.description: The user shapes water into gleaming liquid fists and smashes them into the target. The surge flows back into their arms, making their attacks hit harder for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user forms a fist of rushing water and drives it into %target, the current swelling around their arm for the next blow.

data.name: Drowning Mire
data.description: The user slams water chakra into the ground and turns an area into a heavy, sucking mire. Anyone standing in it takes damage over the next few rounds and suffers more from every blow.
data.battleDescription: %user strikes the earth and water wells up through it, spreading into a churning mire that drags at everything caught inside.

data.name: Dragon Breath
data.description: The user breathes a torrent of dragon fire over the target. The flames keep eating at them, dealing further damage over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user exhales a torrent of dragon fire over %target, the searing flames devouring them long after the first blast.

data.name: Draconic Assasult
data.description: The user unleashes a surge of draconic fire that crashes over the target. The flames sear deep, leaving their wounds slow to mend for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user lets loose a roar of dragon fire that engulfs %target, scorching them with burns that resist every attempt to heal.

data.name: Cyclone Sweep
data.description: The user sweeps a leg through a low arc and a whirlwind rips across the target. The wind keeps clinging to them, so their own attacks lash back at them for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user sweeps a leg in a wide arc, and a ground-level cyclone crashes into %target, tangling them in wind that turns on them.

data.name: Cyclone Fists
data.description: The user drives a wind-wrapped punch forward and a cyclone of cutting air tears into the target. The battering saps their strength and speed, weakening their taijutsu and weapon attacks for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user hurls a punch wrapped in howling wind, and the cyclone it unleashes slams into %target, leaving their limbs heavy and slow.

data.name: Mallow Smash
data.description: Teni raises her hands, revealing they are covered in marshmallows, forming giant gauntlets. Yelling “TENI SMASH!”, she proceeds to pummel the opponent into sweet, marshmallowy oblivion.
data.battleDescription: %user’s hands are enveloped in chakra-infused marshmallows, forming massive, cushioned gauntlets. With a battle cry of “TENI SMASH!”, she charges at her opponent, delivering powerful blows that send them flying and leave them embedded in sticky marshmallow goo.

data.name: Chakra Edge
data.description: The user runs chakra along their weapon until it gleams with a keen blue edge. For a short time their bukijutsu strikes hit harder and the flowing chakra blunts incoming damage.
data.battleDescription: %user channels chakra along their weapon until it glows a keen blue, the flow wrapping around them as a guard.

data.name: Amaterasu's Renewal
data.description: The user calls down a radiant dawn that washes over every ally and purges their harmful effects. Each ally takes less damage for a short time and is wrapped in a sturdy shield for several rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user raises their hands as a radiant dawn spreads across the battlefield, washing every ally clean and wrapping them in light.

data.name: Summoning: Hell Hound
data.description: Freed from their contract by Vulcan's death, the hellhounds now answer to the user. A scroll unrolls and one bounds onto the field to fight beside them for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user unrolls a contract scroll and a hellhound of Vulcan bursts onto the field with a savage howl.

data.name: Summoning Poison Salamander
data.description: The user slaps a palm to the ground and calls forth a venomous salamander to fight at their side. The creature holds the field for a short time before it returns.
data.battleDescription: %user slaps a palm to the ground, and a poison salamander bursts from a cloud of smoke ready to fight.

data.name: Shard Pulse Eruption
data.description: The user detonates a condensed orb of chakra into a spray of shards that rip into the target. The leftover fragments circle the user, briefly guarding their own boosts from being stripped away.
data.battleDescription: %user detonates a condensed orb of chakra, and a volatile spray of shards rips into %target before the fragments swirl back around %user.

data.name: Iron Fist
data.description: The user hardens their fist with chakra until it is like iron and drives it into the target. For a short time afterwards part of the damage the user deals flows back to them as health.
data.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra, empowering their fist. They strike at %target with raw force, shattering their bones.

data.name: Inferno Leech
data.description: The user lays a writhing curse on the target that bleeds away their health on each of the next few rounds. Meanwhile part of the damage the user takes is turned into health for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user lays a writhing curse on %target that bleeds away their health, while the backlash settles over %user as a veil that drinks in incoming blows.

data.name: Blazing Edge
data.description: Fire chakra forms a sword in the user's hand as they surge to a new position and sweep it through nearby enemies. The scorched cuts resist healing for a short while.
data.battleDescription: Flames take the shape of a sword in %user's hand as they surge across the field, carving through nearby enemies in a single searing arc.

data.name: Fire Release: Great Fireball
data.description: The user draws a deep breath and exhales a towering fireball that bursts over an area. Every enemy caught in the blaze keeps burning, taking more damage over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user draws a deep breath and unleashes a roaring fireball, engulfing %target in flames that leave lasting burns.

data.name: Kinjutsu: Black Thorn Rose
data.description: A forbidden art paid for in the user's own blood. Black thorn vines lash out in a spiral, choking the healing of every enemy they catch, while the rose's thorns close around the user as armour.
data.battleDescription: %user opens their palm with a thorn and lets the blood fall. A black rose tears up through the earth, its vines spiralling outward to choke every wound they find, while its thorns curl back to armour the one who fed it.

data.name: Succubus' Lilac Petal Absorption
data.description: Kaz creates an enchanting illusion of countless lilac petals, swirling gracefully around her. Each petal acts as a conduit, absorbing incoming damage while channeling restorative energy back into Kaz or her allies. This technique merges beauty and resilience, turning an ethereal display into a formidable defense.
data.battleDescription: %user gracefully launches a flower towards the opponent. In a mesmerizing display, their form dissolves into a swirling vortex of shimmering lilac petals, each one a tiny receptor for incoming attacks. The petals absorb impacts, transforming them into life-giving energy, while %user's essence remains protected within the illusion, untouched by harm. With each absorbed blow, their vitality surges, replenishing %user’s essence. The battlefield is awash with the delicate fragrance of lilacs as %user stands unyielding.

data.name: Counter Helix
data.description: Technique used to ward off enemy attacks
data.battleDescription: Technique used to ward off enemy attacks

data.name: Blazing Death Star
data.description: Shuriken wreathed in fire nature chakra blaze across the field like falling stars. They strike the target and leave them smouldering, so the blows that follow burn deeper.
data.battleDescription: %user hurls a fan of shuriken that ignite mid-flight, slamming into %target as blazing stars and leaving them smouldering.

data.name: Moonlit Fury
data.description: A powerful attack that unleashes the first form.
data.battleDescription: Channeling the mystique of the moon, %user unleashes a whirlwind of primal fury. Each strike carries waves of kinetic force, leaving %target battered and dazed, capped off by a perfectly thrown potato.

data.name: Feral Wrath
data.description: A powerful attack that unleashes the first form.
data.battleDescription: Forcing their dormant bloodline to awaken, %user transforms, limbs elongating and muscles surging with inhuman power. In this primal state, %user unleashes a savage assault on %target, their roars echoing as they attack with feral fury, seeking to overwhelm and disembowel their opponent.

data.name: Frenzy Assault
data.description: A strong melee attack that unleashes the evolved form.
data.battleDescription: %user taps into their inner rage, muscles surging with adrenaline. Consumed by fury, they unleash a relentless rampage on %target, their attacks fueled by uncontrollable power and ferocity.

data.name: Tempest Shroud
data.description: A barrier of razor-sharp wind defends and strikes simultaneously.
data.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra, summoning a Tempest Shroud—a swirling vortex of crimson wind blades that envelops them in a protective layer. The whirling gale forms a defensive barrier, slightly boosting %user’s resilience against incoming attacks while repelling close-range threats. The shroud lashes out with vicious precision, its razor-sharp crimson blades cutting deep into %target

data.name: Great Vacuum Bullet
data.description: The user takes a deep breath and exhales several small blasts of wind chakra that scatter in different directions, making them very difficult to avoid without injury.
data.battleDescription: %user takes a deep breath and exhales several small blasts of wind chakra that scatter in different directions before converging on %target, making them impossible to dodge.

data.name: Blazing Chains
data.description: Illusionary chains of fire lash onto the target, burning them with searing force before continuing to scorch them over time.
data.battleDescription: The user casts a haunting illusion where spectral chains, wreathed in ethereal fire, burst from the ground and wrap around %target. The fiery bonds sear into their flesh with each movement, warping their senses and igniting phantom pain that continues to ravage their body over time.

data.name: Scorch Break
data.description: Your most basic technique as a wielder of the Boil style
data.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra into their palms, turning it into steaming liquid. Dashing forward, %user unleashes a flurry of punches, each strike searing %target's body and leaving burn marks in its wake.

data.name: Typhoon Tear
data.description: The user unleashes a series of rapid, spinning slashes that create multiple cutting wind blades, shredding through the target and surrounding area.
data.battleDescription: With a fierce cry, %user infuses their blade with swirling wind chakra, creating a vortex of cutting winds. As they slash at %target, the vortex surrounds them, slicing through flesh and leaving behind a lingering effect. %target feels the winds continue to cut at them, causing sustained damage even after the initial strike.

data.name: Terra Spire
data.description: Jagged earth spikes erupt, creating hazards for the battlefield.
data.battleDescription: %user slams their hands to the ground, channeling their chakra deep into the earth. With a rumbling roar, jagged spikes of stone erupt from the ground, forming a hazardous field around %target.

data.name: Abysmal End
data.description: This jutsu creates a spiral of dust and air enveloping the enemy and collapsing against them with overwhelming force.
data.battleDescription: %user engulfs %target in a spiral of dust, sapping their strength while boosting their own before collapsing it with devastating force.

data.name: Inferno Dragon's Wrath
data.description: A blazing dragon-shaped assault that deals damage and burns the enemy over time.
data.battleDescription: %user roars with force as a colossal dragon of living fire erupts from their chakra, crashing into %target with scorching fury. The blazing heat continues to cling to the enemy, searing them long after the initial impact.

data.name: Dreamshell
data.description: A deceptive genjutsu that damages the enemy while shielding the user from future harm.
data.battleDescription: The user closes their eyes briefly as a translucent aura forms around them, distorting reality in rippling waves. A pulse of psychic force erupts outward, battering %target’s senses with unbearable pressure. At the same time, the user becomes cloaked in a dreamlike shell of chakra, dulling incoming attacks and reducing harm through pure illusory manipulation.

data.name: Earth Release
data.description: Create a mauseleum of stone around yourself
data.battleDescription: %user entombs themselves in a rock formation protecting them from all sides

data.name: Magnetic Pulse Strike
data.description: A powerful Taijutsu strike that generates a magnetic pulse to disorient and damage the opponent.
data.battleDescription: %user gathers their chakra into their fists, charging it with magnetic energy. With a swift and precise movement, they strike %target directly. Upon impact, a shockwave of magnetic force radiates from the point of contact, distorting the magnetic fields around %target. This pulse disrupts their nervous system and balance, making them vulnerable to follow-up attacks.

data.name: WindPath
data.description: New jutsu description
data.battleDescription: %user uses %jutsu on %target

data.name: Emberbane Cocoon
data.description: A searing cocoon of flame that scorches the target and continues to burn them over time.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a blazing cocoon of ember-forged chakra that engulfs %target in constricting flame. The initial surge scorches their body, while lingering embers cling to their skin and chakra pathways, continuing to burn and disrupt them after the attack lands.

data.name: Stone Release
data.description: Create a mauseleum of stone around yourself
data.battleDescription: %user entombs themselves in a rock formation protecting them from all sides

data.name: Lunar Descent
data.description: A haunting genjutsu that deals damage and applies damage over time.
data.battleDescription: %user uses their genjutsu to manipulate %target's senses, making them believe the moon is plummeting toward them, overwhelming them with agonizing sensations and terror as they are convinced of an impending catastrophic impact.

data.name: Greater Vacuum Bullet
data.description: The user takes a deep breath and exhales several small blasts of wind chakra that scatters in different directions, making it very difficult for one to avoid without injury
data.battleDescription: %user takes a deep breath and exhales several small blasts of wind chakra that scatters in different directions, all converging on %target making it impossible to dodge

data.name: Lava Wave
data.description: Unleashes a tidal wave of lava.
data.battleDescription: %user molds their chakra with earth and fire, creating a towering wave of molten lava. With a swift motion, they release the wave, which cascades forward like a burning tsunami. %target faces the oncoming tide, but the overwhelming heat and pressure make escape nearly impossible. As the wave crashes, it incinerates everything in its wake, leaving behind a molten landscape.

data.name: Death's March
data.description: Release waves of chakra that strikes your target
data.battleDescription: %user envelops %target in a radiant chakra tunnel.  They unleash an unyielding wave of chakra, targeting their enemy's cells with relentless precision. As the assault subsides, the enemy's once-sturdy form crumbles, consumed by decay.

data.name: Skybreaker Palm
data.description: A crushing palm strike that harms the enemy and increases the damage they take.
data.battleDescription: %user slams %target with the Skybreaker Palm, dealing heavy damage and leaving them vulnerable to even greater punishment.

data.name: Windshear Decay
data.description: Razor sharp wind slashes that leave lasting and decaying effects
data.battleDescription: %user forms a series of intricate hand seals which summons forth the power of the winds that once quelled Fujin's fury. With a swift motion, they unleash a torrent of razor-sharp wind slashes that tear through the air towards %target. The wind howls with a vengeful fury, and as the invisible blades connect, they slice deep into %target's flesh, leaving behind festering wounds. The air around %target grows heavy with the scent of decay as the slashes begin to fester and deepen over time, continuing to tear at their flesh with each passing moment.

data.name: Tempestual Rend
data.description: A cutting wind attack that damages enemies and weakens their attacks for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user summons slicing winds that tear into the area, damaging enemies and weakening their attacks.

data.name: Fire Style: Beast
data.description: A remarkable taijutsu technique that merges the essence of the flames with the user's physical combat abilities.
data.battleDescription: %user quickly places multiple Primal seals on their body. Once %user finishes their hand-signs the seals combust into searing flames igniting %user's body into a beastly form made of Hell's flames. %user's punches and kicks unleash a torrential flame of Primal energy scorching %target.

data.name: Torrent Shuriken
data.description: A deadly water projectile that deals damage and reduces the users damage taken
data.battleDescription: %user hurls a spinning Torrent Shuriken, slicing into %target with pressurized water while a cascading veil forms around them, dulling incoming strikes.

data.name: Marshmallow Inferno
data.description: Delusions immerse the target in a sweet yet nightmarish illusion. The target perceives themselves as a marshmallow aflame, melting into gooey oblivion. They feel the heat, the gradual melting, and the sensation of being sandwiched between chocolate and graham crackers.
data.battleDescription: %user casts Marshmallow Inferno Delusion upon %target. The illusion takes hold, enveloping %target in a fiery, gooey nightmare. %target feels the heat, senses their melting form, and experiences the bizarre sensation of being pressed between chocolate and graham crackers, trapped in a surreal, sugary oblivion.

data.name: Water Release: Hiding Water Technique
data.description: Launch a surprise attack by hiding in a puddle of water.
data.battleDescription: %user melds into surrounding water, vanishing from sight while preparing for a precise counterattack.

data.name: Aqua Dragon Barrage
data.description:
A relentless barrage of water dragons that crashes into the target with crushing force while restorative water heals your wounds.

DON'T TRAIN. ALREADY CAPPED. IT HAS NO POWER PER LEVEL
data.battleDescription: %user conjures a series of water dragons that surge forward in rapid succession, slamming into %target from multiple angles while restorative water flows back to heal %user.

data.name: Shrine of Radiance -FR
data.description: Throws a miniature sun shrine that explodes with radiant energy.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a miniature replica of the Sun Shrine, infused with the potent energy of Amaterasu. With a focused throw, they hurl the shrine towards %target. As it makes contact, the shrine bursts open, releasing a blinding flash of radiant energy. This explosion of light and heat burns %target and creates a radiant shockwave that knocks back and disorients surrounding enemies. The sacred energy within the shrine also purifies the area, dispelling any dark or malicious chakra present. This jutsu combines the reverence of the Sun Shrine with devastating offensive power, leaving %target scorched and vulnerable.

data.name: Cutting Tempest
data.description: A tornado made of blades of wind is used to attack the opponent
data.battleDescription: %user weaves lightning-fast handseals, summoning a vicious Cutting Tempest—a roaring vortex of razor-sharp wind chakra blades that spirals toward %target with merciless speed. The tempest shreds through defenses in a storm of slicing crimson edges, inflicting devastating, multi-hit damage as air currents tear armor and flesh alike. Fueled by the onslaught, %user’s chakra surges violently

data.name: Wind Step
data.description: With bolstering speed your move across the battlefield to damage the enemy and lower their offensive abilities
data.battleDescription: %user surges forward with blistering speed, channeling the wind’s relentless momentum to glide across the battlefield like a cutting gust. Each swift step unleashes a razor-sharp burst of wind chakra, striking %target with piercing force. The excessive wind pressure crushes down on %target

data.name: Blast Shield
data.description: Using the concussive blast from an explosion to dampel the next attack you take.
data.battleDescription: %user creatives a massive explosion around themselves neutralizing all attacks coming towards them.

data.name: Crimson Tides
data.description:
A violent chakra wave that drains the enemy’s life, restoring the user with every strike.

DON'T TRAIN. ALREADY CAPPED. IT HAS NO POWER PER LEVEL
data.battleDescription: %user summons a surge of crimson chakra that ravages %target, siphoning their life to heal their own wounds.

data.name: Eruption Strike
data.description: Combines physical strikes with erupting lava bursts.
data.battleDescription: %user charges forward with unmatched speed, their fists and feet glowing with molten heat. Each strike they deliver erupts in a burst of lava, searing %target's flesh and armor. The combination of raw physical power and scorching lava leaves a trail of destruction, overwhelming %target with relentless fiery assaults.

data.name: Yozakura: Dancing Embers
data.description: A storm of wind chakra whips through the flame blossoms of the Sakura Dragon Tree, lifting them into a blinding violet blaze. The swirling torrent surges forward like dancing dragons, leaving scorched trails and reduced damage in their wake.
data.battleDescription: %user stirring the flame blossoms into a violent vortex that lashes out at %target in a blazing spiral.

data.name: Drowning Illusion
data.description: Traps the target in a water illusion, dealing damage and weakening their ability to fight back.
data.battleDescription: The user casts a haunting illusion that submerges %target in a false, inescapable flood. Panic takes hold as phantom waters rise around them, distorting their senses and draining their will to strike back. Every motion feels heavier, every breath more desperate, weakening their ability to launch effective attacks.

data.name: Sunfire Nebula
data.description: New jutsu description
data.battleDescription: %user uses %jutsu on %target

data.name: Chakra Shield
data.description: The user's chakra automatically forms a shield around them in response to an incoming attack.
data.battleDescription: As %user focuses their chakra, a shimmering barrier forms around them, manifesting as a protective shield. The opponent's attacks are repelled by this formidable barrier, their strikes weakening as they impact the shield. %user stands resolute behind the chakra shield, ready to defend against any assault with unwavering determination.

data.name: Replacement Technique
data.description: Basic Replacement used to escape or distract enemies.
data.battleDescription: %user forms a quick seal and vanishes in a puff of smoke, leaving behind a decoy. In the same instant, they reappear elsewhere on the battlefield.

data.name: Armor of Protection
data.description: Forges protective chakra armor around the user, boosting their stats, hardening their defense and empowering their metal attacks for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user forges special armor that strengthens and protects them.

data.name: Venomous Phobia.
data.description: A fear-inducing poison technique that increases how much damage the target takes.
data.battleDescription: %user releases a silent, airborne toxin that bypasses the skin and seeps into the mind. As %target inhales the faint mist, illusions twist into phobias—hallucinations of venomous creatures crawling beneath the surface. The fear tightens their body and frays their nerves, making them far more vulnerable to incoming attacks as their composure breaks.

data.name: Poisonous Senbon
data.description: A precise senbon strike laced with venom, designed to weaken the enemy with every hit.
data.battleDescription: %user flicks a handful of senbon with surgical grace, each needle laced with a slow-acting poison. As the senbon strike %target, their body begins to stiffen and falter, chakra flow disrupted by the toxin’s subtle pulse. Though the wounds seem minor, the damage deepens with every breath.

data.name: Searing Might
data.description: A blazing chakra technique that hardens the user’s body, reducing incoming damage.
data.battleDescription: %user channels intense chakra into their core, igniting it into a controlled blaze that spreads through their body. The heat reinforces their muscles and chakra pathways, forming a shield of inner strength. As attacks come in, the energy absorbs and deflects the impact, allowing the user to withstand damage with unshakable resolve.

data.name: Howitzer Crash
data.description: A devastating technique where you propel yourself at the target with an explosion before launching another massive explosion at them.
data.battleDescription: %user explodes the space behind them launching themselves at the opponent then detonates themselves as soon as they get close enough. The explosion weakens the opponent defenses.

data.name: Charge 4 Explosion
data.description: Spreading your chakra across the battle field causes micro-explosions to everything it comes into contact with.
data.battleDescription: %user covers the battlefield with their explosive chakra. Small explosions can be seen and heard happening all around you.

data.name: Eclipse Cyclone
data.description: A mesmerizing jutsu that amalgamates the user's mastery over both celestial energy and kinetic manipulation to disorient the enemy.
data.battleDescription: %user rotates rapidly, infusing celestial energy around themselves. They create an eclipse-charged cyclone that pulls %target in, briefly disorienting them with darkness, then unleashes an energy burst that propels %target away, staggering them as they land.

data.name: Cruel Sun
data.description: The closer you get the harder it is too breathe.
data.battleDescription: %user fires off his chakra into the sky creating a massive ball of burning chakra.

data.name: illuminance
data.description: A forbidden technique passed down through the generations. Illuminate the entire battlefield.
data.battleDescription: %user creates a jutsu formula that spreads out from their feet. Acting as a homing signal, a bright pattern appears above %target. The chakra condenses and beams of light fire towards %target.

data.name: Widow's bite
data.description: A quick shadow-charged bite that strikes hard for very little effort.
data.battleDescription: %user lunges in a blur of shadow and sinks a vicious bite into %target.

data.name: Widow's Maw
data.description: Sweeps a spiral of shadowed silk across the ground that weakens the strikes of anyone it catches.
data.battleDescription: %user casts a spiralling net of shadowed silk across the ground, sapping the strength of anyone it catches.

data.name: Pill Pack: Stamina Pill III
data.description: A potent pill that toughens the user against incoming damage while leaving the target more exposed.
data.battleDescription: %user bites into a green pill which immediately seems to increase their muscle mass.

data.name: Momo3
data.description: The user's horns extend into spears that impale the target and leave them more vulnerable to attack.
data.battleDescription: %user's horns extend and shoot toward %target, impaling them.

data.name: Increase Potency
data.description: Draws the user's chakra inward to strengthen their effects for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user draws their chakra inward, sharpening every technique that follows.

data.name: Decrease Potency
data.description: Disrupts the target's chakra, weakening the strength of their effects for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user disrupts %target's chakra flow, dulling the strength of their techniques.

data.name: Sticky Fingers
data.description: A quick-handed trick that pockets some of the target's ryo while they are distracted.
data.battleDescription: %user slips close to %target and, with a flick of the wrist, makes off with a handful of their ryo.

data.name: Vacuum Fan
data.description: A fan of metallic chakra whose vacuum drags enemies toward the user, weakening their strikes and leaving them open to metal.
data.battleDescription: %user creates a fan made of metallic chakra. With one motion of their hand, a vacuum is created on the battlefield that pulls everything towards %user

data.name: Shadow Pierce
data.description: A silent dagger thrust from the shadows that pierces straight through defenses and leaves a lingering wound.
data.battleDescription: %user vanishes into shadow, closing distance in silence. In a swift, lethal motion, they drive their dagger forward, piercing through %target with precision, the strike leaving a lingering, chilling pain.

data.name: Phantom Slash
data.description: A ghostly dagger cut that slips past the target's guard, leaving them exposed and hurting them for every blow they land.
data.battleDescription: %user flickers forward like a ghost, dagger gliding in a silent arc. The slash phases through %target’s guard, striking unseen, leaving behind a delayed, phantom cut that suddenly tears through them.

data.name: Middle Guard Stance
data.description: A centered, balanced stance that strengthens offense and defense while shrugging off attempts to weaken the user.
data.battleDescription: %user shifts into Middle Guard Stance, centering their body and blade. Their presence hardens, boosting offense and defense while nullifying incoming debuffs, leaving %target unable to weaken their perfectly balanced form.

data.name: Inner Peace
data.description: A moment of perfect stillness that sharpens the user's strikes and steadies their defense for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user closes their eyes and takes a deep breath fortifying their offense and defense, and eerie stillness that causes their enemy to hesitate

data.name: Equilibrium Guard Strike
data.description: A balanced sword cut sent in a straight line that cracks the target's guard, leaving them more vulnerable to metal techniques.
data.battleDescription: %user settles into a balanced guard, then cuts a clean line of metal chakra through %target, breaking their footing and leaving their defenses open.

data.name: Crimson Thrust
data.description: A crimson-charged dagger lunge that carries the user forward into the strike and sets the target ablaze, so later blows burn deeper.
data.battleDescription: %user grips their dagger as crimson chakra flares to life. In a brutal forward lunge, they drive the blade deep into %target, the impact bursting with violent force and searing intensity.

data.name: Ice Flow
data.description: Technique to become immune to enemy debuffs
data.battleDescription: Technique to become immune to enemy debuffs

data.name: Black Coffin
data.description: Unite, repulse, fill the earth, and know your own powerlessness.
data.battleDescription: %user creates a sphere of intensified gravity centered around %target. The affected area appears shrouded in a swirling mass of pitch darkness with faint, glowing patterns resembling constellations, symbolizing the weight of the universe crushing down

data.name: Atomic Shield
data.description: Create a barrier of particles to protect you
data.battleDescription: %user creates a translucent barrier made of the particles around them to defend from all attacks

data.name: Sonic Slash
data.description: A high-speed slash that pierces defenses with precision.
data.battleDescription: %user channels vibrating sound chakra into their blade and vanishes in a burst of movement. As the weapon cuts through the air, it releases a sharp sonic wave that tears into %target with amplified force. The strike disrupts balance, pierces armor, and leaves behind a ringing pulse that echoes through the target’s body.

data.name: Phantom Realm Oblivion
data.description: The user casts a powerful illusion that transports the target's consciousness into a nightmarish realm of endless darkness.
data.battleDescription: With a series of intricate hand signs, %user unleashes their chakra, casting the forbidden genjutsu, Phantom Realm Oblivion. %target's surroundings warp and twist, enveloping them in a dark, nightmarish realm. %target is consumed by their deepest fears and regrets, experiencing vivid illusions of past traumas. As the torment intensifies, %target's mind struggles to differentiate between reality and illusion, plunging them into a state of psychological disarray.

data.name: Particle Cannon
data.description: The ultimate power comes with the ultimate price.
data.battleDescription: %user weaves an intricate triangle with their fingers, bringing forth a radiant orb that caresses %user's hand with a warm glow that both energizes and burns. Gradually, the sphere transforms, unfurling into a brilliant beam, propelled with purpose towards %target

data.name: Crimson Impact
data.description: The user violently rends their target, leaving them exposed while siphoning vitality from the damage inflicted.
data.battleDescription: %user rends %target with brutal force, tearing open deep, bleeding wounds. The injury lingers, raw and unclosing, as %user drinks from it, each pulse of pain feeding %user’s strength.

data.name: Crimson Dominion: Queen's Judgment
data.description: The user compresses vampiric power into a concentrated sphere of crimson energy before releasing it in a devastating blast. The impact overwhelms her opponent's defenses, while the lingering curse weakens their offensive capabilities and allows her to maintain control of the battle.
data.battleDescription: %user gathers a sphere of concentrated crimson energy in her palm before releasing it in a violent explosion. The blast slams into %target, tearing through their defenses as blood scatters across the shattered ground. A dark curse clings to their body while scarlet energy coils around her like a royal mantle.

data.name: Blood Release: Thousand Scarlet Fangs
data.description: The user conjures thousands of razor-sharp blades forged from condensed crimson energy. Under her absolute control, the blood-red weapons descend upon her opponent in an unrelenting barrage, tearing through defenses and filling the battlefield with a storm of scarlet destruction.
data.battleDescription: Thousands of razor-sharp crimson blades materialize behind %user. With a flick of her fingers, the blood-red weapons rain down upon %target, piercing their flesh from every direction. Blood sprays with each impact as the blades carve through the battlefield, leaving the air thick with scarlet mist.

data.name: Thousand Strike
data.description: The user unleashes a relentless barrage that shatters defenses, leaving the target exposed to further harm.
data.battleDescription: %user descends in a frenzy of strikes, each blow tearing through %target with merciless precision. Defenses collapse under the onslaught, and in the wake of the assault, %target is left wide open, unable to withstand what follows.

data.name: Divine Blood: Scarlet Benediction
data.description: Envelop yourself in immortal crimson radiance that absorbs harm, reduces incoming damage, and strengthens your attacks.
data.battleDescription: Crimson radiance surges through %user, forming a blood-forged mantle that absorbs incoming harm, reinforces their defenses, and empowers their attacks.

data.name: Hemocure
data.description: The user commands their blood to reject injury, sealing wounds and feeding on incoming harm to sustain an unnatural vitality.
data.battleDescription: %user’s blood writhes beneath %user_object skin, surging against the flow of nature. Wounds seal shut as they form, and each strike from %target is devoured, strength stolen as %user refuses to fall.

data.name: Asmodeus: Embrace of Life and Death
data.description: Invokes the authority of life and death, manifesting a devastating crimson force that tears through her opponent. The vitality stolen through the attack flows back into her body, restoring her wounds as she crosses the battlefield with supernatural grace.
data.battleDescription: %user vanishes in a flash of scarlet light, reappearing beside %target. Her fingers pierce through their defenses as crimson tendrils coil around their body, draining their vitality. Blood sprays across the ground as their stolen life force streams into her wounds, sealing them beneath a sinister crimson glow.

data.name: Reaper's Embrace
data.description: The user closes in and drains their target directly, tearing vitality from them in a violent, inescapable exchange.
data.battleDescription: %user lunges forward and crashes into %target, dragging %target close as crimson energy surges between them. With every heartbeat, %user rips vitality free, feeding on %target’s life as %user_object holds them through this vicious dance.

data.name: Asmodeus: Eternal Crimson Requiem
data.description: The user unleashes a sinister blood curse that infects her opponent with a plague of corrupted crimson energy. The curse spreads through their body, weakening their vitality as the lingering affliction inflicts continuous damage. Beneath the Vampire Queen's merciless gaze, the infected target is consumed by the creeping influence of her blood magic.
data.battleDescription: A colossal crimson moon rises as %user spreads her arms, flooding the battlefield with blood-red light. Countless scarlet pillars burst from the earth, engulfing %target in a merciless storm of destruction. Blood stains the shattered ground as their silhouettes disappear beneath the crimson inferno. %user closes her fist, and the entire domain explodes in a final wave of scarlet energy, leaving silence in the Vampire Queen's wake.

data.name: Sanguine Plague
data.description: The user seeds a rival's blood with a burning sickness. The plague opens them to harm and eats at them from within, while the user's own blood refuses all affliction.
data.battleDescription: %user flicks a drop of tainted blood onto %target and it takes root, burning as it spreads. %target is opened and eaten from within, while %user_object own veins run too hot for any sickness to touch.

data.name: Death Blessing: Crimson Judgment
data.description: With a cold and merciless gaze, Luminous condemns her opponent through an ancient blood curse. Scarlet energy erupts beneath their feet, inflicting severe damage while disrupting their movements and making every subsequent action more difficult to execute.
data.battleDescription: %user raises two fingers as blood-red sigils ignite beneath %target. Jagged crimson spikes erupt from the ground, impaling their body in a violent burst of scarlet. Blood splatters across the surrounding terrain as a lingering curse shackles their movements, leaving them vulnerable beneath the Vampire Queen's merciless gaze.

data.name: Crimson Tithe
data.description: The user takes a toll in blood and time alike. The shock of the taking locks the victim in place, and what movement remains costs them dearly.
data.battleDescription: %user reaches into the space between heartbeats and takes what is owed. %target staggers, locked mid-motion, and even time itself grows expensive around them.

data.name: Holy Magic: Sanctuary of the Crimson Moon
data.description: Manifestation of a vast crimson domain beneath the light of a blood-red moon. A destructive wave of supernatural energy engulfs nearby enemies, inflicting widespread damage while suppressing their offensive power beneath the overwhelming authority of her vampiric magic.
data.battleDescription: A blood-red moon illuminates the battlefield as %user spreads her arms. A massive crimson circle erupts beneath <user>'s, unleashing a devastating wave of scarlet energy. The blast tears through their bodies, spraying blood across the ground as their strength crumbles beneath the crushing pressure of her domain.

data.name: Ring of Spilled Blood
data.description: A spiral of spent blood is thrown across the ground. It opens what stands against the user, and what it opens, it weakens.
data.battleDescription: %user spills a spiral across the ground and it turns outward, hungry. Enemies caught in the ring are opened, and their blows leave the circle duller than they entered.

data.name: Surfing Strike
data.description: A series of gliding movements atop boiling water
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes a torrent of water, flooding the battlefield. Using their Boil affinity, they glide seamlessly over the steaming surface, while the boiling water scalds %target causing %user to take less damage.

data.name: Liquid Ember Shell
data.description: Encases the user in a shell of molten fire and water.
data.battleDescription: %user merges fire and water chakra to form a molten liquid shell that absorbs attacks, with fire burning weaker assaults and water dissipating impacts, providing adaptive defense against various threats.

data.name: Azure Dragon Palm
data.description: Land devasting blows from the safety of your dragon.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a water dragon that encases them like armor. Dashing toward %target, each strike they deliver is mirrored by the dragon, landing devastating blows that leave %target battered and overwhelmed.

data.name: Decaying Touch
data.description: Touch your target and start to destroy their body through a dusty decay.
data.battleDescription: %user creates a dust cloud that surrounds %target. Dashing through the cloud, they appear in front of %target, placing their hand on them. %target slashes at %user, and their body becomes dust. Only after the dust has disappeared does %target realize that the part of their body that was touched is beginning to decay.

data.name: Yin-Yang Cascade
data.description: Yin-Yang Cascade is an advanced technique of the Tenohira Musei bloodline, unleashing a powerful wave of Yin-Yang energy that disrupts the chakra flow of all targets within its range, leaving them weakened and disoriented.
data.battleDescription: As %user unleashes Yin-Yang Cascade, a torrent of swirling energies erupts from their outstretched hands. The wave surges forward, engulfing %target in its path. As it crashes over %target, their chakra is disrupted, leaving them staggered and weakened, their movements slowed as they struggle to regain their balance amidst the chaotic energies.

data.name: Silent Rift
data.description: Silent Rift is a swift and elusive jutsu of the Tenohira Musei bloodline. It allows the user to instantaneously close the gap between themselves and their opponent, appearing next to them in a blur of Yin-Yang energy.
data.battleDescription: With a surge of chakra, %user vanishes from sight, leaving behind a faint trail of shimmering energy. In the blink of an eye, %user reappears beside the opponent, the air crackling with residual Yin-Yang energy as they prepare to strike. The suddenness of the maneuver catches the opponent off-guard, allowing %user to take advantage of their proximity for a swift and decisive attack.

data.name: Silent Palm Strike
data.description: Silent Palm Strike is a fundamental technique of the Tenohira Musei bloodline, utilizing Yin-Yang Release to disrupt an opponent's chakra flow upon contact with a precise strike of the palm.
data.battleDescription: With a focused gaze and steady breath, %user channels the power of Tenohira Musei, infusing their palm with Yin-Yang energy. %user swiftly closes the distance to %target, their hand poised to strike. As the palm makes contact, a surge of potent Yin-Yang energy erupts, sending a shockwave through %target’s body, immediately disrupting their chakra flow. In the aftermath, intricate symbols begin to flare across %target’s skin, forming a restrictive seal that targets and suppresses their bloodline abilities. This sealing effect weakens %target, cutting off access to their inherited powers and leaving them vulnerable to follow-up attacks.

data.name: Moonlit Inferno
data.description: Unleashes a fiery, electrified moonlight that damages, weakens, and exposes the enemy.
data.battleDescription: Beneath the silver glow of the moon, %user channels the fiery and electrifying power of Yin-Yang. A brilliant, searing light descends upon %target, infused with the destructive essence of both fire and lightning. The moonlit flames scorch deeply, while arcs of lightning crackle through the air, striking with deadly precision. The burning energy saps the strength of %target, dulling their ability to strike back and leaving them vulnerable to further devastation. As the moon’s radiant fury peaks, %user becomes a beacon of power, the night alight with the dual forces of fire and lightning, reshaping the battle with an overwhelming force.

data.name: Eternal Stillness
data.description: Ensnares all in unending lunar stillness.
data.battleDescription: %user calls forth the moon’s eternal stillness, casting a shadow of timeless peace across the battlefield. In this serene dominion, both %user and %target find themselves unable to alter their power or weaknesses. The world seems to hold its breath, as all movement of strength and vulnerability is frozen beneath the moon's unwavering glow.

data.name: Imperial Freeze
data.description: Imperial Freeze is an awe-inspiring jutsu belonging to the heirs of the cursed Teno Yuki lineage. This technique harnesses the elemental forces of water, wind, and ice to create an overwhelming and majestic frozen storm.
data.battleDescription: %user channels the essence of their bloodline, summoning the regal power of Imperial Freeze. With a series of precise hand signs, an immense blizzard erupts around %target, the air thick with shimmering ice crystals and freezing winds. The temperature plummets, and %target finds themselves ensnared in an exquisite yet deadly prison of ice. The biting cold gnaws at their strength, and the dazzling ice formations disorient their senses, making it difficult to tell friend from foe. The battlefield transforms into a majestic yet merciless winter landscape, showcasing the overwhelming authority of %user and the chilling grandeur of Imperial Freeze.

data.name: Cryostorm Aegis
data.description: Encases you in a protective storm of ice and snow that reduces incoming damage and gradually restores your health.
data.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra into a spiraling vortex of snow and ice. The frozen storm shields %user from incoming attacks while its restorative chakra gradually heals their wounds.

data.name: Infernal Stream
data.description: This jutsu combines the user's incredible physical strength with the explosive power of their bloodline.
data.battleDescription: %user channels the power of their bloodline and slams their fists on the ground and channels incredible power into the environment around them. After a brief respite, the battlefield around the opponent shakes as geysers erupt around. Suddenly, %user barrages the opponent with incredible speed and power. With every hit landed, a geyser erupts and showers the opponent with powerful blasts of magma.

data.name: Blow of Devastation
data.description: The user draws on their lineage to unleash a taxing surge of magma that leaves the opponent vulnerable.
data.battleDescription: %user draws deeply upon their bloodline, molten energy surging across their body as layers of living magma harden into blazing armor. With a decisive stomp, %user sends rivers of lava coiling around %target. The effort strains %user, while the intense heat disrupts %target’s defenses and leaves them vulnerable to further attacks.

data.name: Storm Style: Divine Railgun
data.description: You fire off an attack at inhuman speeds utilizing the properties of lightning and water's conductivity.
data.battleDescription: %user coats small pebble in water chakra, then using lightning, they supercharge it sending it flying toward %target before they can even react, inflicting massive injury with what seems like just a flick of a finger.

data.name: Indra's Storm Cloak
data.description: You cover your body in lightning and water chakra causing those that attack you to be struck in return
data.battleDescription: %user cloaks themselves in their storm chakra; using themselves as the epicenter lightning strikes the battlefield

data.name: Yozakura: Sakura Dragon Pearl
data.description: As wind and fire chakra converge, a glowing sphere takes shape, pulsing in resonance with the Sakura Dragon Tree. Petals spiral inward, fusing into a radiant pearl that enters the user’s body, igniting a healing fire that restores balance and strength from within.
data.battleDescription: %user forming a glowing pearl of flame and petal light that surges into their chest, reigniting their strength before %target can strike again.

data.name: Hiru-Sakura: Sakuragari
data.description: A spiraling lance of burning cherry blossom petals forms from the swirling wind, hurled with violent force toward the enemy. Just before impact, the lance blossoms apart into a storm of flaming petals, searing everything in its path.
data.battleDescription: %user uses Hiru-Sakura: Sakuragari, forming a lance of swirling petals that shatters near %target into a wave of burning blossoms.

data.name: Asazakura – Sakura Dragon Tree
data.description:
Summons the legendary Sakura Dragon Tree—its darkened trunk erupting from the battlefield, crowned in blazing pink and violet flame blossoms.

The tree remains rooted in place, scorching nearby enemies and empowering all fire and scorch-based techniques used by the caster. Its presence marks the battlefield with beauty and devastation alike.

A symbol of rebirth and destruction, this is the first blossom of the Nikko no Hana's legacy.
data.battleDescription: Flames blossom from the earth as %user casting burning petals toward %target in a dazzling display of wrath and grace.

data.name: Shadow Step
data.description: A skillful maneuver that blurs the boundaries between visibility and concealment. Through an artful melding with the enveloping shadows, the practitioner's presence becomes near-invisible, seamlessly blending into the darkness that surrounds them
data.battleDescription: %user seamlessly melds with nearby shadows, becoming an elusive wraith in the dimness. Swift as a moonlit breeze, they materialize in a surge of shadow energy just behind the opponent. Seizing the advantage of stealth, %user initiates an ambush with heightened potency, catching the opponent off guard and delivering a forceful strike that inflicts substantial damage.

data.name: Shadow Shell
data.description: Becoming one with the Shadows gives this Shinobi the edge they need in battle.
data.battleDescription: %user envelopes themselves in darkness as their power reinvigorates %user becomes a pillar of shadows imposing a menacing figure as the battle continues.

data.name: Shadow Domain
data.description: A devastating shadow-infused attack that merges Yin and Yang energy with shadow manipulation, delivering a lethal blow that drains the opponent's vitality.
data.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra, summoning the surrounding shadows to converge around %target. The shadows twist and elongate, forming sharp, ethereal blades that glint with a dark aura. With a swift motion, %user launches the shadows at %target. As the strike connects, the shadowy blades seep into %target's body

data.name: Shadowrend
data.description: Cursed tattoos allow the user’s strike to ignore defenses and inflict a shadow curse.
data.battleDescription: With a pulse of malevolent chakra, %user's cursed tattoos flare to life, filling the air with shadowy energy. They strike at %target, bypassing all armor and barriers, as the cursed shadows cling to %target, seeping into their chakra network. This curse lingers in %target's system, amplifying the damage of future attacks. The shadows coil tightly around %target, ensuring that the next hit they suffer will be devastating, as the curse grows more potent with each passing moment.

data.name: Shadow Tether
data.description: Glowing tattoos summon shadows that deal a devastating wound to enemies
data.battleDescription: %user’s tattoos glow as living shadows stretch toward %target and tighten around them. The tether tears into %target, leaving a deep wound that makes every movement more painful.

data.name: Shadow Surge
data.description: The user bonds with shadows, teleporting to a target while taking reduced damage.
data.battleDescription: %user's tattoos glow a deep, ominous hue, their body dissolving partially into shadows. Vanishing from their position and reappearing beside the opponent. Cloaked in shadow, %user seems to shrug off attacks, the damage lessened as their form becomes one with the darkness.

data.name: Cursed Beast Form
data.description: The cursed tattoos fully cover the user, turning them into a creature of the shadows.
data.battleDescription: With a dark incantation, %user activates the full power of their cursed tattoos, which crawl across their skin like living ink. The tattoos pulse with malevolent energy, overtaking %user’s entire form and warping them into a monstrous shadow creature. Claws extend from their hands, and their body becomes wreathed in dark energy. In this form, %user’s strength, speed, and resilience increase dramatically, their attacks leaving trails of shadow that cling to %target like a curse.

data.name: Singularity
data.description: A Jutsu that displays the symbolism of the Kyuko-sei. The user manipulates fine dust particles infused with chakra, creating a volatile field that detonates upon command. This technique disperses microscopic shards that pierce targets,
data.battleDescription: %user conjures a powerful gravitational core, tearing into %target and amplifying Dust, Wind, and Earth techniques

data.name: Resonance
data.description: Surround yourself with a dust-infused resonance that reflects incoming force and damages the target.
data.battleDescription: %user releases a dust-infused pulse that reverberates around them, reflecting incoming force before striking %target.

data.name: Wire Blast Plus
data.description: Itojinsei's Wind Style: Wire Blast
data.battleDescription: %user channels Wind element to their steel wire bundle, %user hurtles their sharpened wire ball at %target the wires exploding on impact.

data.name: Spiraling Wires
data.description: This Itojinsei jutsu spears their target making them work harder to defend themselves.
data.battleDescription: %user launches out multiple shuriken with wiries attached to them weaving them in an intricate pattern the shuriken strikes %target in their vital spots impairing their movement

data.name: Lightning Threads
data.description: Infuse lightning chakra into thin, thread-sharp wires to deliver lethal shocks.
data.battleDescription: %user weaves an intricate dome-shaped cage made entirely of wires around %target. The wires tighten and constrict, restricting the target's movement and preventing escape. %user infuses lightning chakra into the wires to electrocute %target.

data.name: Iron Web Entrapment
data.description: Conjure magnetic wires to trap your opponent, slowing their resolve.
data.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra into the ground, causing razor-sharp wires to erupt and form a vast web across the battlefield. The wires ensnare %target and nearby enemies, tightening with each movement, slicing through armor and flesh.

data.name: Eternal Embrace
data.description: The user conjures thin, razor-sharp wires, imbuing them with chakra. These wires can be controlled with precision, used for stealthy assassinations or to create intricate traps.
data.battleDescription: %user performs Wire Strangle. Thin wires materialize, dancing with deadly grace, hurtles towards %target. %target is ensnared, the wires tightening with precision, leaving them incapacitated, and cutting deeply as %target struggles under the wires.

data.name: Rising Star
data.description: A powerful Houkyuken uppercut.
data.battleDescription: %user gathers their innate powers into their body. At the right moment, %user unleashes their power into a perfect rising uppercut smashing their fist into %target's chin for a devastating blow.

data.name: Morning Star
data.description: Channel ancient chakra to increase the effectiveness of your attack
data.battleDescription: %user takes the Houkyuken stance, vanishing in a blur. In an instant, %target is launched skyward, where %user appears to deliver a relentless flurry of strikes before slamming them back to the ground with crushing force.

data.name: Houkyuken: Magnetic Assignment
data.description: Even your blood can be used as an effective weapon, thanks to your magnetic mastery and the iron in your blood.
data.battleDescription: %user's blood hardens into a crimson steel-fist, glowing with inner power. With a rapid Houkyuken strike, they drive their fist into %target's stomach, forcing them to cough up blood from the devastating impact.

data.name: Houkyu Dance
data.description: The softer style of Houkyuken, which increases their movement and area of reach from their fists and kicks.
data.battleDescription: %user releases a magnetic pulse, entering the Houkyu Dance. Enhanced by perfect awareness and the amplified speed from the magnetic field, %user unleashes a flawlessly coordinated series of devastating strikes upon %target.

data.name: Lullaby
data.description: Cloud your enemy's sense of hearing and lure them to their death.
data.battleDescription: %user creates a flute from the bones of their body, by imbuing chakra into the flute they begin to play  a harsh melody that slowly erodes %targets eardrums

data.name: Harmonic Chamber
data.description: Trap your target in a chamber of deadly music.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a great chamber trapping %target inside, while target is busy trying to escape they hear a faint melody turns into a horrifying screech that ruptures %target eardrums leaving them withering in pain.

data.name: Frozen Melody
data.description: Freeze your target with a beautiful melody.
data.battleDescription: %user creates a violin made from pure chakra. As each note rings across the battlefield, %target finds themselves unable to move.

data.name: Foreboding Interlude
data.description: Generate a soundwave that forces your target to kneel before you.
data.battleDescription: %user snaps their fingers causing the chakra in the air to vibrate generating a distinct soundwave isolating them from the battle and clearing their mind

data.name: Celestial Harmony Shield
data.description: Creates a barrier of harmonious sound waves and mystical energy.
data.battleDescription: %user raises their hands gracefully, and a soft, ethereal melody begins to resonate through the air. The sound waves, infused with mystical chakra, form an invisible barrier that shimmers with a faint light. As the melody grows stronger, the barrier solidifies, creating a protective dome around %user. The harmonious vibrations disrupt incoming attacks, dissipating physical blows and nullifying elemental jutsu. The sound waves also have a calming effect, reducing the impact of mental and genjutsu assaults. The shield remains as long as the melody continues, providing %user with a serene, impenetrable defense.

data.name: Amaterasu's Holy Mirror
data.description: From the armory of Amaterasu’ combat tools.
data.battleDescription: %user Pulls out a ninja tool that fires a powerful beam of light at the enemy blinding and scorching them.

data.name: Shattered Reflection
data.description: Reflects light to create clones and distort perception.
data.battleDescription: With a flicker of their eyes, %user manipulates the surrounding light, creating multiple afterimages of themselves that confuse and disorient %target. These illusions mirror %target's attacks back at them, leaving them unsure of the true %user's position. Each reflection seems real until %target is struck by a precise blow from the shadows, capitalizing on their disoriented state.

data.name: Elder Flare
data.description: Kieto Delorin and Slyrak were always known for their unconventional methods of combat
data.battleDescription: %user Delorin and Slyrak weave handsigns and begin pouring chakra into a giant sphere. Kieto then compresses that sphere into a tiny ball of light and sends it across the battlefield to %target Upon touching %target The sphere detonates sending chakra rampant and creating a giant ball of exploding light.

data.name: Imperial Swords
data.description: Conjure mirrors and reflect rays of light to pierce your target.
data.battleDescription: %user traps %target within a dense dome made of mirrors. Appearing above the dome, %user clasps their hands together, causing the mirrors to vibrate and swords of light to fire from them toward %target. Trapped in the middle, %target is unable to evade the barrage of swords.

data.name: Amaterasu's Flaming Scimitar
data.description: Kieto releases his chakra to create a new battlefield
data.battleDescription: %user holds his hands out in prayer as a burning light shines down on him giving him a sun blade that he uses to send a massive wave of chakra at %target.

data.name: Chrono Stasis
data.description: Distort time around an enemy, leaving them more vulnerable to incoming damage while accelerating your own movement through the altered flow.
data.battleDescription: %user traps %target within a large translucent sphere of distorted time. The stasis leaves %target increasingly vulnerable while %user moves through the altered flow with accelerated timing.

data.name: Quintessential Flake
data.description: Using your blue blade, you turn your enemies ice pulling them towards you
data.battleDescription: %user channels their Blue Blade unleashing its energy upon %target. The freezing the surrounding area.

data.name: Blue Crimson
data.description: Use your bloodline to teleport to different locations striking the enemy
data.battleDescription: %user activates their bloodline, their eyes glow as patterned blades start to rotate in their pupils. %user disappears and reappears in seemingly random locations around %target, shifting his speed till his movements seem more illusionary than real. As %target becomes more and more disorientated, %user slashes and pierces %target from multiple angles.

data.name: Blade Resonance
data.description: Synchronize your chakra with your weapon to deliver an icy strike that leaves the target vulnerable to Earth, Ice, Water, Wind and non-elemental attacks.
data.battleDescription: %user channels their lineage through their weapon and forms a blade of ice, striking %target and disrupting their defenses against Earth, Ice, Water, Wind and non-elemental attacks.

data.name: Storm Style: Daibutsu Thunder
data.description: Unleashes a torrent of electrified water, overwhelming enemies.
data.battleDescription: %user raises their hands to the sky, gathering their chakra and calling forth a massive storm. With a swift motion, %user brings their hands down, summoning a torrential wave of water infused with lightning. The wave crashes toward %target, the water swirling violently as bolts of lightning strike from within, making escape nearly impossible.
