As the electrified water engulfs %target, the intense shock and pressure from the current deal devastating damage. The storm rages for a few moments, leaving the battlefield drenched and charged with residual electrical energy, hindering actions.

data.name: Izanagi's Hammer
data.description: Brings down a lightning-infused hammer to crush all in its path.
data.battleDescription: %user summons the divine power of Izanagi’s hammer, using it to rapidly close the distance, smashing %target

data.name: Ice Coffin
data.description: Trap your target in a coffin made of ice.
data.battleDescription: %user calls forth an icy gust that washes over %target. Within an instant, %target finds themselves trapped within an ice coffin. %target Desperately tries to break the ice but each time they hit the surface of the coffin they only injury themselves as the snow covers them.

data.name: Solar Reverb
data.description: Focus the sun's radiance into a scorching blast that burns enemies and leaves searing light behind.
data.battleDescription: %user channels Amaterasu’s radiance into the battlefield beneath %target. Searing solar energy erupts on impact and continues to scorch the surrounding ground.

data.name: Radiant Embers
data.description: You release radiant embers that sap your target's strength while gathering into a protective solar shield around you.
data.battleDescription: %user conjures small solar orbs that dance around %target, weakening their attacks before forming a radiant shield around %user.

data.name: Celestial Ignition
data.description: This technique enables the user to focus their innate bloodline mastery. As light gathers around them, their jutsu flows more easily, enhancing offense while making it harder for enemies to face such blinding brilliance.
data.battleDescription: %user fuses wind and fire chakra into a veil of pure light, enhancing jutsu control while dazzling %target with blinding radiance.

data.name: Stormsinger
data.description: A powerful stormy chakra surrounds the user.
data.battleDescription: Calling upon the divine power of Susanoo, %user becomes one with the storm, their presence merging with the crackling energy in the air.

data.name: Sounds of Tempest
data.description: This jutsu channels lightning chakra through the target causing their very blood to become toxic to them.
data.battleDescription: As the tempest rages, %user's eyes begin to glow with a dark blue radiance, mirroring the eye of the storm growing within, intensifying the ferocity and might of the unleashed power. %user then melds the forces of lightning and water, birthing "Akuma no Arashi", a cataclysmic storm of unparalleled power. The merging elements surge forth, enveloping %target and battlefield, a single bolt of lightning strikes them.

data.name: Death’s Storm
data.description: This jutsu summons a powerful storm of intense winds and torrential rain. Its raindrops become sharp needles that pierce the enemy and weaken their attacks.
data.battleDescription: %user conjures a powerful storm, unleashing intense winds and torrential rain that soak %target(s). As the storm rages, the raindrops transform into sharp needles, piercing %target(s) and weakening the force of their attacks.

data.name: Wood Style: Wood Warrior Summon
data.description: Summon your ancestors’ sacred guardian.
data.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra to summon a towering wooden warrior, a living construct to shield and fight.

data.name: Guardian's Grove
data.description: Trap your enemy in a cave filled with poison.
data.battleDescription: %user traps %target in a wooden cave, inside the cave are poisonous plants that release toxic gas, debilitating %target

data.name: Forest Wisdom
data.description: Listen to your ancestors and learn from their previous battles.
data.battleDescription: %user stands still on the battlefield as a green aura surrounds them. They see memories of their ancestors' battles play out in front of them, blessing them with the wisdom of those long gone.

data.name: Eternal Forest
data.description: Trap your enemy in a never ending Forest.
data.battleDescription: %user claps their hands together and releases a massive amount of chakra, the earth starts to shake and crack open as massive tree limbs start shooting upward into the sky. Suddenly a branch springs forth dragging %target into the path of the onrushing roots.

data.name: Shadow Severance
data.description: Shadow Severance enables the user to seize control of the target's shadow, summoning a scythe from the darkness. Through swift and precise movements, the user delivers strikes that sever both the physical form and the shadow of the target, leaving them without identity or substance.
data.battleDescription: %user channels the power of the Shadow Weaver Bloodline, asserting dominance over %target's shadow. Emerging from the darkness, a scythe materializes, a manifestation of the shadow's chilling embrace. With unparalleled speed and precision, %user delivers devastating strikes, severing both the physical form and the shadow of %target, leaving them without an identity, a mere shell of their former self.

data.name: Nine Hell's Spear
data.description: Nine Hells Spear is the signature damage-dealing jutsu of the Hyouga Yui clan. It channels the frigid essence of Glacier into a spear of ice, capable of piercing through the toughest defenses.
data.battleDescription: As %user calls upon Nine Hells Spear, the air grows frigid. A spear of ice materializes in their hand, gleaming with an otherworldly light. With a swift motion, %user hurls the spear at the opponent, the icy projectile piercing through defenses and leaving behind a trail of frost.

data.name: Ice Palace
data.description: The sheer power of this jutsu serves as a testament to the user's profound connection with the icy elements
data.battleDescription: %user summons forth a great mist that obscure the vision of %target wrapped in this mist %target is taken into an icy palace, striken by the cold %target tries to escape but each step they take decreases their body temperature until they fall into a frozen coma

data.name: Glacier's Will
data.description: Tapping into their special chakra a Glacier Shinobi can reinvigorate themselves during battle.
data.battleDescription: As the battle rages, %user channels their unique chakra to invoke Glacier’s Will, enveloping themselves in a surging frosty aura and gleaming Ice Armor that bolsters defenses like an unbreakable glacial shield—fatigue instantly melts away, replaced by razor-sharp focus and renewed vigor. With the awakened fury of the Hyouga Yui bloodline, %user glides and dashes across the frozen terrain with blistering speed, each swift movement amplifying their strikes to deliver surging damage as they close in on foes with unbreakable resilience.

data.name: Glacial Shatter: Purgatory
data.description: The user creates a wave of freezing energy that shatters on impact, dealing widespread damage and freezing the surrounding area.
data.battleDescription: As %user invokes Glacial Shatter, a surge of frigid energy erupts. The wave crashes, shattering on impact, freezing the surrounding area and leaving %target trapped in a field of ice and frost, their movements slowed by the biting cold and their chakra consumption increased.

data.name: Glacial Descent: Cocytus
data.description: Disables the enemy with the cold strength of a glacier, decreasing their overall prowess while increasing yours.
data.battleDescription: Glacial Descent is a blizzard-style jutsu unique to the Hyouga Yui bloodline. It summons a tempest of icy winds and snowflakes, engulfing the battlefield in a swirling maelstrom of frost and sapphire hues.

data.name: Frostbound Ascendancy
data.description: Empowers the user’s ice jutsu, creating a frost field.
data.battleDescription: Drawing on the ancient power of the Teno Yuki, %user summons a surge of freezing energy. Their body becomes a conduit for the icy might of their bloodline, as frost spreads from their feet, enveloping the battlefield.

data.name: Cerulean Storm: Avalanche
data.description: Cerulean Storm is a blizzard-style jutsu unique to the Hyouga Yui bloodline. It summons a tempest of icy winds and snowflakes, engulfing the battlefield in a swirling maelstrom of frost and sapphire hues.
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes the ruthless power of the Hyouga Yui bloodline, eyes blazing with cold cerulean fury. Palms slam down—the earth shatters and flash-freezes into a vast, deadly ice field of jagged frost and slick mirrors under screaming arctic winds.

data.name: Arctic Frost
data.description: Coat your blade in ice chakra and attack your enemy
data.battleDescription: Empowered by Blue Blade Eyes, %user chills the blade in elemental energy, encasing it in ice.

data.name: Water Release
data.description: Surround yourself in a dome of water rejuvenating your mind and body
data.battleDescription: %user presses their feet to the ground, releasing water nature chakra that envelops them in a dome, the water chakra is filled with healing minerals that  slowly heals the %user wounds

data.name: Fire Style: Squirrel
data.description: A harmonious combination of speed and mobility, this Fire Style delivers intense heat and even greater speed
data.battleDescription: %user completes the Primal Radiance hand-seal, flames erupting to coat their body as a blazing fiery tail sprouts behind them. %user launches forward across the battlefield in a scorching dash, slamming into %target with explosive force—dealing heavy damage while the enveloping inferno boosts %user’s defense against retaliation, leaving a searing trail of embers in their wake.

data.name: Praise The Sun
data.description: Increases strength and resilience with sun's blessing.
data.battleDescription: %user raises their arms toward the sky, chanting a prayer to Amaterasu, the deity of the sun. As the chant reaches its peak, a radiant light descends upon %user, enveloping them in a warm, golden glow. This divine blessing increases %user's strength and resilience, empowering them with enhanced physical abilities and heightened chakra control. The light also creates a protective aura that reduces damage from incoming attacks, making %user a formidable presence on the battlefield. The radiance of Amaterasu's blessing inspires allies and strikes fear into the hearts of enemies, shifting the tides of battle in %user's favor.

data.name: Bakuretsu Nendo-Mushi
data.description: Creates small, explosive clay insects.
data.battleDescription: %user molds small insects out of clay, infusing them with explosive chakra. The tiny clay creatures scatter across the battlefield, moving swiftly and stealthily. At %user's command, the insects latch onto the opponent and detonate simultaneously, causing a series of sharp, concentrated explosions. The sudden blast disorients the opponent, leaving them vulnerable to further attacks.

data.name: Nendo Jirai
data.description: Creates a minefield of hidden explosive clay.
data.battleDescription: %user scatters pieces of clay across the battlefield, each infused with explosive chakra and carefully hidden beneath the surface. As the opponent moves, they unknowingly trigger the mines, setting off a series of explosions. The precise placement of the clay mines ensures maximum damage, trapping the opponent in a web of relentless blasts that leave little room for escape.

data.name: Hypnotic Annihilation (NS- SR Pierce)
data.battleDescription: %user uses jutsu on %target

data.name: Alluring Drain
data.description: With an irresistible gaze, Kaz channels a seductive and mystical energy, drawing life force directly from their target. The mesmerizing flow of violet energy weakens the victim while rejuvenating her, leaving a lingering sense of dominance and allure.
data.battleDescription: %user harnesses the overwhelming force of a fading sun, channeling its fiery wrath into their fist. As %user closes in on %target, scales shimmer momentarily across their skin, and a draconic power resonates through the air. With a single, devastating blow, %user’s strike lands with the force of the Twlight Dragon, leaving %target reeling from the sheer intensity.

data.name: Eternal Maw (永遠の顎)
data.description: A massive obsidian dragon’s maw erupts from the ground, trapping the target and crushing them with its flaming jaws.
data.battleDescription: %user summons an enormous obsidian dragon’s maw that erupts from the ground, snapping shut around %target. As the jaws close in with fiery devastation, %target’s final act of resistance is to whimper something about this being “unfair.” Reality check: the ninja world doesn’t give handouts.

data.name: Lilac Requiem: Thousand Agonies
data.description: With an alluring grace, Kaz ensnares their target in an illusion of lilac chains dripping with crimson light. These chains weave seductively around the victim, binding their senses and tearing at their very essence. As beauty and agony entwine, the target is left helpless in Kaz’s seductive nightmare.
data.battleDescription: %user summons shimmering lilac chains that dance with an enchanting glow, wrapping tightly around %target. The chains pulse with crimson energy, tearing through %target’s body with elegant precision. As %target succumbs to the illusion, %user exudes an irresistible aura, her beauty veiling the torment inflicted with every pulse of the chains.

data.name: Wrath of Avernus
data.description: An otherworldly power ignites within.
data.battleDescription: %user calls forth the Wrath of Avernus within as a terrifying shadowy flame surrounds them. In the blink of an eye they appear next to %target as shadow black flames begin to ignite across the battlefield.

data.name: Maple Lance: Wrath of the North
data.description: Forging a spear of crystallized maple essence and northern fury, the user charges through the battlefield, impaling foes and igniting their attacks with unstoppable momentum.
data.battleDescription: %user conjures a lance of gleaming maple crystal, surging forward in a blur of northern light. The strike pierces %target clean through, leaving them reeling as %user’s power surges—each attack hitting harder as the cold fury of the North grips the field.

data.name: Oni Hammer Swing
data.description: Opening a portal to the underworld, a large hand juts out to attack
data.battleDescription: %user summons a large portal from which a giant hand shoots out slamming down on %target

bloodline.name: Night Parade of A Thousand Demons

data.name: Corona Devourer Palm
data.description: Focus a ring of dense, light-devouring shadow around your hand, strike your opponent’s chest and leave a retaliatory shadow clinging to them.

effects.description: A black corona detonates under the ribs.
The stolen warmth returns to the user's marrow.

data.battleDescription: %user condenses a ring of light-devouring shadow around their hand and drives it into %target’s chest. The impact deals damage and leaves a shadow ring that turns part of %target’s subsequent attacks back on them.

data.name: Wind Release: Whirlwind Demise
data.description:
A raging windstorm that boosts power.

DON'T TRAIN. ALREADY CAPPED. IT HAS NO POWER PER LEVEL
data.battleDescription: %user conjures a fierce whirlwind, amplifying their strikes while reducing the impact of incoming attacks.

data.name: Pounce of the Lunar Prowler (Shadow Ambush)
data.battleDescription: %user lowers her stance and her shadow ripples, spilling forward into the shape of a many-eyed feline with no mouth and two tails. The creature coils around her form—then they vanish together in a single, silent lunge. She reappears behind %target in a blur of motion, her form still shrouded in shadows. Her form flickers unnaturally, half-submerged in darkness, too unstable to be struck cleanly.

data.name: Ichi no Kata: Kusanagi
data.description: The first movement of Tenshin Shoden Yami-Ryu, a layer of chakra surrounds the user giving them an air of magnitude.
data.battleDescription: %user draws their sword, and a violet-colored glow of chakra flows from it, engulfing them. With each strike at %user, the chakra seems to lash out in defense.

data.name: Tide Release
data.description: Surround yourself in a dome of water rejuvenating your mind and body
data.battleDescription: %user presses their feet to the ground, releasing water nature chakra that envelops them in a dome, the water chakra is filled with healing minerals that  slowly heals the %user wounds

data.name: Obsidian Tomb
data.description: Command black skeletal rods to crush your target and seal their ability to apply buffs while hardened marrow protects you from incoming debuffs.

effects.description: Obsidian ribs form a heavy skeletal barrier.
The rib sanctuary rejects hostile chakra interference.

data.battleDescription: %user summons obsidian rods that erupt from the ground and crash into %target with crushing force. The impact deals damage and seals %target’s ability to apply buffs while hardened marrow shields %user from harmful effects.

data.name: Final Phantasm
data.description: Channel extinction chakra into a devastating genjutsu that pierces your target and leaves them vulnerable to further damage.
data.battleDescription: %user chants with blazing eyes, trapping %target in an endless void of erasure. The illusion tears through their defenses and leaves their mind exposed to further attacks.

data.name: Water Dome
data.description: The user conjures a water field around him, increasing the potency of his water style
data.battleDescription: %user invokes the help of the sea, water rapidly emanating from his body, creating a dome around him, hindering %target attacks.

data.name: Godstorm Mantle: Storm-God's Heart
data.description: Tapping into the ragged cries of the storm god that Aegis once heard, the user channels that pure grief into a spiraling vortex of purple lightning. The resulting atmospheric detonation leaves targets vulnerable to all incoming elements.

effects.description: The storm god's cry detonates as violet lightning.
The blast leaves the target cracked open to follow-up force.

data.battleDescription: %user raises a hand as mournful thunder answers, weaving the Storm God’s grief into a mantle of violet lightning. The tempest erupts around %target, its crackling arcs shattering their defenses before detonating in a radiant eclipse of thunder.

data.name: Godstorm Mantle: Heavenbreaker Verdict
data.description: The user parts the clouds above, unleashing a colossal beam of pure storm pressure down a direct line. This linear surge completely ignores defensive measures and scatters the target's offensive focus.

effects.description: The verdict tears through guard and armor.
The storm breaks the target's offensive rhythm.

data.battleDescription: %user tears open the stormbound heavens as pressure condenses into a colossal pillar of violet lightning. The beam crashes down in a flawless line, piercing defenses and striking %target with verdict-like force that breaks their offensive rhythm and weakens their attacks.

data.name: Godstorm Mantle: Raijin's Cage
data.description: The user calls down massive pillars of violet electricity to trap an opponent inside a localized lightning matrix. This oppressive cage crushes the target under immense barometric pressure, locking away their bloodline mechanics.

effects.description: A thunder prison crushes the target.
Thunder pressure arrests the target's movement.

data.battleDescription: %user calls down towering pillars of violet lightning as the battlefield fractures into a sealed storm matrix around %target. The Raijin’s Cage compresses inward with crushing barometric pressure, striking them with relentless arcs that lock their movements and suppress their bloodline flow beneath oppressive electrical confinement.

data.name: Midnight Verdict
data.description: A sharp, blade-thin line of solid shadow flashes horizontally across the battlefield. This dark edge bypasses physical guards entirely, leaving targets paralyzed under the sheer weight of its judgment.

effects.description: The verdict passes through guard and flesh alike.
The target's next movement catches on the black line.

data.battleDescription: %user releases a blade-thin line of condensed shadow that flashes horizontally across the battlefield. The Midnight Verdict bypasses physical defenses, dealing piercing damage and stunning %target under crushing pressure.

data.name: Black Sun Cataract
data.description: Channeling the heavy malice of Eclipse, the user molds obsidian chakra to manifest a collapsed, black sun. Coming from the collapsed star, are bones coated in obsidian that erodes targets chakra network.

effects.description: A collapsed sun of shadow-fire crushes the target.
The eclipse leaves burning cracks in the target's bones.

data.battleDescription: %user forms a collapsed black sun of obsidian chakra that rains jagged bones upon %target. The impact deals damage, poisons %target, and leaves festering wounds that continue to weaken them.

data.name: Void Monarch's Decree
data.description: The user speaks a syllable in the tongue of dead galaxies. The command rewrites local physics—wounds become permanent, healing becomes impossible, and the target's defenses crumble like sand before the tide.

effects.description: Applies wound damage over multiple turns based on damage dealt

data.battleDescription: %user's voice drops to a register that vibrates in the marrow as they utter %jutsu. The word *IS* law—%target's armor dissolves into motes of shadow, their regeneration seals shut by cosmic decree. Every impact now carves deeper, every wound becomes a portal to the void. %user watches with cold satisfaction as the battlefield bends to their will.

data.name: Supernova Collapse
data.description: The user detonates a miniature star inside the target's chakra network. The implosion scorches their pathways with stellar radiation, instantly converting vitality into void-energy while the backlash sears the user's own spirit.

effects.description: Deal damage based on Chakra and Stamina lost
Instantly heal yourself based on a percentage of the damage dealt by this jutsu

data.battleDescription: %user's palm presses against empty air as %jutsu ignites a dying star within %target's chest. Golden light erupts from their orifices—then inverts into absolute black. %target's chakra pathways crystallize with radioactive poison as their life force rips free, flooding %user. The feedback loop burns %user's own soul with each stolen heartbeat.

data.name: Shattering Pizza
data.description: Uses the power of the fire from the pizza oven to create clones and distort perception.
data.battleDescription: With a flick of their wrists %user uses the power and light from thousands of pizza ovens to create multiple clones of themselves that disorient %target. The illusions copy %target's attacks perfectly back at them, leaving %target unsure of the actual %user's position. All illusions seem so real that %user is able to land a precise blow from the side-lines, taking full advantage of %target's confused and disoriented state.

data.name: Lightning Release
data.description: Encase yourself in lightning natured chakra
data.battleDescription: %user generates lightning nature charka around their entire body

data.name: Tranquil Guard Flowing Form
data.description: Honed through years of practising the staff, stand firm as you block all incoming damage.
data.battleDescription: %user flows into Tranquil Guard, staff held firm as a steady aura surrounds them. With each controlled strike, they deal measured damage while weakening %target’s power, their blows softened against the user’s guarded form.

data.name: Enduring Resonance Ward
data.description: Endurance is strength.
data.battleDescription: %user raises their guard as a resonant aura hums around them. When %target strikes, the ward absorbs the blow and pulses outward, rebounding the force back and damaging %target in return.

data.name: Pivoting Fortress
data.description: The master once said, Footwork is the key, one must be fluid, flexible but not break
data.battleDescription: %user rotates from one stance to the next, fluid in motion and sure of step. Their strike lands without leaving room for reprisal.

data.name: Storm Release
data.description: Encase yourself in lightning natured chakra
data.battleDescription: %user generates lightning nature charka around their entire body

data.name: Timelapse
data.description: Timelapse is a high-level temporal sand jutsu that manipulates the perception and flow of time within a confined area.
data.battleDescription: %user slams their hand to the ground, releasing a spiraling formation of fine, golden sand that coils upward like an inverted hourglass. The sand rotates in slow, deliberate motion, suspended in the air slowing %targets attack

data.name: Timeshift
data.description: Timeshift is an aggressive counterpart to Timelapse, embodying the destructive side of time rather than its restraint.
data.battleDescription: %user snaps their hands together, compressing sand infused with volatile temporal chakra before hurling it toward %target. Upon impact, the sand erupts into a fractured hourglass formation around the enemy, spinning violently as if time itself has been forced to accelerate

data.name: Eternity Flux
data.description: Eternity Flux is a precision-based sand jutsu that weaponizes a single, endless instant.
data.battleDescription: %user draws sand into a tight, orbiting ring around their arm, compressing it until the grains vibrate with unstable chronal energy. With a sharp forward motion, the sand is released in a linear burst, striking the %target

data.name: Ashes of Eternity
data.description: Through prolonged eye contact or a hand seal, the user traps the target in a looping illusion where they experience their life decaying repeatedly—aging, losing loved ones, and fading into dust.
data.battleDescription: %user forms a hand seal, locking eyes with %target, who’s trapped in a loop of aging and loss. %target collapses, clutching their head. %user binds them before the illusion fades.

data.name: Mirage of the end
data.description: The user gestures or hums a low, resonant tone, projecting an illusion of a barren wasteland where the target’s loved ones or village lie in ruin. The despair saps their will to fight.
data.battleDescription: %user hums a mournful tune, and %target sees a wasteland with their allies dead. %target hesitates, jutsu faltering. %user throws a smoke bomb, closing in to bind %target with wire.

data.name: Shadow Severance NEW
data.description: Shadow Severance enables the user to seize control of the target's shadow, summoning a scythe from the darkness
data.battleDescription: Shadow Severance enables the user to seize control of the target's shadow, summoning a scythe from the darkness

data.name: Baka Slash: Blade of Rejection
data.description: Don’t get the wrong idea—this is for ME
data.battleDescription: %user lunges with a smirk and a blush, slicing the %target while yelling romantic nonsense. The blade flares with Love-each cut messes with the victim’s emotional center.

data.name: Limited Edition Fanblade
data.description: Signed by the voice actor. Sharp enough to decapitate
data.battleDescription: %user swings the enormous fan-shaped blade with flair. As the edge connects, the air fills with distorted J-pop, stunning here %target and slicing their pride.

data.name: Waifu Hunter’s Spear
data.description: You called her 'mid'? Now you die
data.battleDescription: %user spins her anime-branded spear, declaring vengeance for her digital love. The final thrust pierces the %target honor.

data.name: Possessing Yurei
data.description: Summoning up a Yurei from the underworld to possess the target
data.battleDescription: %target finds they've lost most control over their body as they are dominated by this otherworldly creature.

bloodline.name: Night Parade of A Thousand Demons

data.name: Children of the Full Moon (Shadow Dance)
data.battleDescription: %user lifts her hand, and the full moon blooms above—unnaturally bright, summoned by will alone. Her shadow twists into a ring of grotesque yet adorable creatures with hollow eyes and stitched smiles. They skip toward %target like children in a parade… circling %target in a joyful spiral, clapping, twirling, laughing as they start to sink into the shadows.  In that moment, %user is gone with only laughter remaining. The strike lands without form or mercy. Every blow that follows hits harder, like the encore of a show no one applauded.

data.name: Cry of the Waxing Crescent (Shadow Severence)
data.battleDescription: %user draws a silent sigil in the air, and her shadow coils behind her, unfurling into the shape of a long-legged fox with antlers of flickering chakra. It glides toward %target and opens its mouth—not to bite, but to screech. The sound is sharp and impossible to perceive, like torn memory or splitting bone—not heard, but felt. Thought shatters. Focus slips. Every enhancement clinging to %target unravels like thread under a blade.

data.name: Singularity III
data.description: Fold the battlefield inward. Trap the enemy in a freezing knot of pressure and potential.
data.battleDescription: With the quiet authority of a collapsing star, %user channels a surge of unstable, paradox-forged chakra into a single point. Reality starts to wince. Light refracts sideways. Air forgets how to circulate. Then it happens. Space folds—not around %user, but around %target. There is no warning, no flash. Just sudden pressure. Crushing. Absolute. Like the world is hugging too hard out of spite. Frozen mid-motion, %target is trapped in a moment that won’t let go. A singularity pulses at their core, invisible but unrelenting. They are suspended—not paralyzed by force, but by inevitability. The air snaps cold. Time hiccups. And with each slow, delayed pulse, compressed force shears at their body, chakra, and confidence—damage unwinding with surgical cruelty.

data.name: Yon no Kata: Muramasa
data.description: The final movement of Tenshin Shoden Yami-Ryu, it is often regarded as a failed technique since it does not flow with the others. Not many know this as they are simply not taught it.
data.battleDescription: %user accumulates chakra at the edge of their blade. With a hefty swing, the chakra is launched at %target marking them. The chakra invades %target 's body, crippling their movement.

data.name: Breakpoint Genesis
data.description: Fractures the Architect’s identity across parallel runtimes, forcing the world to render multiple truths simultaneously.
data.battleDescription: %user executes Breakpoint Genesis on %target, rupturing time and space as flickering phantoms of themself phase in and out of existence—the battlefield now struggling to decide which instance is real.

data.name: Surging Sun Dash - LR
data.description: Charges forward at lightning speed, delivering a powerful blow.
data.battleDescription: %user begins to move with a fluid grace, their steps light and almost imperceptible. As they dance across the battlefield, arcs of lightning trail behind them, connecting their movements like a web of energy. This dance isn’t just for show—each movement is a setup for a rapid strike, with %user appearing and disappearing around the opponent in a series of blindingly fast attacks. The lightning enhances their agility, making them almost impossible to hit, while every strike they land sends a jolt of electricity coursing through their opponent’s body. The battlefield becomes a stage, with %user orchestrating a deadly performance of speed, precision, and raw lightning power.

data.name: Ashen Theory
data.description: A lingering curse rooted in lost science. Damage, decay, and effect details have been classified by order of seichi’s highest council.
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes Ashen Theory, the weaponized aftermath of forgotten knowledge. What it does to %target is uncertain—only the decay is measurable.

data.name: Zero Hour Protocol
data.description: A last resort jutsu sealed in high level archives. Effects are unknown.
data.battleDescription: %user initiates Zero Hour Protocol. No light or sound heralds it. Only devastation. %target is affected by an outcome that remains sealed by every known village.

data.name: Promethean Core
data.description: An ancient technique tied to forbidden kn owledge. The source and side effects are strictly classified.
data.battleDescription: %user channels forbidden energy stolen from the divine. %target is consumed by a force once thought myth—its nature redacted in all records.

data.name: Judgment Blade
data.description: The user summons a radiant sword forged from pure light. The blade is capable of cutting through anything with ease, whether it be physical defenses, chakra barriers, or even spiritual barriers. Its edge is said to embody the essence of divine judgment, and any strike with the blade is an execution of righteousness, delivering punishment to those who are guilty of evil acts.
data.battleDescription: %user manifests a gleaming blade of divine energy, slashing through %target with righteous force, delivering unavoidable judgment

data.name: Divine Descent
data.description: Divine Descent channels the pure might of heavenly light, summoning a massive column of radiant energy that descends from the sky, striking the battlefield with divine fury. This technique is a cataclysmic strike designed to obliterate large groups of enemies and cleanse the area of corruption.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a spear of celestial light, hurling it from the heavens toward %target, erupting on impact in radiant, purifying devastation.

data.name: Corrupted Flame Dance
data.description: Illusionary flames that seem all too real to be "Just in your head"
data.battleDescription: %target sees flames sporadically sprung up around them, these flames seem to originate from %user and seem to come in a wave like pattern. The flames bridge the gap between illusion and reality and seem to dance with the movements of %user increasing the strength of their attacks.

data.name: Unholy Blight
data.description: An unholy fire that burns away everything.
data.battleDescription: %user is blessed by the unholy flames of the Infernal Demon. With every attack, shadowy black flames seem to engulf %target burning away all their preparations for the battle ahead.

data.name: Grand Detonation
data.description: Unleashes a massive explosion of clay, causing widespread devastation.
data.battleDescription: %user molds a large, intricate sculpture from clay, infusing it with a tremendous amount of explosive chakra. As %user completes the technique, they hurl the sculpture towards %target, where it rapidly expands before erupting into a massive explosion. The detonation creates a shockwave that flattens everything in its path, leaving nothing but destruction in its wake. The sheer power of the blast disorients and severely injures %target, making this jutsu one of the most devastating in the Detonating Clay arsenal.

data.name: Long time no seeeeee (GP - VS Drain)
data.battleDescription: %user uses jutsu on %target

data.name: Mind Trick (EC)
data.battleDescription: %user uses jutsu on %target

data.name: World Smash
data.description: New jutsu description
data.battleDescription: %User focuses all his Chakra into his fist or foot, till its vibrating with chakra. He delivers a blow so powerful to his  %target. It can change the weather itself. The powerful chakra invades his %target , and replenishes %User's Health.

data.name: Chakra Transfer
data.description: New jutsu description
data.battleDescription: %User concentrates briefly, locking on to his target's chakra force. %User savagely rips some of his target's chakra from them and uses it to reinforce his own power.

data.name: Nature's Fury
data.description: Nature's Fury unleashes the raw power of the natural world in a devastating offensive technique.
data.battleDescription: %user kneels and places their hands on the ground, sending a surge of chakra deep into the earth. The ground trembles as %user's energy courses through it, and a moment later, thick, thorny vines and gnarled roots burst forth in a violent eruption. The relentless tendrils snake towards %target, striking with the speed and precision of a predator. Thorns dig into flesh, and the crushing force of the roots batters %target from all sides. Each strike of the vines brings %target closer to defeat as %user commands nature's wrath to its fullest, leaving their adversary ensnared and ravaged by the sheer might of the earth itself.

data.name: Hypnotic Prism
data.description: Creates an illusion of a prismatic prison that entraps the target’s mind, body and soul.
data.battleDescription: %user’s hand forms a seal, conjuring a prism of shimmering water that sings with the melody of sirens. The prism engulfs %target's elemental attack, absorbing its essence into its depths. Empowered by the stolen energy, %user unleashes a rapid barrage of strikes, each infused with the hypnotic resonance of the siren's song, disorienting and overwhelming %target.

data.name: Bakuretsu Nendo-Tori
data.description: Launches explosive clay birds at targets.
data.battleDescription: %user shapes several birds from clay, infusing them with explosive chakra before sending them into the sky. The clay birds soar gracefully, their flight path unpredictable. At %user's signal, the birds dive towards %target, exploding on impact. The resulting concussive blasts send shockwaves through the air, disorienting %target and creating openings for subsequent attacks.

data.name: Ni no Kata: Murakumo
data.description: The second movement of Tenshin Shoden Yami-Ryu, a severing slash
data.battleDescription: %user draws their blade as both the weapon and their eyes begin to illuminate a purple haze. %user casts their gaze at %target a look of pure indifference before a devastating slash passes through them, severing their chakra pathways.

data.name: Lilac Illusion Chains
data.description: Summoning an intricate web of lilac-colored chains adorned with glowing orchids, Kaz ensnares their target in a captivating yet oppressive illusion. The chains bind the mind and spirit, inflicting psychological torment while sapping the target's strength. The haunting beauty of the orchids masks the dangerous and dominating nature of this technique.
data.battleDescription: %user conjures lilac-colored chains that shimmer with a mystical glow, wrapping tightly around %target. The orchids adorning the chains radiate an alluring yet oppressive energy, breaking %target’s will as they are enveloped in the illusion. %user stands empowered as the chains drain %target's resolve and strength.

data.name: Elemental Harmony Chant
data.description: Sing chants to manipulate dust particles and air, damaging the enemy’s skin and weakening them.
data.battleDescription: %user begins the Elemental Harmony Chant, their melodic voice weaving a spellbinding tune. As the enchanting melody resonates, dust particles dance to the rhythm, lacerating the enemy's skin. Simultaneously, the air surrounding %target is manipulated, and forcefully expelled from their lungs, weakening their strength and healing capacity due to lack of oxygen.

data.name: Dust Devil
data.description: A devastating attack with a blade of earth
data.battleDescription: %user performs a gesture, calling forth a tempest of sand and dust that clings to their weapon’s edge. They lift their weapon high, poised for a devastating blow. Then, with a great effort, %user swings the blade at %target, sending a massive arc of dust slicing through the air, This dusty shroud spirals into a formidable twister, ensnaring %target within its wrath. Buffeted by the relentless storm, %target staggers, pelted and battered by the relentless assault of sand and stone.

data.name: Needle and Thread
data.description: Attack the target's pressure points with needles
data.battleDescription: %user coalesces the ambient dust into a swarm of invisible needles. Silently, they launch this assault at %target’s vital chakra points. As the needles find their mark, %user unleashes a potent surge of chakra through them, throwing %target’s internal energies into disarray and damaging their control over their own chakra flow.

data.name: Ethereal Dragon's Whispers
data.description: Entrancing and bewildering auditory illusion, immersing the target in an otherworldly symphony that blurs the line between reality and deception.
data.battleDescription: Using the Skybreak Dragon's affinity for manipulating wind and sound, %user creates an illusory soundscape of distant dragon roars and fluttering wings. This genjutsu not only disorients %target's sense of hearing but also creates phantom sensations, making it difficult for %target to distinguish reality from illusion.

data.name: Fiend Fire
data.description: A destructive fire jutsu that scorches on impact and continues to burn over time.
data.battleDescription: %user conjures an unstable mass of fire chakra, shaping it into a spiraling flame that howls as it tears through the air. Upon impact with %target, the blast erupts violently, igniting their body with cursed flame. The initial strike sears flesh and chakra alike, while the lingering fire continues to eat away at their endurance long after contact.

data.name: Black Crow
data.description: Release crows from the darkest parts of the earth to leech the life from your enemies.
data.battleDescription: %user quickly performs hand signs as their shadow grows and covers the battlefield in a dome. Within the dome, crows as dark as night begin to fly above %target. Stretching their hand outward toward %target, %user sends the crows diving into them and tearing at their flesh. Each bite slowly infuses %user with health.

data.name: Fireball
data.description: A blazing fireball that deals damage and inflicts burning damage over time.
data.battleDescription: %user forms rapid hand seals and expels a massive sphere of flame from their mouth. The fireball engulfs %target in a wave of searing heat, dealing immediate damage on impact. Flames continue to cling to the target’s body, burning persistently and inflicting additional pain over time.

data.name: Molten Manipulation
data.description: A searing fire technique that burns the enemy and leaves them more vulnerable to all future attacks.
data.battleDescription: %user shapes raw fire chakra into a molten surge that scorches %target on impact. The intense heat lingers, warping their defenses and amplifying incoming damage from any source.

data.name: Retribution
data.description: A brutal chakra-fueled attack that devastates the target and heightens the user’s ninjutsu power
data.battleDescription: Chakra surges violently through %user’s veins as they step forward, eyes blazing with fury. The air distorts around them, a  pressure so intense it hums with power. With a swift motion, they unleash a devastating strike that slams into %target, the impact echoing like a thunderclap. The backlash ignites within %user, feeding off their resolve and amplifying their ninjutsu to monstrous levels. The very atmosphere trembles, as if acknowledging their unleashed wrath.

data.name: Verdant Bastion
data.description: Verdant Bastion surrounds you with restorative flora, healing your wounds and increasing the healing received by allies within its reach.
data.battleDescription: With a surge of focused chakra, %user summons Verdant Bastion. Emerald foliage closes around %user's wounds while its restorative energy spreads across the area, strengthening the healing received by nearby allies.

data.name: Kijo's Benevolence
data.description: Kijo's Benevolence creates a protective aura that absorbs damage for allies and increases the healing they receive.
data.battleDescription: As %user focuses their chakra, Kijo's Benevolence spreads across the battlefield as a protective aura, absorbing harm for allies and strengthening the healing they receive.

data.name: Smokescreen Assault
data.description: Unleashes a smoke blast that obscures vision and chokes.
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes a swirling gust mixed with smoke, obscuring %target’s vision and reducing the force of their attacks

data.name: Chakra Siphon
data.description: A jutsu that damages the enemy and makes future jutsu cost less chakra and stamina.
data.battleDescription: %user strikes %target with a spiraling pulse of chakra that draws energy back into their own network. The drain weakens the target while refining the user’s internal flow, allowing upcoming jutsu to be cast with less effort and cost.

data.name: Molten Fury
data.description: A genjutsu that deals damage and inflicts lingering mental burns.
data.battleDescription: %user locks eyes with %target and initiates a searing genjutsu where molten lava pours from the sky, engulfing the target in a hellish illusion. Though the damage is purely mental, the torment lingers, causing %target to feel continuous internal burning that chips away at their psyche each turn. The illusion blurs reality, leaving them unsure if the pain will ever stop.

data.name: Crimson Surge
data.description: A punishing chakra strike that damages the enemy and makes their jutsu cost more chakra and stamina.
data.battleDescription: %user launches a surge of volatile chakra that tears into %target’s system. The strike damages them directly and scrambles their inner flow, forcing them to burn more energy when casting jutsu.

data.name: Netherblight
data.description: A corrupting curse that damages the enemy over time while steadily healing the user.
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes a lingering chakra curse that seeps into %target’s system. As the affliction eats away at them, dark energy flows back to the caster, gradually restoring their vitality with every passing second.

data.name: Corrupting Miasma
data.description: You spread a cloud of poisonous chakra across the battlefield and draw strength from its corrupting haze.
data.battleDescription: %user exhales a swirling mist of dark green and purple poison. As the toxic haze spreads across the battlefield, %user draws it inward and intensifies their strongest abilities.

data.name: KGK: KX Hollow Surge
data.description: An unstable enhancement technique born from early KX experimentation, KX Hollow Surge forces violent chakra throughout the user’s body to overwhelm nearby targets through relentless offensive pressure. Those struck by the surge find their defenses destabilized as the corrupted energy leaves them increasingly vulnerable to follow-up attacks.
data.battleDescription: Violent chakra erupts around %user as KX Hollow Surge tears across the battlefield, the unstable energy overwhelming %target and leaving their defenses exposed beneath the crushing pressure.

data.name: KGK: Black Fang Lance
data.description: A concentrated piercing technique utilized by Kuroganekai execution units to overwhelm enemy defenses through relentless offensive pressure. Black Fang Lance condenses violent chakra around the user’s strike, driving through targets with enough force to amplify subsequent attacks.
data.battleDescription: %user lunges while forging a spear of violet chakra and takes shape into a ravenous beast of energy roaring towards %target that tears forward in a brutal piercing assault.

data.name: Final Boss Phase 2
data.description: Ensnares all in unending lunar stillness.
data.battleDescription: %user calls forth the moon’s eternal stillness, casting a shadow of timeless peace across the battlefield. In this serene dominion, both %user and %target find themselves unable to alter their power or weaknesses. The world seems to hold its breath, as all movement of strength and vulnerability is frozen beneath the moon's unwavering glow.

data.name: TGC
data.description: Brings down a lightning-infused hammer to crush all in its path.
data.battleDescription: %user summons the divine power of Izanagi’s hammer, creating an anvil of thunderous energy in the sky. With a mighty roar, the hammer descends, crashing into %target with the force of a divine judgment. The impact creates a shockwave of pure lightning, obliterating everything in its path and leaving a crater in the ground, charged with residual electricity that continues to wreak havoc on any nearby foes.

data.description: A formidable technique using friction

data.battleDescription: %user channels his chakra into a focal point in fronnt of him. With a quick hand sign, %user unleashes the chakra in the form of a lazor beam, burning %target to a crisp

data.name: Parry
data.description:
A precise defensive counter that boosts the user’s bukijutsu damage and reduces the opponent’s offensive output.

DON'T TRAIN. ALREADY CAPPED. IT HAS NO POWER PER LEVEL
data.battleDescription: %user deflects an incoming blow with masterful control, twisting their stance into a sharp counter. The technique shifts the tide of battle—amplifying their own weapon-based attacks while disrupting %target’s ability to strike with full force.

data.name: Phoenix Flame Illusion
data.description: Creates an illusion of a phoenix attacking with flames.
data.battleDescription: %user weaves a swift sequence of hand seals, unleashing an illusion of a colossal phoenix made of pure fire. The flaming bird ascends into the sky, then dives straight through %target in a blinding cascade of light. Though no physical flames touch them, the burning vision scorches their senses, delivering powerful mental damage.

data.name: Onibaba's Laughter
data.description: "Onibaba's Laughter" is a haunting Genjutsu that unleashes eerie laughter through the target's mind.
data.battleDescription: As %user weaves the intricate hand seals for Onibaba's Laughter, the air grows heavy with a foreboding chill, swirling around %target like a sinister embrace. Shadows dance with malicious glee, twisting into spectral forms that cackle and jeer, their voices a haunting symphony of madness. %target's senses are assaulted by the cacophony, each laugh like a dagger to their psyche, sowing seeds of doubt and confusion. The world around %target warps and distorts, reality blending with illusion as they struggle against the relentless tide of terror.

data.name: Holy Obliteration
data.description: Call down holy power to smite your disgusting enemies.
data.battleDescription: %user raises his arms to the sky, praising the sun. %target feels the warmth, compelling them to raise their arms to the sky as well. Suddenly, %target bursts into flames, screaming, and then collapsing onto the ground in a pile of ash.

data.name: Siren's Allure
data.description: You envelop the target in an alluring illusion, causing infatuation.
data.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra into the air, summoning a cyclone infused with a siren’s enchanting song. The wind spirals gracefully around the opponent, its melodic whispers luring them into a trance. Disoriented by the swirling air and shimmering allure, the opponent struggles to resist as their senses falter, leaving them vulnerable to %user's control.

data.name: Mermaid's Lyre
data.description: Conjures a cyclone that lures the target into a false sense of bliss while draining their life force.
data.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra into a harmonious melody, evoking the soothing song of mythical mermaids. The melody manifests as two swirling cyclones of elemental chakra, their movements graceful yet commanding. With precise control, %user guides the cyclones to dance around %target, their siren-like resonance disorienting and captivating the foe before converging with unrelenting force

data.name: S'more Surprise
data.description: Teni skewers the opponent and covers them in chocolate and graham crackers. She then roasts them over a fire, absorbing their life force and healing herself as she cackles with glee.
data.battleDescription: With a wicked grin, %user impales her opponent on a skewer and douses them in chocolate and crushed graham crackers. Igniting a chakra-fueled fire, she roasts them over the flames, absorbing their life force and healing her own wounds. The %target is left charred and weakened, their energy drained to fuel %user’s sinister delight.

data.name: Michigan Smash
data.description: New jutsu description
data.battleDescription: %user starts to condense his chakra into his finger. He Flicks this at his %target with blinding speed, power. Blasting his opponent back, making him susceptible to further damage.

data.name: Mind Cognizance (EA)
data.battleDescription: %user uses jutsu on %target

data.name: Starlit Void
data.description: Black hole punch jutsu that backfires.
data.battleDescription: KyoRuedrig places his hand on the ground, lifting both himself and %target up into the heavens above. The ground floats between the twin Gemini stars, which begin to rotate at high speeds, creating a black hole between them. As KyoRuedrig aims to strike %target with a powerful punch, the chaotic energies of the Wonderland Gemini bloodline cause the punch to veer off course. Instead of hitting %target, KyoRuedrig misses and accidentally punches himself into the black hole. The black hole swallows KyoRuedrig entirely, leaving %target bewildered and unscathed, a testament to the perilous nature of wielding such chaotic power.

data.name: Draconic Clash (竜神の衝突)
data.description: Dusk summons two draconic constructs—one of fire and one of shadow—that clash in a cataclysmic explosion, damaging and exposing enemies.
data.battleDescription: %user conjures two enormous dragons—fire and shadow—colliding them in a catastrophic explosion that shakes the battlefield. %target, in their infinite brilliance, decides to stand right in the middle, as if hoping to “reason” with dragons made of pure destruction. How’s that working out, %target? Oh wait, it’s not.

data.name: Cosmic Aura
data.description: The user’s presence warps reality, forming a celestial aura that suppresses the enemy’s strength while shielding them from harm. Space bends around them, reducing the impact of incoming attacks.
data.battleDescription: %user emanates a radiant cosmic aura, distorting space itself. Stars shimmer in their wake as their presence suppresses %target’s power.

data.name: Cosmic Chains
data.description: The user summons ethereal cosmic chains, forged from celestial energy, to bind their target. These luminous restraints drain power, suppressing their abilities while making them more vulnerable to attacks.
data.battleDescription: %user extends their hand, summoning radiant cosmic chains from the void. The glowing restraints lash out, binding %target as celestial energy siphons their strength. Gravity warps around them, their power fading under the weight of the stars.

data.name: Earthen Fortitude
data.description: A ruthless earth strike that damages the enemy and cripples their offensive power.
data.battleDescription: %user shatters the ground with Earthen Fortitude, crushing %target under brutal force and sapping their strength to leave their attacks feeble.

data.name: Killer Instinct
data.description: Summon heavy mists that sap the energy from your enemies and hide you from sight
data.battleDescription: Madcrep draws in the Nature energy around him, fueling his flame

data.name: Blighted Tree
data.description: A withered, blighted tree takes root in the target’s mind, its twisted branches spreading decay through their thoughts.
data.battleDescription: %user manifests a twisted, withered tree deep within %target's mind. Its diseased branches creep through their thoughts, sowing confusion and corrupting their focus.

data.name: Chakra Overload
data.description: Disrupts and destabilizes the target's chakra flow, making their network unstable and highly vulnerable to attacks.
data.battleDescription: %user focuses intensely, flooding %target’s chakra network with an overabundance of raw chakra. The sheer force surges through %target’s tenketsu points

data.name: Infernal Curse
data.description: Shadow-like flames engulf the target.
data.battleDescription: %user surrounds %target in a dark shadowy flame, weakening them significantly. The flames seem to beckon to %user causing all their attacks to hit %target that much harder.

data.name: Judgment’s Wrath
data.description: The user summons an array of radiant spears or swords from the heavens, each imbued with judgment and valor. These ethereal weapons rain down from above or can be hurled at the enemy, piercing through armor and chakra defenses. The spears burn with purifying light and leave lasting marks of divine judgment on the battlefield.
data.battleDescription: %user calls forth a storm of divine energy, striking %target with relentless golden bolts, each blast delivering righteous devastation.

data.name: Shield  Dust
data.description: A delicate yet relentless frost coats the target, dealing damage while preventing them from enhancing their power. No matter how they struggle, the chilling grip of the snowflake dust holds them back.
data.battleDescription: A shimmering cloud of frost swirls from %user, engulfing %target in a flurry of enchanted snowflakes. The icy dust seeps into their chakra, disrupting their energy and locking away their ability to grow stronger.

data.name: A  Frost Dot
data.description: A relentless surge of arctic air engulfs the target, dealing damage while inflicting frostbite. The numbing cold saps their power, weakening their body and suppressing their potential.
data.battleDescription: A wave of piercing cold surges from %user, crashing into %target with icy force. Frost clings to their body, seeping deep into their skin as the lingering chill drains their strength.

data.name: S Command Pierce
data.description: A commanding surge of sapphire chakra that strikes with devastating precision. This technique fortifies the user against damage while propelling them forward, allowing them to close in on their target with relentless force.
data.battleDescription: A brilliant sapphire light erupts from %user, cutting through %target with precise, piercing force. The energy surrounds %user like a protective aura as they surge forward, closing the distance with unstoppable momentum.

data.battleDescription: %user activates Project Trinity, invoking the original forbidden technique. What follows is not recorded—only the aftermath remains.

data.name: Core Directive: Reforge
data.description: Overwrites the Architect’s current form with the original divine design, surpassing all limitations—at a cost
data.battleDescription: %user activates Core Directive: Reforge on themself, tearing muscle and bone into compliance as their body reforms into its optimal prototype—unstable, burning, and untouchable.

data.name: Collapse Into Form
data.description: Extracts raw potential from ambient code and weaponizes it into absolute spears written into the world’s memory.
data.battleDescription: %user executes Collapse Into Form on %target, tearing lances of decompiled light from the air and hurling them into the core of reality—each one a final sentence in a paragraph of deletion.

data.name: Frostbite Grip: O Canada Clutch
data.description: Summoning the unyielding cold of the far North, the user traps their foe in a crushing grip of ice and pride—binding them in place and delivering a bone-cracking blow
data.battleDescription: %user slams their hand down as a surge of jagged ice erupts beneath %target, locking them in place like a winter freeze. The ice constricts, cracking with national pride, leaving %target frozen stiff and wide open for more.

data.name: Cosmic Hiss
data.description: A quantum-charged hiss that tears through probability, disorienting foes and absorbing damage into a spatial veil.
data.battleDescription: %user arches their back, ears flattening as they unleash a multidimensional HISSSSS—reverberating with dark matter. The space around them fractures like glass, creating a gravitational shield. Nearby enemies are struck by an intense wave of unease as space snarls around them, increasing the damage they take and shielding %user in cosmic furred defiance.

data.name: Nebula Pounce
data.description: A blur of ears, tail, and starlight, %user warps across space and lands with a celestial slam, suppressing their target.
data.battleDescription: With a wiggle of the hips and a mischievous grin, %user vanishes into a ripple of stardust. A heartbeat later, they POUNCE from the stars above, claws sheathed in quantum fire. Their target is slammed into the ground, wrapped in gravitational bindings shaped like shimmering paws and tails, left dazed and vulnerable.

data.name: Nya Strike
data.description: A finishing move filled with chaotic meows, tail slaps, and gravitational flicks—dealing purrfectly unpredictable punishment.
data.battleDescription: %user channels starlight through their paws as they launch into a spiraling NYA STRIKE. Their movements blur with tail-twirls and winking stardust. A chorus of meows echoes as enemies are struck with warping pressure waves. The laws of motion bend slightly off-rhythm—making projectiles misfire and attacks feel weightless.

data.name: Singularity I
data.description: Abby exits the concept of relevance. Buffs and debuffs? Denied by existence itself.
data.battleDescription: With a snap of inverse will, %user releases a gentle pulse of paradoxal chakra—a ripple that unthreads cause and effect in a five-meter radius. Time hitches. Color desaturates. Snowflakes hang motionless mid-fall, unsure if they’re ice or metaphor. %user then phases out, entering a Null State where interaction becomes optional. Buffs skitter away like nervous fox spirits. Debuffs dissolve mid-flight. Even the air forgets how to cling to %user. For two full rounds, %user becomes a fixed point in a broken equation—not immune, just categorically incompatible. Attempts to empower or weaken them unravel before they’re born. %target’s enhancements fizzle into shame. There’s no resistance. No deflection. Just stillness. Just Abby.

data.name: Yandere Kunai Barrage
data.description: If I can’t have you... then no one can
data.battleDescription: %user locks eyes with the target. Her hand blurs—kunai rain from the sky in a heart-shaped formation. The final one pierces the ground, pulsing with killing intent.

data.name: Overloaded Impact

data.battleDescription: %user overloads their chakra points to turbo charge their next attack against %target causing a %jutsu

data.name: Wailing Bark

Bound within the flow of collapsing seconds, %target is left weakened and vulnerable.

data.name: Walk of the Forgotten
data.description: "To walk through Mictlan is not to die — but to remember everything that made you wish you had"
data.battleDescription: %user exhales a whisper of chilling chakra causing the world to shift for %target . They find themselves walking the path of Mictlan, a realm of frost and endless descent. Nine spectral gates appear, each colder than the last. Between them, the wails of lost souls echo. %target sees familiar faces among the dead —  illusions of their past failures, former comrades, or slain foes — and as they try to flee, the cold grips their limbs and the dead grasp at their soul.

data.name: Death Spine of Mictlan
data.description: “From the frozen depths of the underworld, the spine of death rips through the battlefield.”
data.battleDescription: %user causes the temperature across the battle field to plummet. The world becomes silent, the air thick with an unseen pressure. Reality fractures for %target , their eyes blur as they find themselves standing alone in an icy black corridor. Before them stretch nine frost-covered stone gates, each carved with images of skeletal priests and winged serpents. As they pass each one, spectral hands emerge from the walls, taking away their strength, stripping memory, erasing their will, and rewriting their purpose. Their own voice echoes in reverse as they attempt to cry out. At the final gate, they face their reflection — Dead; Frozen; Forgotten. They try to scream, but only haze escapes their breath. As the illusion breaks, they collapse to one knee, eyes wide with terror:- Something inside them was left behind.

data.name: Litany of the Devourer
data.description: A sacred litany spoken through relentless motion. Each verse is a bite, each strike a mouthful taken from flesh and spirit alike. The Devourer does not rush its feast. It drains, consumes, and forbids mercy, ensuring the offering is swallowed whole.
data.battleDescription: %user advances with measured devotion, movements repeating the Litany strike by strike. Each blow tears more than flesh from %target, siphoning strength, chakra, and breath into hunger. No cleansing follows. The wounds remain open, the body unable to purge the feast, as the Devourer continues to feed through the coming rounds.

data.name: Hymn of Absolution
data.description: Absolution is not forgiveness. It is correction through suffering. By spilling blood in sacred measure, the disciple weakens the unworthy and prepares herself to be restored through the rite that follows.
data.battleDescription: %user strikes with deliberate cruelty, the blow draining strength and certainty from %target. As the wound settles, a quiet calm returns to the devotee's breathing. When the next round comes, the Sacrament answers, knitting flesh as absolution is granted through pain.

data.name: Momentum Shift
data.description: Momentum Shift is a devastating control-oriented time jutsu that attacks the concept of motion itself.
data.battleDescription: As %target moves  %user snaps their hand forward, releasing a burst of tightly compressed sand infused with chakra. The sand collides with the %target’s halting their movement

data.name: Muryōkūsho
data.description: The user steadies their breath and asserts control over the space around them, creating an unseen barrier that blunts incoming attacks. Rather than stopping force outright, this distance causes strikes to lose cohesion before they can fully land.  Opponents who commit to attacking overextend in the process, leaving their defenses compromised. As a result, they take increased damage, paying the price for misjudging the space they attempted to cross.  The technique does not rely on force or aggression. It enforces separation, turning intent itself into a weakness.
data.battleDescription: %user exhales and settles into place, the space around him tightening into something unseen but absolute. The opponent’s strike falls short, their momentum carrying them forward into a misstep.  %user does not move. The distance holds. From that moment on, every blow against the opponent lands harder, the price of reaching where they never truly could.

data.name: Karmic Correction
data.description: Karmic Correction is a technique born from patience exhausted, not anger unleashed. It represents the moment when restraint gives way to consequence, and clarity decides that no further balance can be maintained without force.  Rather than overwhelming the battlefield with chaos, the technique condenses intent, awareness, and judgment into a single release. The initial strike is absolute, but its true weight lingers, manifesting as wounds that continue to deepen as karma settles its account. What follows is not cruelty, but inevitability.  Those who witness Karmic Correction often describe it as less an attack and more a verdict. Once delivered, the outcome no longer belongs to the user. The consequence has already been set in motion.
data.battleDescription: %user brings his hands together, invoking Karmic Correction, as violet energy collapses into a single, devastating strike that crashes into %opponent. The impact carves deep, lingering wounds that continue to tear at them even after the blow has passed, the full weight of their actions settling in as %user stands calm and unmoved.

data.name: Oath of Unravelling
data.description: A vow sworn not to survive intact. In taking the Oath, the disciple abandons restraint, offering stability, mercy, and hesitation to the hunger within. What remains is a body sharpened by devotion and shielded by faith stripped of fear.

Each strike %user_subject delivers carries greater violence, each element bends closer to %user's will, and harm falters against %user_object as if unwilling to profane such conviction.

data.name: Revelation of The Red Monarch
data.description: A revelation delivered through flesh. The Red Monarch does not whisper truth. It is carved, forced open, and made impossible to deny. Those struck are laid bare beneath divine scrutiny, their bodies opened so suffering may find them more easily.
data.battleDescription: %user delivers the Revelation with solemn authority, each strike tearing into %target as if guided by unseen judgment. The wound glows with crimson decree, marking %target as chosen for ruin. From that moment on, pain finds them more readily, as if the Monarch’s gaze has settled fully upon their flesh.

data.name: Communion of the Crimson Tide
data.description: True communion is immersion. The faithful do not sip. They kneel, submerge, and allow the tide to claim them. Within the crimson flow, wounds are consumed, harm is devoured, and protection is shaped from blood itself.
data.battleDescription: The ground stirs beneath %user as the Communion begins. Blood surges upward and wraps around %user_object in living reverence, forming a shield that pulses with warmth. Each blow %user_subject suffers is swallowed by the tide, feeding restoration when the moment arrives.

data.name: Mictlan’s Cursed Road
data.description: "Before the dead reach peace, they must cross the frozen road of bones."
data.battleDescription: %user steps forward and slams his hand into the cold earth. An eerie pulse echoes outward — not like a shockwave, but like a heartbeat from beneath the ground. The terrain shifts violently, turning jet-black as spectral frost spreads in jagged patterns. The air freezes and howls with ghostly voices. Skeletal limbs and broken stone steps rise from the ground, forming a cursed road from Mictlan — etched with obsidian glyphs and slick with spirit frost. Movement becomes sluggish. Jutsu flow like molasses. Every step forward feels like it’s dragging through a grave. Walking ahead, already on the path, are footsteps letting you know your fate has already been decided.

data.name: Descent of the Bone Monarch
data.description: "He comes from beneath — not with fire, but with stillness."
data.battleDescription: The battlefield darkens as all warmth vanishes. %user raises a hand to the sky as black snow begins to fall. Behind them, a towering spectral form rises — the Bone Monarch. Cloaked in regal obsidian armor and wearing a crown of frozen thorns, he brings one bony finger to his face, gesturing for silence. With each breath, enemies feel the cold of death clawing at their lungs, and they envision ancient hands rising from beneath their feet. Chakra itself freezes, spirits crumble, and time feels as if it has slowed to a crawl. When the Monarch departs, he leaves only ruin and a cold silence.

The fawn lowers its head and bolts at %target with blinding speed, its body unraveling mid-charge into jagged lines of shadows. Where it strikes, strength bleeds away and pain rushes in.

data.name: Schrödinger Catboi’s Box
data.description: Abby slips halfway out of existence, forming a shimmering shell of semi-coherent defense.
data.battleDescription: %user exhales. Their chakra doesn’t flare—it fractures. Notes of it scatter into dimensional harmonics, and suddenly they are no longer fully present. Light bends. Sounds delay. Shadows fail to keep up. Caught between states, %user becomes a quantum blur of suggestion. Blows aimed at them lose impact, skipping like bad dreams on static. Even chakra begins to hesitate, unsure if it’s allowed to touch. As this anomaly stabilizes, a radiant shell—woven from warped moments and displaced space—forms around %user. Inside, time feels distant. Motion, optional. Battle is just a rumor. And in that perfect pause, %user reaches into their pouch…  and bites into a warm, freshly-roasted potato.  Crisp on the outside. Fluffy within. Reality has no defense.

data.name: Abby Paradox
data.description: Tear the timeline a little. Ride the rupture. Leave the enemy questioning their own hitbox.
data.battleDescription: In an instant of catastrophic serenity, %user pulses with distorted chakra—unfolding time like a bad map. Frost forms sideways, wind reverses its scream, and droplets of water hover mid-existential crisis. Without warning, %user flickers forward through an echo of future motion. The strike hits the opponent before it starts, severing balance, expectations, and likely a few laws of physics. Unmoored by time’s tantrum, %user rides the aftershock like a ripple through possibility, dragging fragments of past elements behind them—heat without flame, ice without cold, wind without direction.

data.name: Astral Nuzzle
data.description: A tender, glowing cuddle from beyond the stars, healing wounds and weaving fate’s fluffiest timeline.
data.battleDescription: %user purrs softly, their form flickering between realities. With a soft paw swipe and a warm astral nuzzle, they nestle into themselves—or an ally—projecting affection across space-time. A constellation in the shape of a cat forms above them as starlight heals wounds and ensures their best possible future is chosen.

data.name: Spirit of the True North: Unbreakable
data.description: Drawing strength from the frozen heart of the North, the user stands tall against all odds—empowering their strikes while weathering incoming blows like a glacier against the tide.
data.battleDescription: A shimmering aura of frost and maple gold encases %user, their presence swelling with unyielding resolve. Every strike lands heavier, while incoming attacks glance off like weak gusts against the northern ice.

data.battleDescription: A wall of swirling snow and ice crashes over %target, conjured by %user’s will. The relentless storm gnaws at their defenses, each flurry sapping their strength until even their strikes feel numb beneath the frost.

data.description: Summoning the fury of a winter storm (and possibly a rampaging moose), the user glides across the battlefield with chilling grace, lowering enemy defenses and sapping their fighting spirit.
data.battleDescription: %user carves a path through the battlefield like a moose on a frozen lake—unstoppable and mildly alarming. A flurry of snow and ice trails behind, chilling %target to the bone and dulling their strength with every pass.

With a rumble, the ground shifts, and an immense wall of solid rock erupts from the earth, towering before them. The wall forms a seamless barrier, its surface craggy and unyielding, standing firm against the enemy’s incoming attack. Dust clouds swirl as the rock stabilizes, its defensive power unmatched, blocking everything in its path.

data.name: Summon Legendary Jabberwocky
data.description: Attempts to summon the legendary Jabberwocky but accidentally summons a Baby Wocky.
data.battleDescription: KyoRuedrig holds out a hilt without a blade, channeling the madness in his heart. Chakra flows down his arm, manifesting the Vorpal Sword into existence. With a single slash of the shimmering blade, KyoRuedrig rends the veil between dreams and reality, attempting to summon the legendary Jabberwocky. Instead, he accidentally summons a Baby Wocky. The innocent Baby Wocky, small and harmless, looks around curiously and lets out a soft, confused chirp. Unable to attack or defend, the Baby Wocky simply sits and watches the chaos unfold around it, its presence a reminder of the unpredictable nature of the Wonderland Gemini bloodline.

data.name: Summoning: Chameleon Oddball
data.description: Oddball strikes without thought.
data.battleDescription: In a flash, %user calls forth Oddball, who lashes out instinctively at %target. The chameleon's swift, unpredictable attack catches %target off guard, delivering a venomous bite that paralyzes and disorients. Oddball's lack of strategy is compensated by the sheer speed and surprise of his assault.

data.name: Summoning: Gator Gaston
data.description: Gaston consumes all in his path.

effects.description: A massive alligator known for his incredible strength and insatiable hunger. Gaston is always looking to devour anything in sight, making him a formidable force on the battlefield but also a bit of a challenge to control due to his aggressive nature.

data.battleDescription: With a swift command, %user calls upon Gaston to sweep through the battlefield. Gaston moves with terrifying speed, devouring anything in his path. His insatiable hunger drives him to snap up %target, engulfing them in a wave of crushing force that leaves destruction in its wake.
