data.name: Marshmallow Hammer of Doom
data.description: Teni throws a marshmallow on the ground which inflates in size. She then skewers it before igniting it. Laughing like a maniac, she raises it above her head before slamming it down towards the opponent repeatedly, like a twisted game of whack-a-mole
data.battleDescription: %user hurls a small marshmallow to the ground, and with a burst of chakra, it swells to an enormous size. She skewers the giant marshmallow with a pole, igniting it with her chakra. Laughing maniacally, she lifts the flaming marshmallow hammer and slams it down onto her %target repeatedly, each impact leaving them scorched and dazed.

data.name: Siren's Enchantment
data.description: Entraps the target
data.battleDescription: %user extends their hand, summoning a towering stone mausoleum that traps %target. The haunting echoes of a siren's song reverberate through the walls, immobilizing %target. As %user clenches their fist, the stone walls close in, crushing %target and piercing them with jagged spikes, leaving them helpless in the siren's unyielding grasp.

data.name: Bakuretsu Nendo Tate
data.description: Creates a protective shield of explosive clay.
data.battleDescription: %user swiftly molds a large, sturdy shield from clay, infusing it with explosive chakra. The shield stands tall and firm, absorbing incoming attacks. When the shield sustains enough damage, %user can trigger the explosive chakra within, causing the shield to detonate and send shockwaves outward. The explosion not only deflects attacks but also creates a powerful counter-offensive blast that disorients and damages the opponent.

data.name: Cleansing Aura
data.description: A non-elemental jutsu that purges the user of all negative status effects, including residuals and debuffs.
data.battleDescription: %user forms a series of deliberate hand seals, creating a radiant aura of pure chakra that surrounds their body. The cleansing energy washes over %user, dispelling all negative status effects and restoring %user to their optimal state.

data.name: Solar Staff Strike - WR
data.description: Strikes with a sun-empowered walking stick.
data.battleDescription: %user wields their walking stick, a symbol of their journeys and devotion across Seichi. Infused with the radiant energy of Amaterasu, the stick glows with a brilliant light. With a swift and precise motion, %user strikes %target with the walking stick. Upon impact, the stick releases a burst of solar energy, searing %target and causing intense pain. The radiant strike not only deals significant physical damage but also leaves %target temporarily blinded by the intense flash of light. This jutsu embodies the strength and resolve of the Traveling Sun Praiser, turning a simple tool of travel into a powerful weapon.

data.name: Solar Purification
data.description: Throws a sun-blessed rag that purifies and burns.
data.battleDescription: %user retrieves a sacred cleaning rag, used to maintain the purity of the Sun Shrine. Infused with the radiant energy of Amaterasu, this rag is not merely a tool for cleaning but a powerful weapon of purification. %user hurls the rag towards %target with a precise throw. As it flies through the air, the rag glows with a blinding light. Upon contact, the rag releases a burst of purifying flames, burning %target and dispelling any dark or malevolent energies. The area around %target is left cleansed and sanctified, preventing the use of any dark jutsus for a short period.

data.name: Dust Wraith
data.description: Become semi incorporeal making it impossible for the enemy to attack safely
data.battleDescription: %user blurs the line between corporeal and ethereal, morphing into a wraith. This semi-tangible state leaving foes to struggle to land decisive blows.

You are shocked and horrified at its sudden appearance, and before you can compose yourself, the creature explodes in a blast of chakra disintegrating its flesh and bones in the process.

data.name: Demonic Embrace

data.battleDescription: As %user activates Demonic Embrace, a dark, sinister aura surrounds them, enhancing their physical prowess. With a menacing glare, they charge towards the opponent, delivering a series of devastating blows imbued with dark energy. Each strike lands with incredible force, causing the opponent to stagger and falter, overwhelmed by the sheer power of the demonic aura.

data.name: Starlight Shroud
data.description: Channels celestial energy to enhance both strength and protection.
data.battleDescription: %user gazes upward, drawing in the shimmering essence of the stars. As the celestial energy courses through their veins, a radiant veil of starlight surrounds them. This ethereal barrier fortifies their defenses, while simultaneously enhancing their offensive prowess. With each attack, %user strikes with the force of a shooting star, and every incoming blow is softened by the veil's protective light.

data.name: Phantom Breeze
data.description: Creates an illusion of chilling winds to lower the enemy’s morale.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a spectral breeze that chills %target to the bone. The cold, biting winds sap %target’s strength and resolve, creating an illusion of frost forming on their skin and equipment. As the phantom chill seeps into their bones

data.name: Earthquake Phantasm
data.description: Simulates a powerful earthquake to disorient the enemy.
data.battleDescription: %user stomps the ground, creating the illusion of a massive earthquake. %target feels the ground shaking violently beneath them, making it difficult to maintain their balance. The constant tremors and the sound of cracking earth disorient %target, causing them to misjudge their surroundings and stumble, giving %user an opening to strike.

data.name: Thunderstrike Blade
data.description: Empowers the user's weapon with intense lightning, striking with explosive force.
data.battleDescription: %user weapon crackles with electricity, arcs of lightning dancing along the blade. With each strike, the weapon releases bursts of electrical energy that explode on impact, sending shockwaves through %target. The overwhelming power of the lightning leaves %target stunned and vulnerable to further attacks, as the electrifying assault continues.

data.name: Fire Unbinding
data.description: A Flaming lotus that wraps it selfs around the target
data.battleDescription: %user conjures a flicker flaming lotus of With a whispered chant, the lotus blossoms mid-air — and from it burst dozens of petal-like fragments that streak toward %target

data.name: Earth Release: Seismic Echoes
data.description: Earth Release: Seismic Echoes traps the target in a world of relentless earthquakes and tremors. The illusion creates the sensation of being caught in a series of violent seismic events, causing the target to experience overwhelming disorientation and fear, severely affecting their combat capabilities.
data.battleDescription: %user weaves a complex series of hand signs, their chakra flowing into %target's mind. Suddenly, %target feels the ground beneath them start to shake violently as if an earthquake has erupted. The earth splits and trembles, sending %target stumbling and struggling to maintain their balance. The relentless tremors and aftershocks make it impossible for %target to concentrate, their senses overwhelmed by the chaos. Each quake reverberates through their body, creating a paralyzing sense of dread and confusion. %user stands firm, the real world around them unaffected, while %target is left reeling from the illusionary seismic assault.

data.name: Water Unbinding
data.description: Surround yourself in a dome of water rejuvenating your mind and body
data.battleDescription: %user presses their feet to the ground, releasing water nature chakra that envelops them in a dome, the water chakra is filled with healing minerals that  slowly heals the %user wounds

data.name: Electric Surge Kick
data.description: A lightning-charged kick that strikes hard, boosts the user’s Taijutsu, and weakens the enemy’s physical capabilities.
data.battleDescription: %user channels a surge of lightning chakra into their leg, the energy pulsing violently beneath the skin. In a blink, they launch forward with a blinding kick, lightning crackling in the air as their heel crashes into %target. The impact sears muscle and disrupts the target’s physical balance—slowing their reflexes, weakening their strength, and softening their defense. As the chakra arcs back through %user’s body, their own Taijutsu prowess sharpens, their strikes becoming faster, tighter, and more devastating.

data.name: Wind Unbinding

data.name: Sapphire Decree

data.battleDescription: %user releases a pulse of Blue Blade chakra across the battlefield. As the wave passes through %target, their chakra flow freezes, increasing their vulnerability.

data.name: Unholy Augment
data.description: The user awakens a corrupted vitality, amplifying their strength while their body shrugs off harm with unnatural resilience.
data.battleDescription: A dark pulse spreads through %user’s veins, quickening with hungry force. %user’s strikes land harder, fueled by something that does not tire, while blows from %target sink shallow, unable to fully pierce what refuses to weaken.

data.name: Mirage Step
data.description: Swap places with your own reflection to launch a supprise attack on your target.
data.battleDescription: %user stood at the water’s edge, eyes fixed on their own reflection.  %user stepps forward, merging with their reflection Suddenly, they were the reflection, gazing back at their original self.  Together, they advanced toward %target. %target swung a blade, but it met only air. The reflection dissolved into droplets, vanishing with a splash. And then, from beneath the waves, %user burst forth with a flurry of strikes from their katana

data.name: Tenryūseigan: Celestial Sealing
data.description: Seals the enemy's bloodline abilities.
data.battleDescription: %user's eyes glow with an ancient, divine energy, focusing intently on %target. With a series of intricate hand seals, they channel this energy into a binding force that surges towards %target. The celestial light surrounds %target, forming luminous chains that bind their body and spirit. These chains pulse with divine energy, penetrating deep into %target's chakra system. As %target struggles, %user completes the sealing technique, locking away %target's bloodline abilities. The celestial chains tighten, sealing %target's bloodline and rendering their unique abilities inert, leaving them vulnerable and powerless.

data.name: Lightning Dance
data.description: The user gives their chakra the properties of lightning to enhance their strength both offensively and defensively.
data.battleDescription: %user manipulates their chakra giving it an electric effect that severely increases their power, the overflowing chakra discharges around them coincidentally blocking incoming attacks as they move across the battlefield.

data.name: Tenryūseigan: Tamashī no Sakeme - nM3rV7Z2uzokyoHD0TqHB
data.description: A devastating strike that cuts through both body and spirit.
data.battleDescription: %user focuses their energy, and a dark aura begins to surround them. With a swift and decisive movement, they launch a blade of pure ethereal energy toward %target. This blade cuts through physical defenses like paper, but its true power lies in its ability to sever the connection between body and spirit. %target feels a cold, numbing pain as their very soul is sliced, leaving them disoriented, weakened, and vulnerable to further attacks. The wound left by this strike lingers, disrupting %target's chakra flow and making it difficult to recover.

data.name: Heavenly Edifices
data.description: Creates chakra constructs for massive damage and defense.
data.battleDescription: %user's hands move with fluid grace, channeling their chakra into pure, radiant energy. This energy takes form as shimmering constructs—spectral weapons, towering shields, and fierce guardian beasts. The battlefield is transformed into a scene of divine warfare, as these constructs move to both attack and protect. %target finds themselves besieged by a relentless barrage of ethereal blades and spectral beasts, each strike imbued with the raw power of %user's chakra. Simultaneously, %user is enveloped in a fortress of light, the constructs forming an impenetrable defense that deflects any incoming attacks.

data.name: Void Crush
data.description: A crushing wave of void chakra that damages the enemy and suppresses their overall offensive power.
data.battleDescription: %user compresses a mass of void chakra and hurls it at %target, crushing them beneath invisible pressure. The impact distorts their chakra pathways and dulls their focus, weakening all forms of offensive output across physical and spiritual disciplines.

data.name: Torrent Blade
data.description: The user channels their chakra into their sword and infuses it with water release. This blade can cut through solid objects, and the current can knock opponents off balance.
data.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra into their sword, infusing it with water. The blade transforms, shimmering with liquid energy. With a swift motion, they slash through the air, creating a blade of pressurized water.

data.name: Voltblade Barrage
data.description: Charges the weapon with high-voltage electricity, enabling the user to deliver rapid, electrifying strikes.
data.battleDescription: %user weapon hums with lethal energy, vibrating with the power of high-voltage electricity. In a blur of motion, %user unleashes a flurry of strikes, each one delivering a jolt of electricity that courses through %target’s body. The rapid assault overwhelms %target’s defenses, the electrical energy searing their nerves with each hit.

data.name: Founder’s Fury
data.description: Unleashes a massive attack by harnessing the origins of chakra.
data.battleDescription: Drawing on the very origins of chakra, %user begins to chant an ancient incantation, their voice resonating with the primordial energy of creation. The ground trembles as elemental forces converge around %user—fire, water, earth, and lightning swirl into a tempest of raw power. With a final, commanding gesture, %user unleashes this elemental fury upon %target. The combined elements strike with devastating force, engulfing %target in a catastrophic storm that obliterates everything in its path. The sheer magnitude of the attack showcases the true power of the Heavenly Founder's legacy.

data.name: Electric Ensnare
data.description: Unleashe a torrent of lightning, coiling around the opponent like serpentine tendrils
data.battleDescription: %user summons crackling electric currents that coil around %target, stunning them with jolts of energy.

data.name: Leviathan's Nova
data.description: A water-element Genjutsu that engulfs the target’s mind with a vision of a colossal, deep-sea leviathan rising from the ocean's abyss.
data.battleDescription: %user begins by forming a series of complex hand seals, channeling deep water chakra into the surrounding environment. %target suddenly finds themselves transported beneath an immense ocean, the water dark and oppressive around them. As they struggle to comprehend their situation, a gigantic leviathan emerges from the darkness, its eyes glowing ominously in the abyssal light.  The creature opens its vast maw, and in a moment of horror, %target is swallowed whole. The overwhelming fear and the illusion of digestive acids burning them.

data.name: Aether Bow
data.description: The user creates a bow made of condensed wind chakra, imbuing it with the properties of the wind itself. The bowstring is formed from swirling winds, and the arrows are made of compressed air.
data.battleDescription: %user forms the Aether Bow, drawing back the ethereal bowstring. As they release, the arrow made of compressed air shoots forth with incredible speed and force, cutting through the air with a faint, whistling sound. The arrow strikes %target with the power of a gusting wind, dealing damage with the force of a natural disaster.

data.name: Shocking Torture
data.description: A jutsu that batters the opponent's mind by torturing it with electric shocks.
data.battleDescription: %user locks eyes with %target, casting them into a nightmarish world where crackling lightning surges from every direction. %target's muscles seize as they are bombarded with waves of agonizing electric shocks, each jolt worse than the last.

data.name: Water Release: Water Dragon Blade

data.battleDescription: %user shapes water into a coiled dragon around their blade. They lunge — the dragon strikes first, jaws snapping around %target, empowering %user’s ability to heal.

data.name: Abyssal Lure

The user then utters an incantation and the chain drags %target downward, sinking rapidly toward the ocean floor. As the target struggles against the weight of the water and the darkness envelops them, their chakra is drained away, leaving them weakened and disoriented.

No matter how %target struggles, the flames continue to consume them, spreading across their body in a relentless, agonizing inferno.

The sensation hampers %target's agility, making it challenging to evade attacks.

data.name: Thousand Lash
data.description: The user unleashes a relentless barrage that shatters defenses, leaving the target exposed to further harm.
data.battleDescription: %user descends in a frenzy of strikes, each blow tearing through %target with merciless precision. Defenses collapse under the onslaught, and in the wake of the assault, %target is left wide open, unable to withstand what follows.

data.name: Hemosalve
data.description: The user commands their blood to reject injury, sealing wounds and feeding on incoming harm to sustain an unnatural vitality.
data.battleDescription: %user’s blood writhes beneath %user_object skin, surging against the flow of nature. Wounds seal shut as they form, and each strike from %target is devoured, strength stolen as %user refuses to fall.

data.name: Crimson Collision
data.description: The user violently rends their target, leaving them exposed while siphoning vitality from the damage inflicted.
data.battleDescription: %user rends %target with brutal force, tearing open deep, bleeding wounds. The injury lingers, raw and unclosing, as %user drinks from it, each pulse of pain feeding %user’s strength.

data.name: Imperial Blades

data.battleDescription: %user traps %target within a  dense dome made of mirrors. Appearing above the dome, %user clasp their hands together, the mirrors begin to vibrate and swords of light begin to fire out of the mirrors towards %target. Being trapped in the middle %target is unable to evade the barrage of swords.

data.name: Chrono Arrest
data.description: Accelerates your bodies cellular regeneration, giving your muscles more oxygen and increasing your grit.
data.battleDescription: %user creates a large translucent ball of light and steps into it. Trapping themselves within, %user accelerates the growth of their cells, increasing their power, along with their defenses.

data.name: Luminance
data.description: A forbidden technique passed down through the generations. Illuminate the entire battlefield.
data.battleDescription: %user creates a jutsu formula  that spreads out from their feet. Acting as a honing signal, a bright pattern appears above %target . The chakra condenses and beams of light fire towards %target

data.name: Reaper's Clasp
data.description: The user closes in and drains their target directly, tearing vitality from them in a violent, inescapable exchange.
data.battleDescription: %user lunges forward and crashes into %target, dragging %target close as crimson energy surges between them. With every heartbeat, %user rips vitality free, feeding on %target’s life as %user_object holds them through this vicious dance.

data.name: Fractured Reflection
data.description: Reflects light to create clones and distort perception.
data.battleDescription: With a flicker of their eyes, %user manipulates the surrounding light, creating multiple afterimages of themselves that confuse and disorient %target. These illusions mirror %target's attacks back at them, leaving them unsure of the true %user's position. Each reflection seems real until %target is struck by a precise blow from the shadows, capitalizing on their disoriented state.

data.name: Edge Resonance
data.description: Synchronizes the user’s chakra with their weapon, enhancing its power.
data.battleDescription: %user channels the power of their lineage into forming a blade made of ice. As the blade form, their eyes awaken, In this state, %user 's awareness and abilities are enhanced.

data.name: Astral Energy
data.description: The user channels the aura of the universe, infusing their body with boundless cosmic energy. Their power surges, enhancing all abilities while warping space around them with celestial force.
data.battleDescription: %user's body radiates with cosmic energy, their form pulsing with the limitless power of the universe. Nebulas swirl around them, stars flickering in response to their ascension.

data.name: Astral Chains
data.description: The user summons ethereal cosmic chains, forged from celestial energy, to bind their target. These luminous restraints drain power, suppressing their abilities while making them more vulnerable to attacks.
data.battleDescription: %user extends their hand, summoning radiant cosmic chains from the void. The glowing restraints lash out, binding %target as celestial energy siphons their strength. Gravity warps around them, their power fading under the weight of the stars.

data.name: Astral Explosion
data.description: The user taps into celestial energy, accelerating regeneration through cosmic light. Their body glows with a radiant nebula, restoring health while converting damage dealt into healing energy.
data.battleDescription: %user releases a small purple ball into the center of the battlefield, the small ball begins to vibrate as a strong gravitational field begins to draw in %targets and the surrounding area. Once %targets reaches the center and makes contact with the sphere, it ignites causing a chain reaction of the entire area around %target igniting

data.name: Astral Intent
data.description: A celestial barrier engulfs the user, distorting space with swirling nebulas and crackling energy. It absorbs attacks while weakening nearby enemies under immense gravitational force.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a radiant cosmic barrier, warping space around them. The shield crackles with violet energy, absorbing attacks while pulling %target into its crushing gravity.

data.name: Lightning Unbinding
data.description: Encase yourself in lightning natured chakra
data.battleDescription: %user generates lightning nature charka around their entire body

data.name: Sanguine Blight
data.description: The user seeds a rival's blood with a burning sickness. The plague opens them to harm and eats at them from within, while the user's own blood refuses all affliction.
data.battleDescription: %user flicks a drop of tainted blood onto %target and it takes root, burning as it spreads. %target is opened and eaten from within, while %user_object own veins run too hot for any sickness to touch.

data.name: Crimson Levy
data.description: The user takes a toll in blood and time alike. The shock of the taking locks the victim in place, and what movement remains costs them dearly.
data.battleDescription: %user reaches into the space between heartbeats and takes what is owed. %target staggers, locked mid-motion, and even time itself grows expensive around them.

data.name: Ring of Spilled Vitae
data.description: A spiral of spent blood is thrown across the ground. It opens what stands against the user, and what it opens, it weakens.
data.battleDescription: %user spills a spiral across the ground and it turns outward, hungry. Enemies caught in the ring are opened, and their blows leave the circle duller than they entered.

data.name: Ice Fetters
data.description: The Gaze regards a rival and the cold agrees. Frost climbs them like a verdict, and for a breath the world simply declines to let them move.
data.battleDescription: %user levels the trident and its three eyes narrow. Frost races up %target from the ground, locking joint after joint, until %target stands shackled in blue ice.

data.name: Glacial Salvo
data.description: The wielder raises the Gaze and the air answers with an arsenal. A dozen lances of ice hang waiting, and every one of them has already chosen where it lands.
data.battleDescription: %user raises the trident and the cold assembles into ranks: lance after lance of pale ice hanging in the air, every point aimed at %target. %user lowers the tines, and winter volleys.

data.name: Icebound Force
data.description: The wielder lets winter close over them like a second body. What it grips, it guards, and the cold it sheds sinks into their rival's every limb, dulling their blows before they land.
data.battleDescription: %user plants the trident and the cold closes over %user like armor, plate after plate of pale ice. The chill hangs heavy on every swing at %user, and the blows that land arrive dulled, only settling the frost.

data.name: Forbidden Art: Soul Furnace Reversal
data.description: A forbidden yin-yang ninjutsu that turns the user's chakra core into a furnace, stealing vitality while making the body dangerously brittle.

effects.description: A soul furnace burns the target from within.
The user siphons vitality from inflicted damage.
The target's ability to recover is scorched away.
The stolen heat leaves the user's body brittle.

data.battleDescription: %user exhales black flame from their palms and shapes it into a furnace door behind %target's spirit. The door swings open, dragging heat, breath, and willpower from %target into %user's chest. Wounds seal for a moment, but the stolen vitality burns too hot; %user's skin fractures with pale light, leaving them dangerously easy to break.

data.name: Forbidden Art: Grave Lotus Detonation
data.description: A suicidal taijutsu form where the user opens every chakra gate for one blooming strike, detonating the impact like a funeral flower.

effects.description: A blooming explosive strike crushes the target.
The lotus impact leaves a deep lingering wound.
The user overclocks their body past safe limits.
The forbidden gates punish the user's body.

data.battleDescription: %user drives both feet into the ground and forces their chakra gates open with a sound like breaking iron. A crimson lotus unfolds around their body as they vanish, reappearing inside %target's guard with a strike that detonates outward in layered petals of force. The impact wounds %target deeply, but the recoil throws %user back with bones shaking and blood-hot chakra leaking from every tenketsu.

data.name: Forbidden Art: Eclipse Nerve Sutra
data.description: A forbidden genjutsu that writes dark scripture directly across the target's nervous system, locking pain and hesitation into the body.

effects.description: Eclipse scripture damages the target's senses.
The target's nerves seize under forbidden script.
The target's attacks lose force and timing.
The scripture rejects all blessings from the user.

data.battleDescription: %user traces a circle over one eye, and the battlefield dims under an artificial eclipse. Black sutra characters crawl through the air and stitch themselves into %target's nerves. Every thought becomes a delayed command, every breath a misfire, while %user stands perfectly still, unable to receive any blessing until the scripture fades.

data.name: Forbidden Art: Black Sun Funeral
data.description: A banned solar incineration art that folds scorch and explosion chakra into a false sun. The blast is overwhelming, but the user's own life force burns with it.

effects.description: A collapsing black sun tears through the target.
The target is left exposed by solar burns.
The user's forbidden heat sharpens their next attacks.
The black sun consumes the user's body and chakra.

data.battleDescription: %user clasps both hands and crushes the light above the battlefield into a black sun. The sphere drops behind %target without sound, then blooms into a white-hot funeral pyre that strips shadows from the ground. As %target reels, %user's veins glow like cracked embers, their own chakra reservoirs collapsing under the forbidden heat.

data.name: Earthquake Guard
data.description: A powerful defensive strike that boosts the user's Offence, Strength and Speed.

As stone and dust erupt into the air, the impact reinforces %user’s physical form, sharpening reflexes and bolstering their power. The terrain trembles beneath their stance, radiating raw force that surges into their body, heightening their Offence, Strength and Speed.

data.name: Stone Coffin

data.battleDescription: %user weaves a grim illusion into %target’s mind, conjuring the sensation of being sealed within suffocating stone coffins. The heavy pressure clamps down on their limbs, and phantom stone walls grind in around them with slow, crushing force. Though it is all in their mind, the weight feels real—crushing resolve, disrupting chakra flow, and dulling their ability to strike back with strength or precision.

data.name: Terra Crush
data.description: A powerful strike that channels the weight of the earth into the weapon, delivering a crushing blow.
data.battleDescription: %user slams their weapon into the ground, pulling up a massive chunk of earth with the force of their chakra. With a single fluid motion, they hurl the earth at %target, smashing into them with the full weight of the land. The impact sends %target crashing to the ground, crushed beneath the debris.

data.name: Pulse Strike
data.description: A raw chakra strike that damages the enemy and heightens the user’s mental and spiritual power.
data.battleDescription: %user releases a focused burst of pure chakra that slams into %target with precision. The surge sharpens the user’s chakra flow, boosting their Offence while enhancing their clarity and inner strength through elevated intelligence and willpower.

data.name: Thunderous Knee Strike
data.description: A close-range knee strike that delivers heavy impact and suppresses enemy offensive power.
data.battleDescription: %user lunges forward with explosive speed, chakra tightening around their core as they drive a sharp knee into %target’s abdomen. The impact sends a thunderous shock through the target’s body, disrupting chakra circulation and muscular focus. The blow rattles the center of their offense—cutting power from their strikes, reducing precision, and softening their follow-through

data.name: Iron Fist Fury
data.description: A punishing taijutsu strike that boosts the user’s Offence, Strength and Speed after impact.
data.battleDescription: %user surges forward, fists clenched with dense chakra and full-bodied intent. They unleash a ruthless strike against %target, each punch landing with the weight of forged iron. The assault stuns not just with power, but precision. As the final hit lands, the chakra coursing through %user intensifies—sharpening their Offence, tightening reaction speed, and reinforcing every movement.

data.name: Quaking Mallet
data.description: A powerful Earth Bukijutsu technique that involves striking the ground with a chakra-infused weapon, creating shockwaves that resonate through the earth and destabilize the ground beneath the target.
data.battleDescription: %user slams their mallet into the ground, sending a surge of chakra deep into the earth. The ground beneath %target begins to shake violently, cracks forming around them as the terrain becomes increasingly unstable. The quakes grow stronger with each passing moment, forcing %target to constantly adjust their stance to avoid being toppled or trapped by the shifting earth.

data.name: Blooming Nightmare
data.description: The Lilac Seductress bloodline harnesses the power of flower manipulation to ensnare opponents. This technique traps the target in a surreal nightmare, making them feel as if their bodies are being enveloped and constricted by rapidly blooming flowers.
data.battleDescription: As %user locks eyes with %target, a sinister smile forms on their lips. In an instant, %user's technique takes hold, and %target's reality warps into a surreal floral nightmare. %target feels their body being enveloped by vines and flowers, petals blooming from within, constricting their movement and sapping their strength. The overwhelming sensation of being choked and bound leaves %target immobilized and vulnerable. With %target's defenses shattered, %user moves in for the decisive strike, exploiting the chaos wrought by the blooming nightmare.

data.name: Terra Shield
data.description: Creates a protective shield of solid rock.
data.battleDescription: %user raises their weapon, channeling earth chakra to summon a massive shield of solid rock. This defensive technique can block incoming attacks and protect %user and their allies. The Terra Shield is incredibly durable, capable of withstanding powerful blows and providing a strategic advantage in battle.

data.name: Stone Edge
data.description: Creates a blade of hardened earth for close combat.
data.battleDescription: %user forms a blade from the surrounding earth, hardening it with their chakra. Wielding this stone blade, they engage %target in close combat, delivering precise and powerful strikes. The earth-enhanced blade is incredibly durable, capable of cutting through most defenses and causing significant damage to %target.

data.name: Earthen Echo
data.description: Uses the sound of shifting earth to create disorienting echoes.
data.battleDescription: %user manipulates the earth to produce a series of echoing sounds that reverberate around the opponent. The constant shifting and rumbling noises make it difficult for the opponent to pinpoint %user location or focus on their surroundings. Confused and overwhelmed by the auditory illusions, the opponent is left vulnerable to %user’s next move.

data.name: Stone Labyrinth
data.description: Creates an illusion of an endless stone maze.
data.battleDescription: %user weaves intricate hand seals, causing the ground to tremble as an illusory stone labyrinth rises around %target. The towering walls twist and turn, leading %target into a disorienting maze with no apparent exit. As %target navigates the endless corridors, they are plagued by feelings of confusion and claustrophobia, making it difficult to focus on the battle.

data.name: Silent Tempest

The complete absence of noise disorients the opponent, making them acutely aware of their own heartbeat and breathing. The eerie silence heightens their anxiety and fear, impairing their ability to fight effectively as they struggle to adapt to the unnerving environment.

data.name: Tempest's Whispers

As the whispers grow louder and more insistent, %target becomes increasingly paranoid and distracted, unable to focus on the battle at hand.

data.name: Siren's Lure

As %target is drawn towards the apparition, they are ensnared in a web of deceit, their senses overwhelmed by the phantom's allure. The illusion manipulates their perception of reality, making it difficult for them to distinguish friend from foe, ultimately leaving them vulnerable to %user's next move.

data.name: Whispering Duststorm

Despite the risk, %user persists, driven by an unwavering determination to emerge victorious.

This excruciating pain overwhelms %target, leaving them disoriented and vulnerable to %user's next move.

data.battleDescription: Through intricate hand seals and focused chakra manipulation,  using their blade, %user extracts heat energy from target freezing them solid

Panic descends, leaving %target unable to distinguish between reality and the fabricated, devastating storm.

As the dragon tightens its grip, %target's chakra channels are twisted and distorted, causing their Bukijutsu abilities to falter and wane. Each attempt to muster a technique is met with resistance, the dragon draining their skill and proficiency with each passing moment.

data.name: Blinding Strike
data.description: Blinding Strike is a Forbidden S-Rank Bukijutsu that imbues the user's weapon with blinding light, causing disorientation in opponents and reducing their Offence, Intelligence and Willpower.
data.battleDescription: With a swift, fluid motion, %user's weapon gleams with blinding light as they unleash Blinding Strike. data.battleDescription: With unmatched speed and precision, %user begins to spin, their weapon trailing a visible vortex of chakra-infused air. As %user approaches %target, the swirling chakra vortex becomes a weapon-withering force.

data.name: Chains of Sorrow

data.name: Aqua Prison

data.name: Maelstrom's Embrace

As the torrent subsides, %target is left battered and shaken, the water slowly receding back into the surroundings.

data.name: Sealing Blade

As the blade connects, %target reels, the disruption causing them intense pain and confusion. %user presses the advantage, their mastery of swordsmanship and chakra control evident in every move, leaving %target incapacitated without their chakra.

data.name: Soaring Fujin

data.name: Storm Surge

data.name: Thunderous Echo

data.name: Phantom Guilt
